addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon. Download locations: CurseForge | Wago

Profession Shopping List (PSL) allows you to track recipes, and it shows you the materials you need to craft them. It also tracks recipe cooldowns.

When viewing your profession knowledge, see at a glance how many perks you have unlocked and what one-time knowledge you can still obtain.

Easily shows you what a crafting orders's rewards are and how profitable they are.

Quickly send work orders to your alts with the Quick Order preset, and repeat your last work order sent with the click of a button.

Easily track profession achievements and let Profession Shopping List grab the necessary recipes for you.

Includes handy buttons for your professions, such as portable anvils or the cooking fire.

Also lets you track the cost of vendor items. Say goodbye to scribbling on a notepad.

A full list of features and slash commands can be found in-game by reading the tooltips on the tracking window and viewing the addon's settings.

Currently supported addons:
• CraftSim
• TestFlight
If you are experiencing issues
• Use /psl clear. Sometimes stuff gets stuck, or old data needs to be cleared.
• Check if the issue occurs with only this addon enabled, or if the issue is a feature you can disable from the addon's settings menu.
• If the issues persist or you have other feedback, feel free to join the Discord and ask in the #profession-shopping-list channel, or create a ticket on GitHub. :)

Adds ProfessionShoppingList:GetShoppingList(), returning itemID = {

BuyFromMerchant() now buys from it, so BetterBags' vendor can show

• Fixed an error that could occur when gaining skill points on Forever
• Fix lua error for too long if statement
• Add Forever recipe difficulties
• Add 12.1.5 recipe difficulties
• Reuse tracking rows and spread recipe registration across frames (#412)
Opening a profession currently registers every recipe in one delayed
callback, and each tracking-window refresh creates new row frames and
font strings. This can cause visible pauses and accumulate UI objects as
the list is refreshed.
This change reuses recipe, reagent and cooldown rows and their font
strings while retaining the existing click actions, tooltips and display
logic. Recipe registration keeps the initial two-second loading delay,
then processes small slices across frames with a 2 ms target and a
maximum of 12 recipes per slice. Closing/reopening a profession
invalidates pending work, combat pauses registration, and incomplete
recipe data receives two delayed retries. Recipe info is read once per
registration.
Validated in-game on Retail 12.1.5. Private Lua 5.1 checks also covered
repeated row reuse, updated click bindings, complete recipe
registration, retries, close/reopen cancellation and combat pause. A
single native API call can exceed the cooperative time target.

addons.description:
Smart, always-up-to-date macros for Healthstones, healing potions, class/racial self-heals, mana potions, food, drink and bandages.

Auto Potion was previously known as Healthstone Auto Macro. The addon automatically creates and maintains these macros for you:
• AutoPotion – uses your class/racial healing spells, Healthstones and the best available healing potion (and some special healing items).
• AutoManaPotion – uses the mana potion in your bags that restores the most mana.
• AutoFood – eats the best food in your bags: conjured food first, then the food that restores the most health.
• AutoDrink – drinks the best drink in your bags: conjured water first, then the drink that restores the most mana.
• AutoBandage – uses your strongest bandage, with special handling in battlegrounds.

You never have to edit these macros yourself – Auto Potion keeps them updated as your bags, talents and gear change. Just put the ones you want on your action bars.
What the addon does
• Automatic healing macro: Keeps a /castsequence macro up to date so you can bind a single key for self-heals, Healthstones and healing potions.
• Smart priority system:
• Class/racial healing spells (like Renewal, Exhilaration, Desperate Prayer, Gift of the Naaru, etc.).
• Optional support for Heartseeking Health Injector (engineering tinker) on Retail.
• Warlock Healthstones (including classic variants), with an option to lower their priority if you prefer potions first.
• The strongest available healing potion in your bags, including modern and legacy potions (Silvermoon / Invigorating / Algari / Dreamwalker's / Withering / Cosmic / Spiritual / etc.).
• Fleeting potions are used before the normal potion of the same quality, since they expire.
• Optional Cavedweller's Delight support as a separate, toggleable step.
• Sorted for your game version:
• Every potion, food, drink and bandage list is ordered strongest first for your game version (checked against the game data of Retail, Classic Era, TBC, Wrath, Cata, Mists and Forever), so the macro always picks the best item you have.
• Smart battleground support:
• Uses the appropriate PvP-only healing draughts and bandages when you are in battlegrounds (e.g. Ashran tonic, Classic draughts and BG bandages).
• Mana potion macro:
• Maintains an AutoManaPotion macro (/use item:) for the best mana potion in your bags, sorted by the amount of mana restored for your game version (e.g. Lightfused / Algari / Aerated on Retail, Master / Mythical / Runic / Super / Major on the Classic versions).
• Potions that restore health and mana (Rejuvenation potions, Cavedweller's Delight, Refreshing Serum) are included and sorted by their mana, and can be turned off in the settings.
• Channeled/"defenseless" potions, potions with side effects and zone-locked potions are never used.
• Food and drink macros:
• Maintain an AutoFood and an AutoDrink macro for the best food and drink in your bags.
• Conjured food and water come first (free, and they don't take up bag space).
• Food and drink that also give a "Well Fed" or "Relaxed" buff come next, but only if you turn on Include Buff Food.
• Then food and drink that restore health and mana, then plain food and drink, highest tier first.
• On TBC, Wrath, Cata and Mists, food and drink from the earlier expansions follow as a fallback for characters that are still leveling.
• Bandage macro:
• Maintains an AutoBandage macro that uses the best bandage available for your current game version and content.
• Works across versions:
• Retail (Midnight), Classic Era, The Burning Crusade Anniversary, WotLK Classic, Cataclysm Classic, Mists of Pandaria Classic, and WoW Forever (beta).
How it works
• Macro maintenance:
• On login, /reload, leaving combat, changing talents, changing equipment, summoning a pet (for certain classes) or when your bags change, the addon:
• Scans your character for supported healing spells, Healthstones, potions, food, drink, bandages and special items.…

Each ham.cooldownTalents entry must be in the newest build's talent tree

and on pull requests, so a red push shows up before a release. The

fails it, while unused values and line length stay with review.

embeds.xml and AceLocale's XML were CRLF, which scripted edits turned

While the client reports auras as hidden (C\_Secrets.ShouldAurasBeSecret: encounters, M+, PvP),

buff drinks (Argentleaf, Sanguithorn and Azeroot Tea) go first, ahead of

Besides Well Fed, Retail's Hearty Well Fed counts, found by its translated

whose name isn't Well Fed (Increased Stamina, Agility, Intellect and Spirit,

Auto Potion4.0.0 (2026-10-18)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Refresh only open settings pages' previews and build debug messages only in debug mode
A macro rebuild leaves the Current Priority preview of hidden settings pages alone; each page still refreshes its preview in OnShow, and an open page keeps following bag changes. The log calls that concatenate their message now check ham.debug first, so with debugging off an update builds no strings; with it on the messages are unchanged. The fake client can now close the settings panel, take slash commands and count icon lookups.
• Rebuild on gear changes only for tinker slots, and register only events the client knows
PLAYER\_EQUIPMENT\_CHANGED is registered on Retail only, where tinkers exist, and asks for a
macro update only when the changed slot is a tinker slot (head, wrist, gun; Trinket 2 too in
debug mode). A gear-set swap that touches no tinker slot no longer rebuilds the macros, and one
that does still rebuilds once. TRAIT\_CONFIG\_UPDATED is registered where
C\_EventUtils.IsEventValid says the client has it instead of by flavor flag, so Classic Era
now listens for it as well.
The fake client knows each flavor's valid events (tests/fake/events/, generated from the
client's API docs by update.sh there), rejects registering or firing any other, offers
C\_EventUtils.IsEventValid, can change gear (Client:equip) and counts C\_Item.GetItemCount
calls so tests can tell a rebuild happened.
Closes #145
• Follow bag changes once they settle and only the player's own pet
The macros are now requested on BAG\_UPDATE\_DELAYED instead of 3 seconds after the first
BAG\_UPDATE, so a looted or used-up item reaches them the frame after the bags settle, and a
burst of bag updates still leads to one rebuild. UNIT\_PET is registered for the player only,
so group members summoning or dismissing pets cause no work.
The fake client records unit filters from RegisterUnitEvent and delivers unit events
accordingly; addToBags fires BAG\_UPDATE\_DELAYED, changeBagsOverFrames models a burst over
several frames and learnSpell fires SPELLS\_CHANGED.
Closes #144
• Show the shared Current Priority preview on the Food, Drink, Bandage and Mana Potion pages
The four pages drop their copies of the preview code and fill the shared preview row with the
items of their list that are in the bags (PreviewRow:showItemsInBags). So their icons come from
C\_Item.GetItemIconByID and show with an empty item cache, sit at the position of their index
with no overlaps when the list grows or shrinks, and show the tooltip of the entry they hold now
through handlers set once. The scroll content always leaves room for the row below the title.
Tests cover each page on Retail, Classic Era and Forever. Refs #143.
• Show the main page's Current Priority preview with real icons and no overlaps
The preview is now a shared row (FrameXML/PreviewRow.lua) that the other settings pages can
reuse. Each icon's position comes from its index in the combined list, spells first, then

Changelog2.10Added
• Icons can fade in as they show up and fade out as they go, instead of popping. Set the time in seconds with Fade on the Options tab (0, none, to start with), and give a buff group or weapon enchant its own beside Icon size on the Buff groups tab. An icon fading out keeps its place until it's gone. Blizzard Auras icons, alerts and party reminders don't fade.
Changed
• The Buff groups tab has Icon size on its own row with Fade, and the options window is 30 pixels taller.
Fixed
• Clicking a weapon enchant icon could do nothing because a hidden game spell, ex: Opening - No Text, had been remembered as what you last put on the hand. Only items in your bags and spells in your spellbook are remembered now. A hand that already remembered one asks you to put the enchant on again.
• Clicking a weapon enchant icon could cast Stealth or another spell: one cast just after logging in, or just after a poison, was remembered instead of the poison. A poison, oil or stone you used now beats a spell, the enchant has to show up after the cast, and enchants you already had don't count as new after a loading screen or when the hand reads empty for a moment. If an icon casts the wrong thing, put the enchant on that hand again.
• With more than one of your spells in a buff group, ex: Lightning Shield and Water Shield, clicking the icon on Auto cast the first one, not the one you use. Auto now casts the buff you last had or cast, and the icon shows that buff too, also when you cast it in combat.
2.9Fixed
• A weapon enchant icon showing both the bag count and the charges left could read as one number, ex: 15 in your bags and 3 charges looked like "153". When the charges are showing, the bag count is now smaller and tinted blue.
2.8Added
• Icons that cast a spell when clicked show the global cooldown swipe, like an action button, so you can see when the next one can be clicked. Party reminder icons too.
• A chat warning when you cast a buff group's spell on yourself at a lower rank than you know (casts on low level players, which the game lowers by itself, don't count), ex: an action bar still holding the old rank after a visit to the trainer. The Cooldown Manager follows only your highest rank, so an old one can't be followed in combat. It warns once per rank each session.
Fixed
• A Cooldown Manager buff group, ex: Power Word: Fortitude, could show its icon in every fight while the buff was up. The manager's frame for the buff can stop following it, and a "gone" read from it was believed for the rest of the session once it had shown the buff up. Now that frame has to show the buff up in the same fight, and the rank it follows has to be the one last read on you. Otherwise the buff group is predicted.
2.7Added
• "Time left text" on the Options tab puts the time left on the icon, as before, or just above or below it. It applies to every icon, Blizzard Auras and alerts included, but not party reminders.
• "Combat badge" on the Options tab puts crossed swords in the bottom left corner of every icon while you're in combat, alerts included. Off by default.
Fixed
• An alert set to the Spell alert glow caused a "blocked by secret aspects" error. The game's spell alert can't be shown on Blizzard's aura button, so alerts no longer offer it, and ones set to it now Pulse.

addons.description:
A World of Warcraft: Forever addon that displays user placeable icons on your screen when buffs have expired or are soon to expire. Originally written for WoW 1.12 (Vanilla); the 1.12 version is on the master branch.
Combat behavior
WoW: Forever hides aura data from addons during combat, and the list of your buffs can't be read at all. Out of combat Buff Reminder reads every buff and records its expiration time. Each buff group has an In combat setting that picks how it's followed during a fight.

Cooldown Manager (the default). The buff group is checked once a second and on every aura change, using the best source available:

1. Direct lookup. The addon asks about each of the buff group's spells by id. The game still answers for spells it flags as never secret, so these buffs update live in combat: dropped, dispelled, refreshed, and stack counts. Buffs given by name are looked up by the spell id last seen on the aura, or by any rank of your own spell of that name.
2. Cooldown Manager. If the spell is secret but it's one of your class buffs tracked on the Cooldown Manager's buff bars or icons, and the Cooldown Manager is turned on, Buff Reminder reads whether that buff is active from the manager's frames. When the manager's remaining time is readable it's used for the countdown, otherwise the old expiration time is kept. The manager follows only one rank of some buffs, ex: Mark of the Wild rank 2 while you have rank 3, and then the buff group is predicted. The Buff groups tab says when that happens; use Blizzard Auras for those.
3. Prediction. Otherwise the buff group keeps the state it had when combat started. Its own timer runs from the expiration time recorded before the pull, so early warnings and expiry still show on time. Buffs lost or refreshed early aren't seen until combat ends.

If a buff group can only be predicted, because the Cooldown Manager isn't available for your class, is turned off, or doesn't track the buff, Buff Reminder says so in chat after you log in and on the Buff groups tab.

Blizzard Auras, for buffs the Cooldown Manager can't track, like a shaman's Lightning Shield. Blizzard's own aura button is placed over the buff group's icon and shows the buff with its exact time and stack count for the whole fight, with the count in red at or under the buff group's low stack warning. When the buff drops the button disappears and the reminder icon underneath shows. Addon code can't read what Blizzard's button shows, so in combat the buff group's icon is always shown, not only when the buff is missing or low. Use the buff group's conditions to limit when that is. The button is set up out of combat and needs the buff's spell id, which is known once you've had the buff or when you add it by id.

Casting a buff in combat. When you cast one of a buff group's buffs on yourself during a fight, the buff group is marked as up right away and its timer starts from the cast, using the buff's duration from the last time it was read out of combat. This works in either mode and doesn't need the aura to be readable. A buff that has never been read out of combat on this character has no known duration and waits for the sources above. A cast aimed at another player doesn't count. /obr debug prints what each cast of a buff group's buff decides, for when one isn't picked up.…

addons.description:
This is an addon for the popular MMORPG "World of Warcraft".
It can be downloaded at one of the following sites:
• CurseForge
• WoWInterface
• Wago
• GitHub
Description
When using spells and toys such as Wormhole Generator: Northrend you'd normally get a boring list of (sometimes obfuscated) destinations.

Instead of that, Interactive Wormholes displays these destinations as clickable portals on your world map.

Supported wormholes:
• Wormhole Generator: Quel'Thalas
• Wormhole Generator: Khaz Algar
• Wyrmhole Generator: Dragon Isles
• Wormhole Generator: Shadowlands
• Wormhole Generator: Northrend
• Including the "secret" 6th destination!
• Wormhole Centrifuge
• Reaves' Wormhole Generator module

Other spells and transportation methods:
• Taxi (optional, enable in settings)
• Hero's Path
• Shift-click dungeon entrances on the map to teleport
• Mole Machine (Dark Iron Dwarf racial)
• Amani Windcaller taxi system in Vaults of Atal'Utek
• Voidspire Teleport Pads
• Phase Diving in K'aresh
• Requires enabling Taxi option
• Undermine Rocketway
• Siren Isle
• Animaflow Teleporter in The Maw
• War Campaign footholds (Battle for Azeroth)
• Warfront Flightmasters
• Silas' Stone of Transportation (Battle for Azeroth)
• Stormflight (Warrior order hall)
• Manapoof (Pet Battle Dungeon teleporter in Dalaran)
• Vethir in Stormheim
• Underbelly portal network in Dalaran (Legion)
• Azshara Rocketway

Integrates with InFlight or TaxiTimer to display taxi flight durations/estimations.

addons.description:
The database Questie consumes. Stores entity data as WoW addon TOC metadata, readable at
runtime with no file I/O, and owns the offline generator that produces it.

Quests, NPCs, items and objects for Classic Era, TBC, Wrath, Cataclysm, Mists and Forever. Baked
artifacts include nine generated Base locales as compressed CBOR column blocks. Dynamic
Translation Corrections can also supply any custom non-English locale. Source and Baked modes
return the same base entity values.

Two modes, and the client picks
The client searches for flavour-suffixed TOCs first and falls back to QuestieDB.toc only if
none are found. That rule selects the mode at no cost: **a generated artifact wins simply by
existing.**

| | Source mode | Baked mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TOC | QuestieDB.toc (committed) | QuestieDB_Vanilla.toc etc. (generated, gitignored) |
| Reads resolve from | raw entity data | CBOR rows and tables in the TOC metadata store |
| Static Corrections | applied live | already folded in |
| Base translations | raw l10n/ lookups, client locale only | generated Localization blocks |
| Dynamic Translation Corrections | any active non-English locale | any active non-English locale |
| Requires | a clone and native per-file game-type selection | one bootstrap command, or local Generation |

On clients with native per-file game-type selection, a fresh clone needs no download or
Lua toolchain. Historical Interface metadata alone does not establish that support; older-client
Source acceptance and exact Camelot TOC recognition remain pending. See
Forever and client acceptance for the limited
mixed-token live-probe result and outstanding checks. Generation reads the owned localization
sources in l10n/ and needs no Questie checkout or network access. It fails before writing output if required lookup files are missing.
Use --no-l10n only for an intentional partial artifact.

For consumers
Start at docs/api.md. It is written so a third-party addon author needs no
source reading. Release zips also include LuaLS declarations under QuestieDB/Types; point the
consumer's workspace.library at that folder for completion and diagnostics.

Three behaviours to internalise before writing anything:
• Numeric getters return 0, never nil. Test ~= 0, not truthiness.
• Every table read returns a fresh, deeply independent copy you own. Mutate it freely;
the next read is unaffected, and CopyTable is wasted work. GetAllIds is the one
exception: it hands back a shared table, so treat that one as read-only.
• Non-English translations are authoritative for translatable fields. Publish translated
entity text through LibQuestieDB.l10n.SetCorrection, not an ordinary entity Correction.
The locale may be one of the nine generated locales or a custom non-English locale.

For contributors
There are two tiers of tooling. Correction work needs only a Lua interpreter, on any
operating system. The full validation and release toolchain adds Python.
Working on corrections
Corrections are maintained under src/corrections//. Their original format came
from Questie's Database/Corrections, and the
Questie wiki page on corrections still
applies. On clients supporting native file selection, a clone junctioned or symlinked into
Interface/AddOns runs your edits live in Source mode; nothing needs generating for that.
Generation produces the Baked artifact and lets you run offline checks against your change.

For available field names and their meanings, read the commented keys tables in:
• src/meta/questMeta.lua: QuestieDB.questKeys
• src/meta/npcMeta.lua: QuestieDB.npcKeys
• src/meta/itemMeta.lua: QuestieDB.itemKeys
• src/meta/objectMeta.lua: QuestieDB.objectKeys

Correction providers receive authoring views derived from these schema keys through
QuestieLoader:ImportModule("QuestieDB"). Keep using names such as questKeys.requiredLevel;
there is no separate field-key definition to maintain or schema file to load inside a correction.…

addons.description:
AutoGear is a World Of Warcraft addon that automatically rolls on and equips loot according to stat weights like WoWhead filters. AutoGear rolls "need" on upgrades and "greed" otherwise.

AutoGear also optionally interacts with quest NPCs, automatically accepting and completing quests, including deciding the best quest reward based on the same stat weights. If no item is deemed to be an upgrade, the item worth the most vendor gold is chosen.

Included in AutoGear are default stat weights for all specs of all classes. Using these weights, AutoGear will roll "need" on better loot and equip it for you when it can.

Stat weights work like the advanced filter on WoWhead. For example, if you specify that 1 point of strength is worth 1 point and 1 point of crit is worth 0.5 points, an item with 5 strength and 3 crit will be worth 6.5 points. That item might then replace an item in the same slot with 3 strength and 2 crit, worth 4 points. If the first item was presented in a loot roll, AutoGear would roll "need" and if you won the roll, it would equip the new item as soon as it could.

The default stat weights may not be what you prefer. If you want to change them, stat weights for all classes and specs can be found in the "SetStatWeights()" function in "[wow]\Interface\AddOns\AutoGear\AutoGear.lua". Simply edit the numbers there, save the file, and type "/run ReloadUI()" to update. A GUI for setting stat weights would be nice, but the authors haven't been motivated to make one yet. Code patches are welcome. This includes improvements to AutoGear's current stat weights, which sometimes need updating due to WoW class balance changes.

If you receive an upgrade mid-combat, AutoGear queues the upgrade to be equipped when combat ends. It used to equip weapon upgrades immediately because weapons could be changed in combat, but due to addons that automated weapon swaps in combat for DPS at maximum level, Blizzard now prevents addons from swapping weapons in combat automatically. You can still equip them manually earlier than AutoGear can if you notice you've received a weapon upgrade.
WoW Forever
AutoGear also runs on WoW Forever (interface 16001).
• Forever has one specialization per class, so AutoGear uses the general class profile (None). If you heal, tank, or want a more focused damage profile, enable Override specialization in /ag and choose the closest profile. Healers should do this, because the general profile values bonus healing only as spell damage (one third of its value).
• Forever's combined hit and critical strike, expertise, and armor/spell penetration are read from item tooltips.
• On Forever, Use Pawn and Roll on non-gear loot default to off; Pawn has no Forever scales yet.
• Loot messages and tooltip text can be restricted (secret values) in dungeons and during encounters. AutoGear then scans your bags instead of reading the loot message, and treats items it can't read as not evaluable.

Chat commands:

Warning: AutoGear currently automatically rolls "greed" on everything that isn't a gear upgrade for the current spec, including mounts and crafting reagents. It works quite well for leveling quickly and conveniently, but you should disable it before loot rolls you want control over. To do so, simply run "/ag toggle" or toggle it from the options menu.

Warning: AutoGear is not recommended for use at max level. Its weights are not optimal, nor are stat weights ideal for determining upgrades in end-game content. AutoGear is meant primarily as a convenience for leveling quickly. Using it at max level, especially in team PvE or PvP, is likely to get you kicked from various groups and guilds. Calculating proper upgrades using SimulationCraft is preferable. This will be very time-consuming, but worth it for your powerful max-level character.

Full Changelog Previous Releases

• add midnight toc version for any future comparisons

AutoGear2026-10-09-release (2026-10-10)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• remove WoW-Forever-specific toc file to simplify releases; TaintLess is harmless to load and still useful for older client versions
• use modern dropdowns
• toc updates
• docs: describe WoW Forever support
• fix: allow guild bank repairs on WoW Forever
• fix: stop using APIs that need deprecation fallbacks
getglobal and IsSpellKnown only exist with the loadDeprecationFallbacks CVar on modern clients.
• fix: open the options by category ID and not in combat
Opening the settings panel is restricted in combat on modern clients; the title lookup broke when the TOC title differed.
• build: add a WoW Forever TOC without TaintLess
TaintLess treats Forever as Classic (16001 < 11e4) and hooks the Mainline UIDropDownMenu, which Forever's UI hardly uses.
• fix: handle secret loot messages and tooltip text
Under the Midnight addon restrictions (Retail 12, WoW Forever) CHAT\_MSG\_LOOT text is secret in dungeons, raids and encounters, so scan the bags instead of matching it.
• fix: only turn in a quest once a reward was chosen
• feat: localize the options window and add German
• feat: group the options window into tabs
Each option names its tab and optional section; options without a tab land in an Other tab.
• fix: scan for upgrades after closing a merchant and on level-up
Purchases produce no CHAT\_MSG\_LOOT, and level requirements can unlock items without any loot event.
• feat: turn off Pawn and non-gear rolls by default on WoW Forever
Pawn has no Forever scales yet.
• feat: use the general class profile on WoW Forever
Forever has one specialization per class and no GetTalentTabInfo, so the pre-MoP detection errors there.
• feat: parse WoW Forever item stats
Forever combines melee, ranged and spell hit and crit, has expertise and penetration, and counts bonus healing as one third spell damage (rule taken from the community repost).
• fix: read right tooltip text and ignore armor penetration as armor
Tooltip data lines name the field rightText (TooltipDataHandler.lua); textRight was always nil.
• feat: detect WoW Forever
WoW Forever runs the Mainline API but reports interface 16001, so the TOC version alone can't tell which API family is present. Also guard two load-time calls that don't exist there.

Add stylized 2D portraits to supported World of Warcraft unit frames with flexible positioning,
class icons, overlay textures, and shareable profiles.

CurseForge
|
Bug Reports
|
Feature Requests
|
Discord

Overview
Blinkiis Portraits is a lightweight customization addon that adds portrait elements to popular
unit frame addons. It is built for players who want their UI to feel more
personal, more readable, and a lot less generic.

The addon can automatically detect compatible unit frames or let you choose the parent frame
manually per unit type. Once attached, each portrait can be customized independently.
Highlights
• Supports portraits for player, target, focus, target of target, pet, party, boss, and arena where the selected frame addon provides those unit frames.
• Works with multiple unit frame.
• Includes a broad portrait style library with classic, geometric, mirrored, and decorative shapes.
• Adds optional extra textures for rare, elite, boss, and player states.
• Supports class icon display with multiple built-in styles and custom class icon packs.
• Lets you use custom portrait textures, masks, and extra masks from your own files.
• Offers per-unit settings for size, anchor point, layer, frame level, mirroring, cast icon display, and color behavior.
• Includes profile export/import so setups can be backed up and shared.
• Ships with localization files for multiple languages.

addons.description:
WoW addon for retail and classic

This addon provides a simple list where you can view and store all your to-do's,
and everything can be sorted as daily or weekly, in which case it will reset automatically when the time comes!
You also have the possibility to favorite / add descriptions on items, and even create custom tabs with custom resets.

You can also switch to a clear theme. It’s just a visual style, so feel free to choose it if you prefer the look!

If you are having any problems, type /tdl help to print help in the chat, it will surely give you the answers you are looking for.
How to toggle:
• Minimap button (the default)
• Key binding
• Databroker plugin
• Normal button that you can place anywhere on your screen
• The "/tdl" chat command
Ny's To-Do List Backup
The download also includes a second addon, a backup manager.
You can toggle the backup list either by going into the addon options, or by using the "/tdlb" chat command.

This backup list allows you to create and restore backups whenever you want, and it also has an automatic backup section.

Backups add a layer of protection in case something goes wrong with Ny's To-Do List, but don't forget to also back up your saved variables folder from time to time!
Feedback
Please report any bugs (with error messages if possible) through an issue on GitHub.

You can also visit the addon's page on CurseForge to give direct feedback.

addons.changelog:
NeverQuestAlone is the quest companion for World of Warcraft®: Forever. It sits by your quest tracker, picks your next quests, draws the route on your map and helps you track things down. Ask it anything in a chat window inside the game ("where do I turn this in?", "what should I do next?") and the reply shows up right there. It knows your character and quests, runs on the AI you pick, and never plays for you: no key presses, no clicks, nothing posted to chat.
What's new in 1.4.19
• Quest chains on the HUD. A quest that leads somewhere worthwhile now says so right in the HUD's list, not only on the quest page: "Leads to The Deadmines · step 1 of 7", with the dungeon's or the reward's icon.
• Local models that think work better. Under Other, qwen3 and gpt-oss on Ollama answer without spending the whole reply thinking, and a model that thinks longer gets more room instead of "couldn't finish a reply".
• From 1.4.18: NeverQuestAlone is open source. The whole app and addon are at github.com/tommygeoco/neverquestalone.
Get started with the app
1. Download and open it. Mac: open NeverQuestAlone-mac.dmg and drag NeverQuestAlone to Applications, then open it. Windows: open NeverQuestAlone-Setup.exe; it installs and opens by itself.
2. Connect your AI. Pick Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or Gemini (or Other, for any OpenAI-compatible service or a model on your own computer or home network), copy your API key from that company's site and paste it in the app. The app tests it and saves it in your macOS Keychain (Credential Manager on Windows).
3. Set up WoW. Click Install to add the addon (on a Mac, also click Allow for Screen Recording). Start WoW, or restart it if it was already open. At character select, click AddOns and check NeverQuestAlone, then log in. When NeverQuestAlone shows up by your quests, you're set.

Already on 1.2.0 or later? The app tells you 1.4.19 is ready: open About and click Download, and it installs when you quit. From 1.4.9 on, updates install by themselves.
Windows: signed
The Windows installer is signed, like the Mac app (signed and notarized by Apple). While its new certificate builds trust, Windows may still show "Windows protected your PC" the first time you open it: click More info, then Run anyway.
Only the addon: Copy and Paste
No app, no key, any AI you already use. Unzip NeverQuestAlone-addon.zip into the Interface/AddOns folder inside your World of Warcraft forever folder and start the game. Each message you send opens a small window: copy it into ChatGPT, Claude or any other AI, then paste its reply back, and it shows in game. Type /nqa app for the app's link whenever you want to skip the copying.
Downloads
| File | For |
|---|---|
| NeverQuestAlone-mac.dmg | Mac, macOS 14 or later (Apple silicon and Intel), signed and notarized |
| NeverQuestAlone-Setup.exe | Windows 10 or 11, signed |
| NeverQuestAlone-addon.zip | The addon only, for Copy and Paste |

The other files are for automatic updates. To check a download, compare its SHA-256 with SHA256SUMS.txt.
Privacy and cost
Your key stays on your computer and goes only to your AI company; there's no NeverQuestAlone account, server or subscription, and by default your character's name, realm and guild stay out of what's sent.
You pay your AI company directly for what you use (a typical day of play is about $0.29–1.22 on each AI's default model, its thinking included; on Claude's default, $5 of credit lasts 4 to 7 days, and the app shows what a day costs on every model), and you can set a daily spend limit in the app.

Not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment. World of Warcraft is a trademark of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.

• NeverQuestAlone-addon.zip
addons.description:
Always know where to go next. NeverQuestAlone is a free, open-source quest companion for World of Warcraft®: Forever. It sits by your quest tracker, plans your quests and redraws your route on the map as you play. It runs on the AI you pick: Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or Gemini with your own API key, another OpenAI-compatible service, or a model on your own computer.

Download for Mac · Download for Windows · All downloads
What it does
• Your next stop is always on screen. How far it is, and what to do when you get there.
• Your map always shows the best route. Every stop in your quest log, in the best order, on the map and minimap.
• Ask when you’re stuck. Type a question in game and get a waypoint or clear directions.
• Less clicking, if you want it. Quality-of-life options like Auto Accept Quests and Auto Sell Junk finish what you start: talk to a quest giver and the quest is accepted; open a vendor and your gray items are sold. They’re off until you turn them on.

It never plays for you. No key presses or mouse clicks, no memory reading, nothing posted to chat. The AI can only write replies in the chat window and routes and pins on your map, which the app checks first.

Free, no account, no tracking. You pay your AI company only for what you use.

> Unofficial. NeverQuestAlone isn’t made, reviewed or endorsed by Blizzard. How it works explains exactly what it does.
Set up in three steps
It takes 2–3 minutes once you have an API key. You need:
• World of Warcraft: Forever, in Windowed or Windowed (Fullscreen) mode, with Enable Sound on in its sound settings.
• macOS 14 or later, or Windows 10 or 11.
• An API key for the AI you want, with a few dollars of credit. What’s an API key?
1 Download
Download NeverQuestAlone for Mac or Windows.
• Mac: open the .dmg, drag NeverQuestAlone to Applications and open it from there. If macOS asks whether you’re sure, click Open.
• Windows: open NeverQuestAlone-Setup.exe. It installs and opens by itself. If Windows says “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway.
2 Connect your AI
1. Pick an AI, like Claude.
2. Click Open Anthropic’s key page, make a key and copy it. Add a few dollars of credit there too.
3. Click Paste Anthropic key, then Agree and connect. The app tests the key and saves it in your macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager.
4. Click Continue.

The buttons name the company behind the AI you picked: Anthropic for Claude, OpenAI for ChatGPT, xAI for Grok and Google for Gemini.

Using another service, or a model on your own computer? Pick Other, click Connect another AI, fill in its address (Base URL), key and model, and click Connect.

The defaults send the least that works: your character’s name, realm and guild stay out, and other players’ names are swapped for stand-ins. Change them later on the app’s Your data and Settings pages.
3 Set up WoW
1. Install the addon. Click Install. If WoW is open, click Install when WoW closes instead: new addons only load when the game starts.
2. Allow Screen Recording (Mac only). Click Allow, then Open System Settings in the macOS box, and turn on NeverQuestAlone. The app only reads the top of the game window, where the addon draws.
3. Turn on the addon. Start WoW (if it was open while the addon installed, quit it and start it again). At character select, click AddOns and make sure NeverQuestAlone is checked, then log in. NeverQuestAlone shows up beside your quest tracker, and you’re set.

NeverQuestAlone lives in your menu bar (on Windows, the system tray by the clock).

No app? The addon also works on its own with Copy and Paste: you copy each message into any AI chat and paste the reply back. Download NeverQuestAlone-addon.zip from the releases page and unzip it into the Interface/AddOns folder inside your World of Warcraft forever folder.
What it costs
The app is free, and NeverQuestAlone sets no limits of its own. You pay your AI company for what you use.

| AI | What you need | Cost |
|---|---|---|…

addons.changelog:
Battlefield Info is now Waymark. Same addon, new name. Your settings, ink, notes, setups and key bindings come along by themselves.

The download now has two folders: Waymark (the addon) and BattlefieldInfo (a small helper that carries your old settings over). The CurseForge app installs both. If you install by hand, extract both into Interface\AddOns; the helper replaces the old BattlefieldInfo folder's contents. Once each of your characters has logged in with Waymark, the helper can be deleted (it is safe to keep). /waymark opens the settings; /bfi still works. If you kept an old copy of Battlefield Info as well, Waymark turns it off for you and asks for a /reload.

This release is for WoW Forever.

New
• The found notebook: an old wanderer's dungeon notes, with maps, routes and warnings, reached from the dungeon doors and the map's quill button. Write in it and draw on its maps yourself.
• Map ink: a quill to draw your own marks, routes and notes on any zone or dungeon map.
• Dungeon maps for every classic dungeon: bosses you can number and reorder, doors, chests and switches, quest monsters, and a light that guesses where you are inside from the monsters you meet.
• Caves: quest pins and objective spots inside caves, a floor bar for caves with several levels, and a right-click out to the zone.
• The continent map: zone maps joined into one painted continent, with coasts, seas and fading names.
• Quest ground: objective areas drawn on the map, coloured by quest type; hover for the quest, right-click for its menu, arrows to lone spots and turn-ins.
• Quest window: rewards and drop chances, a "Looking at" section for quests you don't have, one row per quest on givers with several, Shift-click links and Ctrl-click try-ons.
• Quest progress on the game's own tooltips, and giver tooltips with each quest's kind in its colour (or Questie's tooltip, if you prefer).
• Rares and chests from our own data, with their drops behind Shift; boss loot in a "What they carry" window.
• Vendors and trainers: what they sell and what they teach.
• "What you've learned": quest givers and monster spots learned as you play, shareable as a string.
• Start here: presets that set up the whole map in one click (Creator's, Purist, Minimap Replacement, Minimalist), "(altered)" when you change one, and presets of your own.
• Quick options panel beside the map; toggle buttons for quest areas and the quill; lock the map in place.
• The big map key opens and closes the map; the map stays open through zone changes and reloads, and holds still on a flight path while you browse.

Changes
• Auto-zoom is off by default; its button is now "Keep centered".
• Clearer settings: plain words, pages that read top to bottom, a welcome page.
• One set of controls everywhere: left-click acts, right-click gives a menu, hold to move.

Fixes and polish
• Quest-provider chat spam on Classic Era gone.
• Duplicate key binding warnings gone.
• Many smaller tooltip, tracker and docked-minimap fixes.
addons.description:
Formerly Battlefield Info.

The small Battlefield Map, turned into the map you actually play with.

Waymark builds on the game's own Battlefield Map (Shift-M): the small map you can keep open while you play. It adds quests, townsfolk, rares, gathering nodes and exploration to it, and lets you size, zoom and style it however you like. It's an exploration aid in the classic spirit: it shows you the world and leaves the route to you.
On the map
• Quests: quest givers, turn-ins and objective spots, plus the game's own objectives and quest areas. Quests you pick up from givers the database doesn't know about are learned as you play.
• Quest tracker and quest window: a tracker attached to the map, sorted by distance, level or area, and a full quest log.
• Towns and cities: Townsfolk and an automated system for switching between town-view, city-view and cave-view. Changes made in either context is kept to that context.
• Rares and treasures (with RareScanner), gathering nodes (with GatherMate2)
• Dungeons and caves: dungeon entrances on the world, a dungeon's own map while you're inside, and cave maps either art or minimap detail when youre inside.
• Exploration: show unexpored in different styles you want
• Your group: party and raid members in class colours, a line to your target (friendlies only).
The map itself
• Resize it, move it, zoom it in and out, and switch to a large mode.
• Close-up detail when you zoom in near. (or at any zoom if you choose)
• Zoom out for continent view, seamless.
• Header and border styles to choose from: classic plate, parchment, leather, stone, gold, wood and more.
• Every layer has its own switch, opacity and size, and a row of toggle buttons on the map that you pick and order yourself.
• Context profiles: different layers in combat, battlegrounds, dungeons, towns or while gathering, or hide the map there.
• Saved setups: keep several complete setups and switch between them; each character can use its own.
• Key bindings also!
•

addons.description:
(screen)-shotta, mate. Automatically take screenshots of your best moments in
Azeroth so you can keep them forever.
Shotta Discord
Join the Shotta Discord server to share your
best screenshots, suggest features, or just chat.
Features
Shotta takes screenshots for you automatically, so the moments worth keeping
are saved without you thinking about it. Each event can be toggled on its own:
• levelling up, quest completions and reputation/renown gains
• achievements, loot rolls and hearthstone binds
• boss kills, including first kills and raid encounters
• entering a new zone or area
• ready checks, trade windows and group formation
• emotes, mailboxes, auction houses and chat channels
• death
• on a timer: every 5, 10 or 30 minutes

Screenshots include the interface by default. You can also take one on demand
from the minimap button: click it for a screenshot without the UI, or
control-click it to include the UI.

Every library is embedded, so there is nothing else to install. New events are
added regularly and suggestions are very welcome via GitHub issues or Discord.

Shotta supports Retail, Forever, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Classic Era, and
Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary.

Screenshots are saved to the Screenshots folder inside the game installation
for the client you are playing:

| Client | Folder |
| --- | --- |
| Retail | retail/Screenshots |
| Forever | camelot/Screenshots |
| Mists of Pandaria Classic | classic/Screenshots |
| Classic Era | _classic_era_/Screenshots |
| Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary | anniversary/Screenshots |

On Windows these live under C:\Program Files (x86)\World of Warcraft\, and on
macOS under /Applications/World of Warcraft/.

4.2
On World of Warcraft: Forever, a party member set as a custom target now takes. Until now chat said it was set, but it was not.

On World of Warcraft: Forever, Dispel is now two actions. A Dispel action now shows as Dispel: Curse, Disease, and Dispel: Magic, Poison is new. Both work on a Druid, Priest, Shaman or Paladin; a Mage has only Dispel: Curse, Disease. Where a class has two spells for one dispel, the higher-level one is cast once you know it.

A key where no action runs can go back to WoW, if you want it to. Set When no action runs under Keys Given Back in Debind's settings to Key is given back, and the key then does what WoW or another addon has on it, as it did before 4.0. It starts on Press does nothing, which is what every key has done since 4.0.

Keys given back can follow a change sooner. A key that is given back, or runs a WoW Binding, only in some situations can still do what it did before a change for up to 0.2 seconds after it. This can happen with When no action runs set to Key is given back, or on a key with a Give Key Back or WoW Binding action. Lowering State Driver Interval, under Miscellaneous in Debind's settings, shortens that delay, down to one frame at 0. The value belongs to Blizzard's state driver, which other addons use too, so a lower value makes theirs update more often as well and costs more CPU. With no such key, the slider changes nothing.

Hover Cast has no Off, and a press while you point at a unit follows the order on screen. It tries a key's actions in the order the Overview tab shows. An action that was on Off is now on Cast on the usual target, so one standing above an action set to Cast on the unit you point at now takes that press; set it to Skip this action to pass it on. One that was on Off with Normal Cast unticked is now on Skip this action. As set it never runs, so it is marked Needs checking.

Mouse buttons other than left and right click run on unit frames. An action on one of them now runs when you click a unit frame with that button, and goes where its Hover Cast row sends it. To leave that click to the frame as before, set it to Skip this action.

During a pet battle, an Action Button action does what WoW's own keybinding for that button does. Action Button 1 to 5 press the battle's buttons, and 6 to 12 do nothing. Until now it pressed that slot of your main action bar.

An Action Button action whose slot holds a flyout opens it at the cursor, as a Flyout action does. It used to open on that slot's button on WoW's action bar, so with a bar addon that hides WoW's bars it showed nothing and left that addon's button raising an error.

Two new actions: Give Key Back and WoW Binding. Give Key Back, in the Special tab of Add an action, gives the key back when it runs. WoW Binding, in the WoW Bindings tab, runs one of WoW's own keybindings. A Use WoW's Own Binding or Binding Command left over from before 4.0 is now a Nothing action, which is what it has done since 4.0.

The Commands tab of Add an action is now WoW Bindings, and holds only WoW's own keybindings. Targeting, focus, the unit menu, world markers and the Action Button rows moved to the Special tab.

A share code made by 4.2 cannot be pasted into 4.1.2 or earlier, which answer that it was made by a newer version of Debind. Share codes made by earlier versions still paste into 4.2.
4.1.2
On World of Warcraft: Forever, spells you have not learned yet can be given a key now. Talking to a class trainer adds the spells that trainer can teach to an Unlearned group in the spell list. With Unavailable checked in the trainer window's filters, the spells you cannot learn yet are added as well. The group's tooltip says the same.
4.1.1

addons.description:
Supports Retail and World of Warcraft: Forever.

Set a key once, for every character you have. Override it on one class, one spec, or a single alt — and only that key changes.

A key in Debind goes straight to a spell, an item, or a macro — no action bar slot involved — and the layers decide which characters it covers. Whatever you already bound in WoW's own keybinding window stays exactly where it is, and stays there if you ever remove Debind.
The problem
Roll an alt of a class you already play and you lay its bars out like the others. Some of those spells are on the bar because you want to watch the cooldown. The rest are on the bar because that's where the keybind is. 3 doesn't mean Judgment. 3 means the third button on the first bar, and Judgment happens to be standing there.

Addons have been putting spells on keys without a bar slot for years. None of them answer the next question:

Which characters is this key for?

Most of your binds are the same on every character. Some belong to one class. A few to one spec, one or two to a single character. WoW's own switch is all-or-nothing — the whole set shared, or the whole set per-character — and all-or-nothing has no way to say that. Go character-specific and every key that was the same everywhere now has to be set everywhere — the chore you were trying to avoid, times your alt count.

And "which character" isn't the only question a key has. The same key can want one thing in combat and another out of it, one thing on the frame under your mouse and another anywhere else. That part you already know — it's why you ran out of modifier keys, and why the macro got too long.

So the binds have to be layered, and one key has to be able to mean more than one thing.
What you get
• Layers, not profiles. account → class → spec → this character → that character's spec. The narrowest layer holding that key wins; the rest keep every other key. Nothing to switch by hand — the layers follow your character and spec.
• @healer and @tank that actually work. WoW has no idea what a healer is; Debind does. Pick Healer as an action's target and you're done — no macro. And where you do want one, /cast @healer,exists Innervate is one line.
• Conditions on any key. In combat, in a form, in a party or a raid, while some unit exists — re-checked as they change.
• Click casting built in. A key can go to the unit you point at, so one key heals off the raid frames and stays a normal key everywhere else. Unit frame addons work with it whether or not they support Clique, and Clique itself can run alongside.
• Flip what a key does mid-fight. Switches of your own, usable in combat, without spending a real modifier.

Debind is for the keys where the answer isn't "all of them." Put in the ones you want now — every other key goes on working exactly as it did.
Layers
| Where a key can come from | Who it applies to |
|---|---|
| Character / Specialization | this character, in this spec |
| Character / Class | this character |
| Account / Specialization | every Druid you own, while Balance |
| Account / Class | every Druid you own |
| Account / General | every character on the account |

A layer holds only the keys you put in it — never a whole keyboard. So the question is asked one key at a time: for this key, which rows have something to say?

The narrowest row that fits wins. A row whose conditions don't hold has nothing to say this time, so the key carries on to the next row that does, and if none of them do, by default it does whatever it would do without Debind. Nothing is switched off on the way: the rows below are still answering for every other key.…

4.2
On World of Warcraft: Forever, a party member set as a custom target now takes. Until now chat said it was set, but it was not.

On World of Warcraft: Forever, Dispel is now two actions. A Dispel action now shows as Dispel: Curse, Disease, and Dispel: Magic, Poison is new. Both work on a Druid, Priest, Shaman or Paladin; a Mage has only Dispel: Curse, Disease. Where a class has two spells for one dispel, the higher-level one is cast once you know it.

A key where no action runs can go back to WoW, if you want it to. Set When no action runs under Keys Given Back in Debind's settings to Key is given back, and the key then does what WoW or another addon has on it, as it did before 4.0. It starts on Press does nothing, which is what every key has done since 4.0.

Keys given back can follow a change sooner. A key that is given back, or runs a WoW Binding, only in some situations can still do what it did before a change for up to 0.2 seconds after it. This can happen with When no action runs set to Key is given back, or on a key with a Give Key Back or WoW Binding action. Lowering State Driver Interval, under Miscellaneous in Debind's settings, shortens that delay, down to one frame at 0. The value belongs to Blizzard's state driver, which other addons use too, so a lower value makes theirs update more often as well and costs more CPU. With no such key, the slider changes nothing.

Hover Cast has no Off, and a press while you point at a unit follows the order on screen. It tries a key's actions in the order the Overview tab shows. An action that was on Off is now on Cast on the usual target, so one standing above an action set to Cast on the unit you point at now takes that press; set it to Skip this action to pass it on. One that was on Off with Normal Cast unticked is now on Skip this action. As set it never runs, so it is marked Needs checking.

Mouse buttons other than left and right click run on unit frames. An action on one of them now runs when you click a unit frame with that button, and goes where its Hover Cast row sends it. To leave that click to the frame as before, set it to Skip this action.

During a pet battle, an Action Button action does what WoW's own keybinding for that button does. Action Button 1 to 5 press the battle's buttons, and 6 to 12 do nothing. Until now it pressed that slot of your main action bar.

An Action Button action whose slot holds a flyout opens it at the cursor, as a Flyout action does. It used to open on that slot's button on WoW's action bar, so with a bar addon that hides WoW's bars it showed nothing and left that addon's button raising an error.

Two new actions: Give Key Back and WoW Binding. Give Key Back, in the Special tab of Add an action, gives the key back when it runs. WoW Binding, in the WoW Bindings tab, runs one of WoW's own keybindings. A Use WoW's Own Binding or Binding Command left over from before 4.0 is now a Nothing action, which is what it has done since 4.0.

The Commands tab of Add an action is now WoW Bindings, and holds only WoW's own keybindings. Targeting, focus, the unit menu, world markers and the Action Button rows moved to the Special tab.

A share code made by 4.2 cannot be pasted into 4.1.2 or earlier, which answer that it was made by a newer version of Debind. Share codes made by earlier versions still paste into 4.2.

4.0
Each action now says what it does on each kind of press, under Cast Options in its right-click menu. The Self Cast Key and Focus Cast Key rows each take Cast on yourself, or on your focus, Cast on the usual target, or Skip this action, which hands that press to the next action on the key. Hover Cast is a row of the same shape for the unit you point at, and Normal Cast covers a press with no key held. So one key can carry one action for a held key and a different one for a plain press. Several actions can be set at once.

Hover casting is set on each action now, and it starts off. It takes the place of the Unit Frame condition, and everything you set up under that condition does what it did before. The one exception is an action whose Unit Frame condition had more conditions with it, placed below one on the same key that had the Unit Frame condition alone: it never ran before, and now it runs when its conditions are met. Debind's settings now hold only which units count as pointed at, Unit Frames or Mouseover; an action can name a mode of its own instead.

A target picked under Target is where the action goes, on every press that runs it. Holding the Self Cast Key or the Focus Cast Key does not move it: the action takes that press and still goes to its own unit. Neither does the unit you are pointing at. And Auto Self Cast does not send a friendly spell back to you when the unit you picked cannot take it; the action simply does not go out. That last one used to depend on the unit: a friendly spell aimed at your target came back to you while you had a target and did nothing at all while you had none. Disable under Target hands the decision back to the game, and the menu says so on every entry.

The game's own Mouseover Cast does not apply to Debind keys. Pointing at a unit is Hover Cast, which each action turns on for itself.…

WoW: Forever
This version adds initial support for WoW: Forever!

• Added multiple new CVars.
• Added Trade (Local) to Chat Channel Manager for WoW: Forever.
Additional Changes
• Updated Simplified Chinese translations by nanjuekaien1, thank you!
• Switched Profile and Graphics Import/Export settings to use Blizz's own Encoding/Decoding functions.
• Most Chat Window Settings will now only be changed if needed, instead upon every addon settings load. This is a test to try and prevent taint in Mythic+/Boss Encounters.
• Numerous fixes and improvements submitted by Erdmann5150, thank you!

• A prompt will appear asking you to reload when required.
addons.description:
An addon for World of Warcraft!
About
This QOL addon synchronizes various Blizzard Interface Settings that are normally character specific and applies them to all of your characters on your account automatically, including brand new characters.

The addon can synchronise the following, and you can disable any that you'd rather keep character specific:
• Combat
• Action Targeting Settings
• Assisted Highlight Setting
• Auto Loot Settings
• Empowered Spell Input Setting
• Loss of Control Settings
• Mouseover Cast Setting
• Self Cast Setting
• Misc. Combat Settings
• Unit Frames & Nameplates
• Arena Frame Settings
• Nameplate Settings
• Party/Raid Frame Settings
• HUD & Interface
• Calendar Filter Settings
• Camera Settings
• Cooldown Manager Visibility Setting
• Chosen Edit Mode Layout
• Damage Meter Settings
• External Defensives Visibility Setting
• Gamepad Settings
• Minimap Settings
• Spell Overlay Settings
• Viewed Tutorial Tooltips
• Visible Action Bars
• World Map Settings
• Zone Map (Shift-M) Settings
• Misc. UI Settings
• Social
• Block Channel Invite Setting
• Block Guild Invite Setting
• Block Neighborhood Invite Setting
• Block Trade Request Setting
• Chat Window Settings
• Chat Position/Size Settings
• Custom Chat Channels
• Location Visibility Setting
• System
• Graphics Settings
• Audio Settings
• Modifier Keybinds
• Experimental (Togglable in Advanced Options)
• Bag Organisation Settings
Additional Functionality
• Profile Support - Save and switch between multiple Interface configurations
• Profile Import/Export - Share your profile as a text string with others online, or import a profile string that has been shared with you
• Graphics & Audio Settings Import/Export - Export your system settings from one WoW client and import into another
• Force Leave/Join Blizzard Chat Channels - Never see Services spam on any character again, or perhaps always make them join Trade Chat?
• Screen Resolution Specific Settings - Useful for users who sync addon settings across multiple PCs, enable in Advanced Settings
• Custom CVar Support - Enter your own additional list of CVars to synchronise across characters, enable in Advanced Settings
Compatibility
• Midnight - 12.1.5
• MoP Classic - 5.5.4
• TBC Classic - 2.5.6
• Forever - 1.60.1
• Classic Era - 1.15.9

Changelog
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on Keep a Changelog,
and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.
[Unreleased][2.3.0] - 2026-10-14
Stable release of 2.3.0-beta1: no code changes since the beta (the entries below are the release content).

Verified in game on this build: the M1 Part D regression pass (docs/M1_SESSION_SCRIPT.md) - the event reason argument, the single-frame dispatch, the target-change STOP, the WoW: Forever target registration and the Unit:Reschedule pause-resume fix - and the duplicate-dispatch two-copy test (an addon embedding MINOR 37 loaded together with this build).

Known unverified in this release: the WoW: Forever Multi-Shot / Aimed Shot no-reset (UNIT_SPELLCAST_START behavior, melee cadence across the cast) and the Rapid Fire mid-swing rescale (whether the engine rescales the in-flight swing at all, and the factor, 1.40 vs 1.41) - no in-game capture yet. Capture plan: docs/M1_SESSION_SCRIPT.md B8.
[2.3.0-beta1] - 2026-10-14
Known unverified in this build: the WoW: Forever entries below - no in-game capture yet. Multi-Shot / Aimed Shot no-reset: UNIT_SPELLCAST_START behavior, melee cadence across the cast. Rapid Fire: whether the engine rescales the in-flight swing at all, and the factor (1.40 vs 1.41). Capture plan: docs/M1_SESSION_SCRIPT.md B8. The event reason argument, the single-frame dispatch, the target-change STOP, the Forever target registration and the Unit:Reschedule helper below: no in-game pass on any client yet (luajit -bl syntax check only); the duplicate-dispatch fix wants a two-copy test (an addon embedding MINOR 37 loaded together with this build). Regression plan: docs/M1_SESSION_SCRIPT.md Part D.
Added
• reason argument on UNIT_SWING_TIMER_START / UNIT_SWING_TIMER_UPDATE and their legacy SWING_TIMER_* variants (all clients), appended after hand so existing consumers are unaffected. START: "swing" (a swing seen by the game), "reset", "clip", "attack"; UPDATE: "haste", "parry", "pause", "autoshot", "movement". On WoW: Forever this tells consumers which starts come from the game's own PLAYER_SWING ("swing") and which are the library's reconstruction.
• Rapid Fire (3045) mid-swing haste on WoW: Forever: the cast now rescales the in-flight main-hand, off-hand and ranged swings by 1.4 (Wowhead Forever lists +41%, the forever-hunter wiki +40%), through the dynamic-haste path Slice and Dice uses. ApplyDynamicHaste gains an optional ranged factor, fed from a new dynamic_ranged_haste_spells table, so the Slice and Dice rescale keeps leaving ranged alone. The rescale is not undone when the buff fades; the next swing re-anchors on its true speed, as with Slice and Dice. Classic flavors unchanged (they rescale ranged via UNIT_ATTACK_SPEED).
Changed
• Internal: every in-flight swing reschedule (parry haste, haste rescale, pause resume, Auto Shot cast window, movement delay) goes through one Unit:Reschedule helper (all clients). Behavior is unchanged except that a pause resume now cancels the hand's existing timer before arming the new one, so a swing that started during the pause can no longer leave two timers (and two STOPs) behind. Needs a regression pass on Classic Era and on a client with pause spells (Wrath, Cata, Mists: Slam).
Fixed
• Fire every event once when several addons embed different library versions (all clients): each copy created its own event frame, and after a LibStub upgrade the older copy's frame kept dispatching into the shared library, so every game event was handled twice (START / STOP / START per swing). The frame is now shared through lib.frame and taken over by a newer copy; handlers dispatch through a private table and the lib.EVENT_NAME entries are blanked, which also silences frames left behind by copies up to MINOR 37.…
addons.description:
There is no relevant WOW API to have an easily accessible state of the swing timer. This library fires custom EVENTS that can be used in other ADDONs to produce swing timer information.
WoW: Forever
The library runs on WoW: Forever (the Classic-rule-set mainline client) and fires the same events as on Classic Era:
• Swing detection uses the native PLAYER_SWING event (the client refuses the combat log there). The player's main-hand, off-hand and ranged swings are all anchored by it, including in restricted content where weapon-speed APIs return secret values.
• Cast-completion resets, instant-with-reset spells and no-reset exceptions follow the Classic Era spell tables — the client reuses classic-era spell IDs.
• Parry haste is reflected mid-swing on the player, via the defender-anchored UNIT_COMBAT event (probe-verified on the beta). Other mid-swing modifications (haste changes) are still reflected at the next swing; no addon-facing event exists for those (report filed with Blizzard).
• Target swing tracking is unsupported on WoW: Forever — no UNIT_SWING_TIMER_* event other than UNIT_SWING_TIMER_INFO_INITIALIZED fires for "target", and UnitSwingTimerInfo("target", ...) always reports a parked state (no swing in flight).
• Only UNIT_SWING_TIMER_START events with reason "swing" come from the game's own swing event. The other reasons (cast resets, clips, haste, parry, ...) are the library's reconstruction of the Classic rules; any drift is corrected at the next swing, which then arrives as UNIT_SWING_TIMER_STOP followed by UNIT_SWING_TIMER_START.
• The game's own swing timer bars (controlled by the showSwingTimer CVar) coexist with this library's events; disable the CVar if you only want addon-driven bars.
Usage example:Use in AddonUse in WeakAuras
The LibClassicSwingTimerAPI fire the events as WeakAuras custom events that can be use on Custom Triggers. The following auras export strings are examples on how to use the lib in WeakAuras.
Main hand auraOff hand auraRanged hand auraAPI EVENTSUNIT_SWING_TIMER_INFO_INITIALIZED
Fired after the initialization of swing information for the unit. The UnitSwingTimerInfo method is only usable after this event. It fires again for the player after every loading screen, and for the target on every target change: treat it as "reset everything for this unit". Swings still in flight at that moment end with UNIT_SWING_TIMER_STOP first.

| Property | Description |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| unitId | string - type of the unit ("player" or "target") |
UNIT_SWING_TIMER_START
Fired when a weapon or ranged swing starts.

| Property | Description |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| unitId | string - type of the unit ("player" or "target") |
| speed | number - weapon speed |
| expirationTime | number - end of swing relative to GetTime() |
| hand | string - the hand that start to swing ("mainhand", "offhand" or "ranged") |
| reason | string - why the swing started, see below |

| reason | Meaning |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| "swing" | A swing seen by the game: an auto attack, an Auto Shot / wand shot, or an on-next-swing ability (Heroic Strike, Raptor Strike, Maul...) |
| "reset" | A spell cast, channel end, Feign Death, Volley or weapon swap restarted the timer |
| "clip" | The swing came due during a cast and restarted; UNIT_SWING_TIMER_CLIPPED follows |
| "attack" | Auto-attack was switched on (off-hand start) |

The first off-hand swing after auto-attack is switched on (or after a reset that comes before the first off-hand hit) arrives as UNIT_SWING_TIMER_UPDATE, not UNIT_SWING_TIMER_START: the off hand starts half-way through its cycle, so expirationTime is speed / 2 away.
UNIT_SWING_TIMER_UPDATE
Fired when an in-flight swing's end time changes: a weapon speed change, and also parry haste, the end of a pause, or a delayed Auto Shot. speed is the weapon speed, not the time left: expirationTime - speed is not the swing's start after an update.

Known limitation: a parry in the same frame as the player's own swing start is treated as landing before that swing and does not shorten it. The engine applied the cut in one such case and skipped it in another (Classic Era captures), so the rule stays until more samples settle the ordering; 2.1.x cut every parry.

• Park the player's swings on PLAYER_DEAD (all clients): the death reset cancelled each active hand's timer and fired UNIT_SWING_TIMER_STOP but left its expiration in the future, so UnitSwingTimerInfo kept reporting the stopped swing as in flight until that time passed. Each stopped hand now parks (expiration = lastSwing, the same convention as the login seed) before its STOP fires, so a consumer that reads the state inside its STOP handler already sees it parked. Found in the Classic Era regression pass (2026-10-02, client 1.15.9.70003, Season of Discovery realm): STOP fired at death with 0.54 s left on the main hand, while the state query still read that swing as in flight. Event-driven consumers were unaffected. Verified on the same client after the fix: one STOP at death and the main hand reads parked at once; the duplicate PLAYER_DEAD fires nothing; the first swing after resurrection starts cleanly. Also verified on the WoW: Forever beta (client 1.60.1.70170): STOP at death with 1.115 s left, the main hand reads parked at once, clean START after resurrection. Report: docs/CLASSIC_ERA_REGRESSION_2026-10-02.md.
• Skip UNIT_SWING_TIMER_DELTA when either hand has already landed (all clients): at the attack toggle the off-hand restart computed the delta against the main hand's expiration from its last swing, firing a meaningless value (-21.625 s in a WoW: Forever capture, 2026-10-02) that consumers displaying the delta would show until the next one. addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon that remembers the people you meet in the open world.

You group with a stranger for an hour in the Barrens, trade a few potions with
someone in Redridge, get killed twice by the same rogue in Hillsbrad. A week
later you meet one of them again and can't place the name. Social Diary writes
these meetings down for you: who you grouped with, traded with, whispered,
fought beside or against, who killed you, who you saw along the road, and when
you met again.

It keeps your own journey too: levels, firsts, the zones you
passed through, close calls, lucky drops, the end of long quest chains and
profession caps. All of it is written into a paper journal automatically.

Made for WoW Forever (currently in beta): classic-era content on the
retail addon API. Current version: 1.5.0.

addons.changelog:
Wayfarer 1.0.0 — аддон, все паки голосов и «Путевые истории» прямо в этом релизе (архивы ниже). То же самое есть на CurseForge.
Как установить
• Проще всего — Wayfarer на CurseForge: приложение CurseForge поставит аддон вместе с паками голосов и будет их обновлять.
• Вручную, отсюда. Скачайте ниже:

| Архив | Что это | Нужен? |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfarer-1.0.0.zip | сам аддон: плеер, дневник путника | да |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Alliance-3.2.0.zip | голоса: квесты Альянса | если играете за Альянс |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Horde-3.2.0.zip | голоса: квесты Орды | если играете за Орду |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Shared-3.2.0.zip | голоса: общие квесты, праздники | да |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Narrator-3.2.0.zip | рассказчик: лор мест, книги и таблички | да |
| Wayfarer_Radio-1.0.0.zip | «Путевые истории»: радио и аудиокнига для дороги | по желанию |

Полностью закройте игру, распакуйте все папки из архивов в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns (должны получиться Wayfarer, Wayfarer_Voices_… и, если ставите истории, Wayfarer_Radio) и запустите игру заново — после /reload новые звуки игра не увидит.
• Обновляетесь с 0.7.x: замените папку Wayfarer и папки паков голосов целиком (в паках 3.2.0 — 1 201 новая реплика и исправления ударений).
Что нового по сравнению с 0.7.0Дневник путника
Книга, в которой собрано всё, что вы открыли в пути, и всё, что можно послушать ещё раз. Зачем он нужен:
• рассказчик говорит о месте один раз, при первом входе — в дневнике любую историю можно переслушать;
• видно, сколько мест каждой земли вы уже открыли и где ещё не были;
• с паком «Путевые истории» дневник становится библиотекой: сезоны «Хроник Азерота», бестиарий, лица, тайны мест, байки — слушать по порядку, как аудиокнигу.
Как открыть
• Левый клик по кнопке Wayfarer — микрофон на краю мини-карты. Правый клик — быстрое меню.
• Команда /wf journal (или /wf j).
• Клавиша «Дневник путника»: Esc → Назначение клавиш → Wayfarer.
• Кнопка-книга в окне плеера.
Закладка «Азерот» — атлас ваших мест
• Слева: сколько мест открыто, материки, поиск по землям и местам, «Вы здесь», закреплённые земли, открытые земли (у каждой — «5 / 18»: сколько её мест вы видели). Закрытые земли свёрнуты одной строкой — по клику их список.
• Справа — выбранная земля: карта, «Исследовано X из Y мест», кнопки «Рассказ о земле», «Открыть карту» (карта мира на этой земле), «Закрепить». Ниже — все места земли в две колонки.
• Клик по месту — его история текстом и голосом рассказчика, ещё клик — стоп.
• Где вы не были — место закрыто («ещё N не открыто»): дневник не расскажет того, до чего вы не дошли. Место открывается, когда вы в нём побываете, даже если рассказчик выключен. Места, чью историю вы слушали до обновления, уже открыты.
Закладка «Истории» — библиотека «Путевых историй»
Появляется, если стоит пак «Путевые истории».
• Слева — рубрики и выпуски. «Хроники» разбиты по сезонам.
• Статус у каждого выпуска:
• новое;
• остановились на части N;
• прослушано;
• звучит;
• закрыт — «откроется на N уровне», «по ходу ваших приключений» или «когда дослушаете прошлый сезон».
• Справа — карточка выпуска:
• «Слушать» / «Продолжить» — с того места, где вы остановились;
• «С начала»;
• «Краткий пересказ» — напомнит прошлые серии сезона;
• части плитками — включить любую;
• весь текст выпуска.
• Внизу — «Включить эфир» и «Эфир…»: настройки радио.
Мини-гайд
1. Поставьте паки. Аддон, пак голосов своей фракции, «Общие квесты» и «Рассказчик» — обязательно. «Путевые истории» — по желанию.
2. Играйте как обычно. Новые места открываются сами, рассказчик читает их историю при первом входе. Пропустили или хотите послушать снова — откройте дневник, «Азерот», выберите землю и место.
3. Закрепите земли, где сейчас качаетесь. Они будут сверху списка. Поиск находит и земли, и отдельные места.
4. «Хроники Азерота» — с начала. Откройте «Истории», рубрика «Хроники», сезон «Темный портал», серия 1 → «Слушать». Серии идут подряд. Если прервались, дневник запомнит часть, а «Продолжить» начнёт с неё.…
addons.description:
Russian voice-over addon for WoW Forever (ruRU client): quests read aloud by NPC voices, zone lore and books read by a narrator, the Traveler's Journal and an optional radio of stories for the road. Get it on CurseForge.

Wayfarer читает вслух задания и рассказывает историю мест Азерота. Каждый NPC говорит своим голосом, подобранным по расе, полу и характеру: ворчливый дворф, суетливый гном, сдержанная эльфийка-часовая. Лор мест, книги, письма и таблички читает рассказчик.
Скачать
Рекомендуем — Wayfarer на CurseForge. Приложение CurseForge само поставит и будет обновлять аддон вместе с паками голосов.

Или вручную, отсюда: в последнем релизе — архив аддона Wayfarer-.zip и (с 1.0.0) архивы всех паков: голоса и «Путевые истории». Исходный код аддона — в папке Wayfarer/. Паки — те же, что на CurseForge:

| Пак | Что внутри |
|---|---|
| Wayfarer Voices - Alliance | квесты и квестовые диалоги Альянса |
| Wayfarer Voices - Horde | квесты и квестовые диалоги Орды |
| Wayfarer Voices - Shared Quests | общие квесты обеих фракций, новые квесты Forever |
| Wayfarer Voices - Narrator | рассказчик: лор зон и подзон, книги, письма и таблички |
| Wayfarer Stories (по желанию) | «Путевые истории»: радио и аудиокнига для дороги — 359 выпусков, почти 16 часов |

Нужны пак своей фракции, общие квесты и рассказчик. Если какого-то пака не хватает, аддон напишет об этом в чат. «Путевые истории» — по желанию.
Что озвучено
• Квесты Альянса и Орды 1–60 уровней и общие квесты: описание при взятии и текст награды при сдаче.
• Квестовые диалоги — разговоры, где по квесту выбираешь ответы (Тирион, Тралл, Эйтригг, «Испытание знаний» и другие).
• Новые квесты WoW Forever: Остров Зефрис, «Основы походной жизни», классовые и стартовые.
• Рассказчик: лор 994 зон и подзон, сверенный с сюжетом Forever, — при первом посещении места.
• Книги, письма и таблички: 1 143 страницы — открыли книгу, рассказчик читает страницу.
• Праздники и события (Лунный фестиваль, Любовная лихорадка, Детская неделя, Огненный солнцеворот, Тыквовин, Зимний Покров, война Ан'Киража, нашествие Плети) и поля боя.

Всего 11 012 реплик, 4 058 квестов, 75 голосов (модель ElevenLabs v4). Нужен русский клиент игры.

Пока не озвучено: промежуточные фразы квестов («Ну что, принёс?») и обычные реплики NPC в разговоре.
Установка вручную
1. Полностью закройте игру.
2. Если стоял Wayfarer 0.3–0.5, удалите папку Wayfarer_Voices (голоса теперь в паках). Если стоял VoiceOver RU — папки VoiceOverRU и VoiceOverRU_Data*, иначе реплики будут звучать дважды.
3. Скачайте из релиза Wayfarer-.zip и паки: голоса своей фракции, общие квесты, рассказчик и, по желанию, «Путевые истории» (Wayfarer_Radio). Они же есть на CurseForge (на странице пака — вкладка Files).
4. Распакуйте все папки в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns: должны получиться Wayfarer, Wayfarer_Voices_* и, если ставите «Путевые истории», Wayfarer_Radio.
5. Запустите игру. Нужен именно перезапуск: после /reload новые звуковые файлы игра не увидит.

Другие аддоны озвучки квестов (CatQuest, Spoken, VoiceOver) лучше отключить.
Дневник путника
Книга обо всём, что вы открыли в пути. Открыть — левый клик по кнопке Wayfarer (микрофон на краю мини-карты), /wf journal или клавиша «Дневник путника».
• «Азерот» — атлас: земли с картами и местами, сколько мест вы уже открыли, поиск, закреплённые земли. Клик по месту — его история ещё раз. Где вы не были, там закрыто: рассказчик не забегает вперёд.
• «Истории» — библиотека пака «Путевые истории»: «Хроники Азерота» (шесть сезонов от Темного портала до Королевства Отрекшихся и шесть сезонов народов), бестиарий, «Лица Азерота», «Тайны мест», байки у костра. У каждого выпуска — статус, «Слушать» / «Продолжить», краткий пересказ и весь текст. Включите эфир — и летописец будет рассказывать в дороге и в полёте; квесты и разговоры с NPC всегда важнее.
Управление…
