releases.changelog:
Wayfarer 1.0.0 — аддон, все паки голосов и «Путевые истории» прямо в этом релизе (архивы ниже). То же самое есть на CurseForge.
Как установить
• Проще всего — Wayfarer на CurseForge: приложение CurseForge поставит аддон вместе с паками голосов и будет их обновлять.
• Вручную, отсюда. Скачайте ниже:

| Архив | Что это | Нужен? |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfarer-1.0.0.zip | сам аддон: плеер, дневник путника | да |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Alliance-3.2.0.zip | голоса: квесты Альянса | если играете за Альянс |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Horde-3.2.0.zip | голоса: квесты Орды | если играете за Орду |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Shared-3.2.0.zip | голоса: общие квесты, праздники | да |
| Wayfarer_Voices_Narrator-3.2.0.zip | рассказчик: лор мест, книги и таблички | да |
| Wayfarer_Radio-1.0.0.zip | «Путевые истории»: радио и аудиокнига для дороги | по желанию |

Полностью закройте игру, распакуйте все папки из архивов в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns (должны получиться Wayfarer, Wayfarer_Voices_… и, если ставите истории, Wayfarer_Radio) и запустите игру заново — после /reload новые звуки игра не увидит.
• Обновляетесь с 0.7.x: замените папку Wayfarer и папки паков голосов целиком (в паках 3.2.0 — 1 201 новая реплика и исправления ударений).
Что нового по сравнению с 0.7.0Дневник путника
Книга, в которой собрано всё, что вы открыли в пути, и всё, что можно послушать ещё раз. Зачем он нужен:
• рассказчик говорит о месте один раз, при первом входе — в дневнике любую историю можно переслушать;
• видно, сколько мест каждой земли вы уже открыли и где ещё не были;
• с паком «Путевые истории» дневник становится библиотекой: сезоны «Хроник Азерота», бестиарий, лица, тайны мест, байки — слушать по порядку, как аудиокнигу.
Как открыть
• Левый клик по кнопке Wayfarer — микрофон на краю мини-карты. Правый клик — быстрое меню.
• Команда /wf journal (или /wf j).
• Клавиша «Дневник путника»: Esc → Назначение клавиш → Wayfarer.
• Кнопка-книга в окне плеера.
Закладка «Азерот» — атлас ваших мест
• Слева: сколько мест открыто, материки, поиск по землям и местам, «Вы здесь», закреплённые земли, открытые земли (у каждой — «5 / 18»: сколько её мест вы видели). Закрытые земли свёрнуты одной строкой — по клику их список.
• Справа — выбранная земля: карта, «Исследовано X из Y мест», кнопки «Рассказ о земле», «Открыть карту» (карта мира на этой земле), «Закрепить». Ниже — все места земли в две колонки.
• Клик по месту — его история текстом и голосом рассказчика, ещё клик — стоп.
• Где вы не были — место закрыто («ещё N не открыто»): дневник не расскажет того, до чего вы не дошли. Место открывается, когда вы в нём побываете, даже если рассказчик выключен. Места, чью историю вы слушали до обновления, уже открыты.
Закладка «Истории» — библиотека «Путевых историй»
Появляется, если стоит пак «Путевые истории».
• Слева — рубрики и выпуски. «Хроники» разбиты по сезонам.
• Статус у каждого выпуска:
• новое;
• остановились на части N;
• прослушано;
• звучит;
• закрыт — «откроется на N уровне», «по ходу ваших приключений» или «когда дослушаете прошлый сезон».
• Справа — карточка выпуска:
• «Слушать» / «Продолжить» — с того места, где вы остановились;
• «С начала»;
• «Краткий пересказ» — напомнит прошлые серии сезона;
• части плитками — включить любую;
• весь текст выпуска.
• Внизу — «Включить эфир» и «Эфир…»: настройки радио.
Мини-гайд
1. Поставьте паки. Аддон, пак голосов своей фракции, «Общие квесты» и «Рассказчик» — обязательно. «Путевые истории» — по желанию.
2. Играйте как обычно. Новые места открываются сами, рассказчик читает их историю при первом входе. Пропустили или хотите послушать снова — откройте дневник, «Азерот», выберите землю и место.
3. Закрепите земли, где сейчас качаетесь. Они будут сверху списка. Поиск находит и земли, и отдельные места.
4. «Хроники Азерота» — с начала. Откройте «Истории», рубрика «Хроники», сезон «Темный портал», серия 1 → «Слушать». Серии идут подряд. Если прервались, дневник запомнит часть, а «Продолжить» начнёт с неё.…

Wayfarer 0.7.1 — с этой версии на GitHub только сам аддон. Голоса — паки на CurseForge.
Как установить
• Проще всего — Wayfarer на CurseForge: приложение CurseForge поставит аддон вместе с паками голосов и будет их обновлять.
• Вручную: скачайте Wayfarer-0.7.1.zip ниже и паки голосов с CurseForge (на странице пака — вкладка Files): Альянс, Орда, Общие квесты, Рассказчик. Нужны пак своей фракции, общие квесты и рассказчик. Полностью закройте игру, распакуйте все папки в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns и запустите игру заново.
• Обновляетесь с 0.4.x: удалите папку Wayfarer_Voices — голоса теперь в паках Wayfarer_Voices_*, иначе озвучка будет звучать дважды.
Новое в 0.7.1
• Рассказчик у мини-карты: кнопка ▶ слева от названия места над мини-картой — рассказ о месте, где вы стоите, не открывая карту. Правый клик — о всей зоне, повторное нажатие — остановить.
• Alt+Tab больше не обрывает озвучку. Если в настройках звука выключен «Звук в фоновом режиме», игра при сворачивании глушила реплику, а полоса плеера шла дальше. Теперь на время реплики звук в фоне включается, потом ваша настройка возвращается. Если звук всё же оборвётся — реплика встанет на паузу, «Играть» начнёт её заново.
• Исправлено: при прослушивании квеста кнопкой ▶ (список заданий, журнал) вместо говорящей головы NPC иногда была книга или значок. NPC, которых игра ещё не знает, аддон запрашивает у сервера; пока модель грузится — значок расы говорящего.
Что появилось после 0.4.1 (выпуски 0.5–0.7 выходили на CurseForge)
• Озвучены квесты Альянса и Орды 1–60, квестовые диалоги (Тирион, Тралл, Эйтригг, «Испытание знаний»…), новые квесты Forever со сдачами.
• Книги, письма и таблички — 1 143 страницы читает рассказчик; лор Острова Зефрис.
• Окно «говорящая голова», как в retail: 3D-портрет NPC (голова крупно или по пояс), фон в цветах расы, текст прокручивается за голосом; /wf move, /wf size 80.
• Прослушать квест ещё раз — кнопка ▶ у квестов в списке заданий и в журнале на карте.
• Голоса не накладываются: озвучка ждёт, пока NPC договорит приветствие.
• Очередь без ограничений: квесты, страницы диалогов и новые места звучат по порядку.

Всего 9 811 реплик, 994 места, 66 голосов. Сообщество и репорты — Discord.

Wayfarer 0.4.1: исправлен повтор рассказчика на границах зон.
Исправления
• Рассказчик больше не повторяет одно и то же. Некоторые места лежат на границе двух карт и описаны в обеих: Руины Лордерона (Тирисфальские леса и Подгород), Руины Альтерака, моря и реки, Мост Тандола, врата Дун Морога и Лок Модана и другие. На границе игра сообщает о «новом» месте, и рассказ о нём звучал второй раз подряд. Теперь такое место рассказывается один раз.
• Рассказ о зоне больше не теряется. Если войти в новую зону, пока рассказчик ещё говорит, рассказ о зоне мог выпасть из очереди, вытесненный рассказом о подзоне, и при этом считался прослушанным. Теперь звучат оба. Место отмечается прослушанным, только когда рассказ действительно начался: пропущенный рассказ прозвучит при следующем визите.

Разные места с одинаковым названием, например Каналы в Штормграде и в Подгороде, по-прежнему рассказываются отдельно.
Установка и обновление
• Уже стоит 0.4.0: скачайте маленький Wayfarer-0.4.1-update-from-0.4.0.zip (59 КБ) и замените им папку Wayfarer в Interface\AddOns. Голоса (Wayfarer_Voices) не менялись, после замены достаточно /reload.
• Новая установка или обновление с 0.3.0: скачайте полный Wayfarer-0.4.1-2026-09-30.zip (649 МБ). Полностью закройте игру и распакуйте архив в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns: замените папки Wayfarer и Wayfarer_Voices. После установки полностью перезапустите игру. Подробная инструкция — в архиве (Wayfarer_README.txt) и в README.

Wayfarer 0.3.0: первая публичная версия под новым именем (раньше аддон назывался VoiceOver RU).

Скачайте Wayfarer-0.3.0-2026-09-28.zip ниже (625 МБ) и распакуйте в World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns. Подробная инструкция есть в архиве (Wayfarer_README.txt) и в README.
Что озвучено
• Квесты Альянса и общие квесты 1–40 уровней: взятие и сдача (2 784 реплики)
• Лор зон и подзон
Что нового
• Новое имя: ядро Wayfarer и модуль озвучки Wayfarer_Voices. Команда /wf, старая /vru тоже работает.
• Все модули озвучки объединены в один.
• Таймер реплики в окне плеера.
• Кнопка «!» и команда /wf report: сообщить об ошибке в реплике. /wf reports открывает список для отправки автору.
• Звук по умолчанию идёт через «Общую громкость». Если канал не воспроизводит звук, аддон пробует общий и подсказывает в чате, что проверить.

addons.description:
Remember who they are.

Keep private reminders about players you meet. Add an optional note or color-coded reason for your own reference, then see it in their tooltip the next time you meet. Your information remains local to your computer and is never shared.

Download: CurseForge · GitHub Releases
Features
• Remember players — save a personal note, choose a reason, or use both; each is optional.
• See it at a glance — your notes and color-coded reasons appear when you hover over a player.
• Organize your list — create your own reasons, such as "Met in a dungeon", "Helpful player", "Crafter", or "Alchemy".
• Add an icon — pick an icon for a reason or an individual player from a searchable picker, shown next to it in the tooltip; you can also add your own icon image files, which always appear first in the picker.
• Know when they are nearby — play an alert sound when you encounter someone on your list.
• Choose how alerts repeat — hear an alert once per session, or let it repeat after a delay.
• Make alerts recognisable — choose different sounds for your whole list, a reason, or an individual player; you can also add your own sound files.
• Add players quickly — right-click players from unit frames, chat links, and other supported places to add or edit them.
• Easy access — use the minimap button or slash commands to open your settings, reasons, and player list.
• Use separate lists if you want — keep different lists for different characters, or share one across them.
• Keep your data private — your notes and settings stay on your computer; nothing is sent anywhere.

addons.changelog:
v3.2.0 (2026-11-02)Added
• Warn earlier: a cooldown shows 5 seconds before its time by default and counts down to the moment you press it, then shows Now. Change the default on the New messages page or per assignment; text messages can warn earlier too.
• The encounter page is one desk: the bosses of the instance as tiles on top, a toolbar, the timeline across the whole width and the selected assignment below it as a form with one line per setting: template, when (once, repeating or several times), what, for whom, overlay, duration and warning, sound and difficulties. A new assignment can start from a template right there. Advanced opens every setting in a window of its own. There is no separate encounter list or assignment page anymore.
• Demo playback: plays the plan from the playhead on your overlays, in real time or four times as fast. Click on the time axis to move the playhead.
• View as a role or player: the timeline and the demo playback show only what they get. Normal, Heroic and Mythic switch on and off one by one; the timeline dims the assignments that run on none of them.
• In the timeline, drag a marker to move the assignment, with Alt to copy it, and middle-click it to delete it (asks first). The mouse wheel zooms (out to 20 minutes, to plan after the last assignment), Shift + mouse wheel or dragging an empty spot scrolls the time, and repeating assignments show as a bar. The timeline and its markers list these controls.
• New encounter lists the dungeons of the current expansion besides the raids.
• On Retail it also lists the Mythic+ dungeons of the current season. A dungeon's page lets you add a boss the journal doesn't list, by its encounter ID.
• Each encounter has a Share with the group switch. Encounters you don't share aren't sent to your group and run only for you.
• Demo: Overlays → Demo or /prt demo plays a sample fight of about 40 seconds with every kind of message for you (text with countdown, marker, own sound, read aloud, healing and utility cooldowns, a repeating assignment) on your overlays, plus your next assignments and the raid plan in combat. It runs anywhere, out of combat and in every role.
Changed
• In a dungeon group every member can send plans; in a raid it stays the leader and assistants.
• Simpler window: the overview and the settings are one page (with About at the end), and importing an encounter moved to New encounter.
• The overview picks your role (lead, player or both) the same way as the first start guide.
• A message's sound is one choice: the overlay's sound, its own sound or TTS (text to speech).
• An assignment's targets are picked with ticks in one list (roles, your group, raid groups, classes), so several targets need no extra step.
• Save as template is one click; the template is named after the message and can be renamed on the templates page.
• The message editor has no Tools card and no Undo anymore; loading and saving templates and deleting the assignment are at the end of Display.
• Overlays have one Unlock switch instead of lock and unlock buttons, Raid plan in combat (formerly Lead status) one switch to place it, and the layout options are labeled.
• New messages is its own page with the same options as an assignment (type, text, targets, overlay, duration, sound) plus the difficulties of new assignments. Every new assignment and template starts as this message.
• Overlays lock again when you close the options window.
• A new profile is created by pressing Enter in its name field.
• The debug log shows one line per entry.
• Every overlay (messages, your next assignments, lead status) has the same text settings: font, size, outline (off, thin, thick) and shadow.
• Your next assignments shows every line in the same size; the next one is no longer larger.
Fixed
• The Every slider of a repeating assignment can be dragged again.…
addons.description:
Plan per boss which player sees which message when; the raid lead syncs the plan before the pull.

The raid lead plans each boss on a timeline. Before the pull the plan goes to
the group, and every player runs it locally and sees only the messages meant
for them. Since Midnight (also WoW: Forever) addons get no combat log, no boss
health or power and can't message the group during encounters, so everything
counts from the pull. Use it next to your boss mod (DBM, BigWigs).

It runs anywhere, out of combat and in every role.
Changed
• In a dungeon group every member can send plans; in a raid it stays the leader and assistants.
• Simpler window: the overview and the settings are one page (with About at the end), and importing an encounter moved to New encounter.

• Every overlay (messages, your next assignments, lead status) has the same text settings: font, size, outline (off, thin, thick) and shadow.
• Your next assignments shows every line in the same size; the next one is no longer larger.
Fixed
• The Every slider of a repeating assignment can be dragged again.…

v3.1.0 (2026-10-25)
PhenomRaidTools 3.1 for Midnight (12.x) and WoW: Forever. Since Midnight, addons get no combat log and no boss health or power, and they can't message the group during encounters. PRT therefore sends the plans to the group before the pull, and every player runs them locally.

Back up your SavedVariables first (WTF/Account//SavedVariables/PhenomRaidTools.lua). The update removes everything that can't run anymore, and this can't be undone.
New
• Everything is in one window with search: overview, encounters, templates, overlays, settings and profiles (/prt).
• The lead sends the enabled plans on every ready check or with /prt sync, and the overview shows who has them.
• Assignments: click into an encounter's timeline to add one at that time. An assignment shows once, repeating (every n seconds from–to) or at several times, and runs only on the difficulties you pick.
• The timeline shows spell icons. Hover a marker to see the text and who gets it.
• Cooldowns show the spell's name or your own text. Text to speech can read any message aloud.
• A preview beside the window shows the assignment or overlay you are editing.
• New encounter offers the bosses of the current raids. The encounter list is grouped by instance and shows boss portraits.
• New profiles start with three overlays: messages at the top, healing cooldowns on the left and utility cooldowns on the right. A cooldown chosen from the list goes on the matching overlay.
• Each overlay shows text, icons or bars and can grow in any direction.
• Your next assignments shows what is next for you during an encounter.
• The What's new window opens after updates, and /prt news opens it again.
Removed

• Encounter versions (the active version is kept) and timer groups. Each assignment takes over its group's difficulties.
• The old AceGUI options and Classic Era / Wrath Classic support.

addons.description:
Opinionated and highly optimized quality-of-life tweaks for WoW Forever in one neat package.

More than 50 tweaks, from a campfire timer and an XP tracker to better tooltips and automatic junk selling, each one switched on and set up in a single settings window. It also loads on Classic Era.

Type /hst in game to open the settings. Each tweak can be turned on or off at any time without a /reload. Tweaks that act for you or replace part of the game's interface start off. The full list of tweaks and how each behaves is in HastesSuperTweaks/README.md.
HighlightsCampfire Helper
On WoW Forever, a campfire on screen shows when you're near a fire, counts down while you sit by it, then shows how long your camp buffs have left and blinks when they're about to run out. Show it as a ring, a bar or an icon. /hst camp check lists every camp timer.
XP Tracker
An XP bar with rested XP, XP from completed quests, XP per hour and time to level. Mob tooltips say roughly how many more kills of that mob you need to level, and the quest log shows each quest's XP.
Better Tooltips
A health bar under unit tooltips (in class colors, or green to red by health), borders in class colors, guild ranks and notes, and who the unit is targeting. On WoW Forever, your Recent Allies show where and when you last played together. Item tooltips can say how many you have in your bags and banks, and item, spell and NPC IDs are optional. Works with tooltip styles from other addons.
Appearance Collector
On WoW Forever, a mark on gear whose look you haven't collected, in your bags, at vendors and in the Loot Window, and a line in item tooltips. Choose a hanger, shirt, sparkle or dot. Sell Clutter keeps that gear.
Consumable Macros
Macros that always use your best food, drink, bandage and potions as your bags change, plus one that eats and drinks at once, a hunter's Feed Pet, and ones that put your best stone, oil or poison on each weapon. Drag them onto your action bars from the Macros window.
Loot Window and Fast Loot
A compact loot list with a Take All button and hotkey. While you auto loot, it lists what you picked up for a few seconds. Fast Loot takes everything at once and still lets gathering trackers see the loot.
Sell Junk and Sell Clutter
Greys are sold at any vendor. Sell Clutter also sells the items you collect while leveling and won't use:
• cooking ingredients and monster parts that none of your professions use
• other classes' reagents
• gear your class can't use
• food, potions and white gear you've outleveled

It keeps quest items, items your RestedXP guide needs, equipment sets, profession tools, expensive materials, anything that opens and gear whose look you haven't collected. Item tooltips say what will be sold, and /hst clutter list shows the full list before you reach a vendor.
Better Scrolling Combat Text
Separate scroll areas for damage and healing you take and for notices: entering and leaving combat, low health and mana, combo points, auras, reputation, honor and skill-ups. Damage numbers can show on enemy nameplates. Choose fonts, colors, animations and filters, and move each area in Edit Mode.
Settings window
• Point at a tweak in the list to see its description, a preview and its main settings beside it.
• Search finds any tweak or setting by name, description or menu choice. Switches work in the results, and Enter jumps to the setting.
• Tweaks you can see on screen, like the XP bar, tooltips, the loot window and combat text, have a live preview beside their settings that redraws as you change them.
• The cog in the title bar picks the window's theme: Graphite, Ember or Moonwell.
• Profiles hold every tweak's settings. Switch, copy and reset them, or share one as text.
All tweaks…

addons.description:
This addon enables Masque (CurseForge, Wago, WoWInterface) to skin the built-in WoW action bars.

If you like the base WoW interface and don't want to use a separate action bar mod, you're in the right place.

You can install this addon from CurseForge, Wago, or WoWInterface.
Features
Masque Blizzard Bars can currently skin the following bars, according to your game version:
• Main Action Bar
• Multi Bars (Action Bars 2 - 8)
• Possess Bar
• Stance Bar
• Pet Bar
• Vehicle Bar
• Pet Battle Bar
• Extra Ability Buttons (Extra Action Button, Zone Ability Buttons)
• Spell Flyout
• Cooldown Manager (with each bar type configured indepdendently)
• Essential Cooldowns
• Utility Cooldowns
• Tracked Bars
• Tracked Buffs

Support for Buffs, Debuffs and External Defensives bars is tentatively planned for a future update.

Alert, debuff, and pandemic styles for Cooldown Manager bars are not supported due to game restrictions. These will appear using the default style and may not match your skin.

Each bar type is its own group so you can configure them independently from Masque's Skin Settings.
Forever Support
World of Warcraft: Forever has nearly the same interface features as Retail, so it is fully supported.
Classic Support
Classic versions available in the US are fully supported. Bars not available in Classic will not appear in Masque's Skin Settings.

I don't play Classic so testing is somewhat limited, but I'll do my best to address bug reports promptly.
Compatibility
This addon is intended to skin the base WoW interface. Addons that heavily modify parts of the base interface may conflict. This is especially common with Cooldown Manager addons. If you experience a conflict, use Masque's Skin Settings to disable the affected group and reload your UI. This should allow the other addon to control the interface without interference.

If you'd like to see Masque support in a conflicting addon, try sending a feature request to that addon's author directly.
Localization
If you'd like to help localize this addon, please submit translations here.
LLM Policy
LLM ("Generative AI") agents are not used for development of this project and such contributions will not be accepted.
Other Addons
If you want to skin built-in Inventory UI elements as well, check out Masque Blizzard Inventory (CurseForge, Wago, WoWInterface)!
Special Thanks
Thanks to StormFX, the author of Masque, for a ton of feedback and development tips and for creating a logo for the addon.

Thanks to Madnessbox, the author of the original Masque Blizz Bars addon, for the concept.

addons.description:
Midnight Changes: I have created a version of ArcHUD3 that is compatible with Midnight!! With the API changes in 12.0, it is no longer possible to create the exact smooth arcs used here, but I've made the closest approximation I could. There is some polish that is no longer possible for arcs that rely on secret values (health, power, etc), like the spark, smooth animations, angled tips, etc. If you notice any issues (there are likely several), feel free to open an issue on GitHub.

ArcHUD displays smooth arcs around your character in the middle of the screen to inform you about the health and power (mana, rage, ...) of you, your pet, and your target. In addition, it shows casts, combo points, holy power, soul shards, and a couple of other things. It discretely fades when you are out of combat and at full health/power.

This is a continuation of ArcHUD2 which managed to survive various patches... until the Cataclysm. Thanks to Nenie, the original author of ArcHUD2, for supporting me with this new version.

Please report any bugs or feature requests via the ticket system. The login is the same as your Curse login.

These arcs are currently supported:
• Health and power (mana, rage, focus, energy, runic power) for player, pet, target, and focus target
• Player's secondary power (Holy Power, Soul Shards, Chi etc.)
• Casting/channelling progress for player, target, and focus target
• Fatigue/breath (mirror timer)
• Combo points (including unconsumed combo points on previous target, e.g. on dead corpses)
• Custom (de)buff arcs: Ever wanted to keep track of the stacks and/or remaining times of some specific (de)buffs such as Evangelism, Savage Roar, Beacon of Light, Weakened Soul, etc? Then just create your own custom (de)buff arc for it!

In addition, some additional target information is displayed:
• Current target (name, class, guild, 3D model)
• Current (de)buffs on target
• Target-of-target and target-of-target-of-target

Small warning: Using this addon apparently bears a high risk of getting addicted to it, as these user comments suggest. I received those after taking over the development of ArcHUD when the Cataclysm happened:
• "...nothing ever quite matched the smooth, clean simplicity of ArcHUD's graceful rings."
• "Great job!! I've used this addon for years! None of the other HUDs come close to the functionality and elegance of ArcHUD."
• "Thanks for the work on it so far, much more lightweight than IceHud!"
• "Was staring at the various icehud/metahud alternatives with discomfort and sadness right after the patch [4.0]."
• "Awesome! Thank you so much for that miracle!"
• "Thank you so much for continuing this fantastic addon."
• "...nothing could compare to ArcHUD..."
• "For a whole 4years I had this mod and I missed it so much in the passed few weeks. I tried other HUD mods but they were too in my face >.< . Best HUD mod IMO! Thanks for resurrecting an old friend :D"
• "Loving the new ArcHUD my favorite HUD by far :)"
• "I don't think I could play wow without this addon :)"
• "I've actually grown kind of dependent on it because I'll occasionally run out of Mana/ die without this."
• "Hey mate, just came to thank You again for taking over this beauty, awesome job!"
• "THAT addon! So long I have been searching for a replacement when the development stopped, thanks for bringing it back to live!"

So use it at your own risk ;)

addons.description:
UA Forever is a Ukrainian localization addon for World of Warcraft: Forever
Beta, built for its modern Camelot interface. It translates quests, tooltips,
menus, character and profession panels, chat, NPC names, and other visible text.
Hold Shift to see the original tooltip; quest conversations have an EN/UA
switch. Target client: World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001).
Bundled client data: build 1.60.1.70450.

UA Forever — доповнення з українською локалізацією для World of Warcraft: Forever Beta, створене для сучасного інтерфейсу Camelot. Воно перекладає завдання, підказки, меню, панелі персонажа й професій, чат, імена NPC та інший видимий текст.
Утримуйте Shift, щоб побачити оригінал підказки. У діалогах завдань можна перемикатися між англійською та українською мовами. Цільовий клієнт: World of Warcraft: Forever (інтерфейс 16001). Клієнтські дані в аддоні: збірка 1.60.1.70450.
Реліз 0.22.0
Git-тег: 0.22.0. Зміни відносно 0.21.0:
• Оновлено клієнтські дані до збірки 1.60.1.70450.
• Додано українські назви й описи предметів і заклять, оновлено описи здібностей та аур.
• Виправлено переклад тривалості «до скасування» у підказках.
• Доповнено переклад тексту завершення завдання.
• Доповнено переклад ігрових об’єктів.

Для встановлення розпакуйте архів так, щоб папка UA_Forever опинилася в Interface/AddOns, після чого виконайте /reload або перезапустіть гру.
ClassicUA translations
We use Ukrainian texts and terminology from ClassicUA for classic quests,
NPCs, items, spells, gossip, books, zones, and basic interface strings. We
adapted those texts for Forever and added new translations. UA Forever has its
own Camelot integration; it does not load ClassicUA's old UI hooks.

ClassicUA: GitHub ·
CurseForge.

Classic translations can be outdated when Forever changes a spell or quest.
The bundled client catalog declares 1.60.1.70450 in its manifest;
/uaf scan reports a build mismatch when the running client differs.
Commands
• /uaf [status|on|off] and /uaf dev on|off
• /uaf ui, /uaf capture [seconds], /uaf scan, /uaf report
• /uaf menus (історичний лічильник меню), /uaf autoscan on|off
• /uaf owner, /uaf tooltip [rows], /uaf aura [seconds], /uaf window [seconds]

Scanned IDs, missing translations, menu captures, and diagnostics are saved in
UA_ForeverDB when the client reloads or exits. Run the translation audits in
tools/ when changing dictionaries. Contributor instructions are in
CONTRIBUTING_TRANSLATIONS.md.

У Налаштування → Додатки → UA Forever можна увімкнути автоскан
неперекладеного контенту. Він збирає нові предмети з текстом підказок, діалоги
й імена NPC, тексти та задачі квестів, навички, закляття, аури й вислови NPC
до UA_ForeverDB.scan.auto. Кнопка Показати зібрані дані відкриває експорт
частинами: натисніть Виділити для Ctrl+C, потім Ctrl+C і вставте текст на
сайті. Кнопка Форма для надсилання показує адресу
форми збору даних для копіювання й
відкриття в браузері. Користувач сам надсилає дані. WoW записує SavedVariables на диск під
час /reload або виходу з гри.
Після надсилання всіх частин натисніть Очистити дані у вікні експорту та
підтвердьте дію. Це видаляє UA_ForeverDB.scan.auto, локальну runtime/hook
діагностику поточної сесії та очищує видимий export.

Changelog
All notable changes to Horizon Suite are documented here.

[Unreleased]

[6.12.1] – 2026-10-27🐛 Fixes
• (Echo) Chat lines from other players show who said them again during boss fights and Mythic+, in conversations and in the All feed, and boss yells name the boss.

[6.12.0] – 2026-10-23✨ New Features
• (Insight) Cursor, fixed in combat — A new Tooltip Anchor choice follows the cursor out of combat and moves tooltips to your fixed anchor while you are in combat.

[6.11.1] – 2026-10-20🐛 Fixes
• (Focus) Tracked achievements now list only the criteria you still need by default, as Blizzard's tracker does. Turn off Missing Criteria Only to see every criterion.
• (Focus) In Minimal mode the header chevron and Options text stay hidden after a reload, and they disappear again when the cursor leaves the tracker.

[6.11.0] – 2026-10-19✨ New Features
• (Focus) Reverse sort order — A new Reverse order switch under Sorting flips the Quest level, Alphabetical and Zone sorts, so you can work through your lowest-level quests first or read your list Z to A. Quests that tie stay in A to Z order.
🐛 Fixes
• (Axis) The bottom of a settings page is no longer cut off after it opens; Focus → Layout scrolls all the way down to the Spacing options again.

[6.10.0] – 2026-10-18✨ New Features
• (Focus) Focused quest highlights — Active quest highlight now offers Left bar, Right bar, Gradient fade, Pointer, Coloured title and None, and none of them push your quests out of line. Each style keeps its own colour and turns green when the quest is ready to turn in, and with Show progress on the bars light up in four steps as you complete objectives.
🔧 Improvements
• (Focus) Fewer, cleaner highlight styles — Top bar, Bottom bar, Outline, Glow, Dual bars, Pill accent and Highlight have been retired. If you used one, you're moved to Left bar or Gradient fade automatically.

[6.9.0] – 2026-10-16✨ New Features
• (Augment) Faster auto-loot — With auto-loot on, every item on a corpse is taken at once; anything that won't fit in your bags stays behind and the loot window opens straight away showing just those. Off by default: turn it on under Augment → Loot Frame → Loot window.
• (Augment) Recipe learned alerts — The "new recipe learned" pop-up can show in your Horizon alert style, and Train all at a trainer shows one "12 Recipes Learned" alert instead of one per recipe. Off by default: turn on Recipe learned in Augment Alerts.
🐛 Fixes
• (Axis) Hovering Reset loot window position no longer raises a Lua error, and settings search no longer shows "function: 0x…" as a setting's description.

[6.8.1] – 2026-10-14🐛 Fixes
• (Augment) Gold, currency and reputation toasts no longer play the friend-online chime: gold plays the coin clink, currency and reputation play the loot toast sound, and the durability, bags and mail alerts play a neutral chime.
• (Focus) Quest items the game can't look up no longer flood chat with a warning every second, and their cooldown shows on the quest item button again.
• (Axis) The Integrations page shows an installed add-on built for a different game version as "Out of date" instead of calling it missing.

[6.8.0] – 2026-10-12✨ New Features
• (Vista) Map icon size — A new slider under Layout → Size & shape resizes the inn, repair and herb icons on the minimap without switching Vista off. Both it and Minimap size now redraw as you drag.
🐛 Fixes
• (Focus) Lock position now only controls the lock: it can be turned off with Shrink to fit on, and both the header and the body obey it.
• (Focus) Turning on Shrink to fit redraws every quest in full instead of cutting entries off half-way with gaps between sections.
• (Augment) The money, currency and reputation toast sounds play the toast chime again, and the durability, bags and mail alerts do too.

[6.7.1] – 2026-10-11🐛 Fixes
• (Focus · Forever) Group quests no longer show a group finder eye that does nothing when clicked; its option is greyed out until Forever supports group search.…
addons.description:
Driven by the community and customised for each member's sensibilities.
### Current Versions
_since-black?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=0FBF3E&logoSize=auto)

Seven modules, one download, for Retail (Midnight) and WoW: Forever. Each module switches on or off on its own, so you only run the parts you want. A fresh install starts with every module off: pick yours under Axis → Modules and reload.

New in 6.0: Echo, a chat module that gives every conversation its own tile. See below.

🌐 Retail and WoW: Forever
Horizon Suite runs on Retail (Midnight) and the WoW: Forever beta from the same download: install it once and every module loads on either client. Forever has no Mythic+, Delves, housing, Great Vault, specialisations or Traveler's Log, so the settings for those stay out of the way there.

Known beta issue: the Forever client doesn't yet read saved settings back at login, so your settings reset on reload there until Blizzard fixes it.

🎒 Augment \[Miscellaneous\]
Quality-of-life improvements to Blizzard's own UI, starting with loot that deserves to be seen.
• Loot toasts: Items, money, currency and reputation slide in with quality colours and smooth animations. Epic and legendary drops stay on screen longer, with a shine and an optional sound. Choose Compact, Framed, Accent, Ribbon, Rail or Card styling (shared with alerts, loot rolls and Echo; Card adds item level and slot under each item), which side the icon and slide-in sit on, and which way the stack grows. With Auto Loot off, Blizzard's loot window picks up the same style.
• Loot rolls: Horizon's own Need and Greed frames, matching your loot toast style by default. While the timer runs they show who has rolled and who is leading, whether the appearance is new to you, how the item level compares with what you're wearing, and whether it binds on pickup. Rolls below a quality you choose keep Blizzard's frame, so no roll goes missing. Off by default, and you can try a demo without a group.
• Alerts: Optional toasts for Great Vault rewards, low durability, nearly full bags, new mail, and friends coming online or going offline. Every kind starts off, so you switch on only the ones you want, each with its own threshold and colour.
• Auto Vendor: Sells your grey items when you open a merchant, with optional rules for unusable and low-level gear. Automatic repairs, from your own gold or the guild bank, are available but off by default.
• Talking Head: Restyles the NPC dialogue frame, with options to hide the portrait or mute the voice-over.
• Self Highlight: Uses Blizzard's "find yourself" outline, circle or icon, in combat, and optionally whenever you target an enemy. Off by default.
• Achievement Tracker: Removes achievements from your tracked list as soon as you earn them. Off by default.

🎯 Focus \[Objective Tracker\]
Your tracker shouldn't need babysitting. Focus keeps up with you: it surfaces nearby quests, updates as you move, and gets out of the way when you don't need it.
• Always relevant: Nearby quests rise to the top, and the list reorganises when you change zone. Delves, scenarios, raids and world events get their own sections with live progress bars and timers. Zone event quests appear under Events in Zone before you arrive and move to Current Event once you're inside.
• Proximity and auto-focus: Sort each section closest-first, and optionally super-track the nearest quest automatically. Toggle auto-focus with a key binding.
• Tracks everything: Achievements with full criteria progress, Endeavors and Decor for housing, transmog appearances, profession recipes and Traveler's Log objectives. One click opens the matching Blizzard panel.
• Recipe shopping lists: Tracked recipes list the reagents you need. Full reagent detail adds optional and finishing reagents. With Auctionator and the Auction House open, the magnifying glass runs a shopping search; right-click it to multiply every quantity by the number of crafts you want.…

addons.description:
The new Blackfathom Deeps is under Instances in the settings. Normal is the old 5 player instance only in regular Classic and 10 is the new version in Season of Disocvery. The game client considers the new BFD a 10 player instance/dungeon and not an actual raid.
Overview
AutoCombatLogger is a World of Warcraft addon that automatically enables or disables the combat log based on location. It's specifically tailored to control the logging based on the raid name and difficulty.

Logging can be controlled for the following locations:
• Raid (Can be customized per raid, raid size, and difficulty)
• Instances (Can be customized per instance, current only)
• Arenas (Can be customized per arena)
• Battleground (Can be customized per battleground)
• World
• Garrison
• Brawler's Arena

Currently, you cannot customize instances and world.

It also provides an LDB launcher and a minimap icon to control it.

Options are set under Interface Options or typing /acl.

addons.changelog:
First public snapshot from day one of the World of Warcraft: Forever beta (build 1.60.1.69893).

Addons (drop the folder into _classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns):
• ForeverCDM 0.3.4 - a cooldown manager that needs no Blizzard Cooldown Manager data (which is empty for Forever specs). Reads the spellbook and your auras directly. /fcdm opens the settings window.
• ForeverCompat 0.1.1 - loads first; defines the deprecated Retail globals Forever lacks so Retail addons stop crashing, adds /place to put abilities on bars while dragging is broken, and hosts the settings-loader workaround for the client not reading SavedVariables.

Also in the repo: the captured API surface (6,046 functions, 269 namespaces), a scanner that diffs any addon against it, a porting script, a secure-snippet guard, and a README of measured findings: the version-check trap, the missing loadstring_untainted, the saved-variables bug, the 100-error cap, and the in-combat aura lockdown.

Author: Thunderz. MIT.
addons.description:
Tools, findings, and three small addons for developing on the World of Warcraft: Forever beta
(build 1.60.1.69893, opened 2026-09-17). Everything here was measured against the live client,
not inferred from patch notes.

Author: Thunderz · Status: first-week snapshot, last updated 2026-09-24. Blizzard has started fixing the things below: build 1.60.1.70009 fixed secure snippets. Not every other row has been re-checked on that build.
Findings in one page
| Finding | Detail | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Interface number | 16001 (build line 1.60.x). Product folder _classic_beta_, exe WowB.exe. | Put 16001 first in ## Interface. |
| It is the Retail client | WOW_PROJECT_ID == WOW_PROJECT_MAINLINE. 269 C_* namespaces, Edit Mode, Cooldown Manager, the works. The old Classic globals are gone (GetItemInfo, GetSpellInfo, UnitAura, GetTalentInfo, GetMerchantItemInfo, CombatLogGetCurrentEventInfo…). | Port from your Retail code, not your Classic code. |
| The version-check trap | Almost every Retail addon tests select(4, GetBuildInfo()) >= 100000 to mean "modern client". Forever answers 16001, so they load Classic code paths or refuse to start. | tools/port_to_beta.py rewrites that idiom to 120100 in the copy. |
| Talents and Legacy trees | Both run on Retail's trait system (C_Traits). The Legacy panel is ToggleLegacySystemUI, unlocks at level 25, has a seasonal point cap. | Read trees with C_Traits; see ForeverBeacon's trait walker. |
| No Retail specializations | GetSpecialization and friends are absent; spec IDs are new (paladin = 1486). | Spec-keyed addon logic misbehaves. ForeverCompat bridges the calls. |
| Midnight restrictions carried over | C_Secrets, C_RestrictedActions, restricted combat log, built-in C_DamageMeter. Creature health and damage numbers are secret. | Threat meters and combat-decision addons cannot work. Reference and tracker addons are fine. |
| Registering an unknown event throws | e.g. LEARNED_SPELL_IN_TAB does not exist; RegisterEvent errors and aborts the file. | Wrap registration in pcall. |
| Secure snippets: fixed in build 70009 (was a Blizzard bug) | Before 1.60.1.70009 every WrapScript, onstate-, initialConfigFunction and RunAttribute threw "attempt to call a nil value", because Blizzard_RestrictedAddOnEnvironment/RestrictedExecution.lua:22 captured loadstring_untainted as nil. The cause, traced in forever-bugs #74, was load order: Blizzard_EnvironmentCleanup loads first and deletes that global (EnvironmentCleanup.lua:279), and its dependency on the restricted environment applied only to the Classic and Standard game types, so on Forever the cleanup ran before the capture. 70009 applies that dependency to every game type. Verified in game: a SecureHandlerBaseTemplate Execute snippet returns 42. | Action bars, click-casting and state drivers can work again. Never test with type(loadstring_untainted): it is nil after load on every client, Retail included, by design. An addon that probes that global switches its snippet features off for good (EllesmereUI did up to 9.2.8; 9.2.9 removed its snippet checks after this was reported in PR #2143). Test by running a snippet. tools/guard_secure_snippets.py relies on that probe and is obsolete. |…

History:
For longest time, I did not add support or Victory sounds or encounter music because it was already nicely done by a 3rd party addon called DBM-Victory sounds. However, this project seems long abandoned. Additionally, it's high time DBM supported these features built in.

Now that feature is built into DBM, I had to decide how to handle media. I liked how the overwatch and heroes and voice pack media worked so I continue this trend with Event Sounds system. Basically, DBM supports event sounds but doesn't include media for it by default. No one wants to download tons sound files every DBM update when none of sound files actually changed.

Additionally, I hope many download this template and learn to make their own Event Sound packs to further expand options. Today, DBM has couple dozen voice packs out there. Lets see if we can do same for Event Sounds! Please do so properly though. Don't go downloading latest Taylor Swift or Kanye album, make a mod with it and upload a music pack. Find some free to use media or get permission from the artist.

addons.description:
A full reskin of tooltips for WoW Forever. PrettyTooltip replaces the game's tooltip with a compact, ornamented panel: the icon and name up front, the details in short colored rows grouped by kind, and the fine print gathered in a footer. Hold ALT (or the key you choose) at any time to see the game's own tooltip.
Item tooltips
Top to bottom, an item panel shows:
• Header. The icon with an item level badge, the name in its quality color, and a subtitle with the item's type and slot, such as Mail · Head or Staff · Two-Hand. The subtitle also names what the game leaves unsaid: Consumable · Potion, Crafting Reagent, Scarce. The binding sits below it, with the required level at the right, red while you are below it. The whole panel is tinted by quality; quest items, and items that begin a quest, are tinted quest gold.
• Weapon damage. DPS as the prominent row, with damage and speed beneath it.
• Armor and stats. Armor, then the stats in two blocks: the primary attributes, and everything else under a divider. Long stat wording is shortened (see below), and each stat is colored by kind.
• Equip effects and enchants. Equip effects that are not a plain stat, such as a zone-limited speed bonus, join the stat list in green without the Equip: prefix. A chance on hit joins them too, marked with a small sword instead of its Chance on hit: prefix. Its numbers follow the spell tooltip's highlighting: a lighter school color when the description names that school's damage, or a neutral highlight otherwise. Holyfire blends Holy and Fire. These highlights follow Stat colors and a custom Equip effects color in the panel. Enchants follow as green rows marked with a sparkle, one per bonus: Enchanted: Stamina +1 and Armor +8 becomes +1 Stamina and +8 Armor.
• Use effects and flavor text, as the game words them, each use effect marked with a small gear instead of its Use: prefix.
• Item set. The set name and how many pieces you own, the pieces you own highlighted, and the set bonuses, with active ones highlighted.
• Disenchant. For green, blue, and purple armor and weapons: what the item disenchants into, each result with its icon, count, and chance, and the Enchanting it needs, red while your skill is too low and grey if you have no Enchanting. The chances are Classic's published tables (Warcraft Wiki's Disenchanting tables); the game has no way to ask. Turned off under Item Details in the style editor.
• Footer. Durability as a small bar, the crafter's name for crafted items, other requirements such as skills or classes, and the sell price as coins alone; a stack shows its total first, then the count and one item's price, dimmed (2g (20 × 10s)), which can be turned off under Item Details in the style editor.

While the game shows a comparison, the comparison panels are tagged Equipped, and the game's own "If you replace this item" stat changes appear among the rows at the bottom, in their usual green and red.

Recipes are the recipe first: their own icon and name, Plans · Blacksmithing beneath, and the skill they need beside the binding, red while yours is too low. The item they craft follows under Creates as a smaller card with its icon, name, slot, required level, and its own armor, stats, and effects, then the Reagents with their icons and how many you carry (4 / 10, red while short).
Shorter stats
Common Equip wordings become short stat rows:

| The game says | PrettyTooltip shows |
| --- | --- |
| Equip: Increases healing done by up to 48 and damage done by up to 16 for all magical spells and effects. | +48 Healing Power
+16 Spell Damage Power |
| Equip: Increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 12. | +12 Spell Power |
| Equip: Increases damage done by Fire spells and effects by up to 20. | +20 Fire Spell Damage Power |
| Equip: Improves your chance to get a critical strike by 1%. | +1% Critical Strike Chance |
| Equip: Increased Defense +2. | +2 Defense Skill |…

addons.changelog:
See what your WoW Forever server is missing — and fix it.
What's new in 1.3.3
• "Run again" no longer stays greyed out. A background analysis or locator run now always ends cleanly, even when Python cannot start or stops early, and a run that went silent (PC asleep, website stopped) no longer blocks the button. Before, it could stay disabled for up to 30 minutes.
• ForeverScribe positions are used at once. After an import that locates creatures, the locator runs by itself: the creatures your server needs and lacks show in The Forge › Spawns › Ready, marked seen in game (ForeverScribe). Select them, then Spawn….
Install in three steps (Windows)
1. Download ForeverTracker-1.3.3.zip below and unzip it anywhere. Updating: unzip over your folder, your config.ini and data/ are kept.
2. Double-click ForeverTracker.exe: it finds PHP and Python, starts the website and opens the setup wizard.
3. Follow the wizard: it finds your server and your game client by itself, tests the databases, asks for an administrator password and runs the first analysis.

Full guide: README · Spawns and imports · Changelog

addons.description:
Developed by FilinoDZ.

See what your WoW Forever server is missing — and fix it.

ForeverTracker compares the official World of Warcraft Forever client with your TrinityCore-based server. It lists
every resource Blizzard ships — dungeons, bosses, zones, quests, items, spells, talents, recipes, mounts, pets, toys,
achievements, flight points — checks whether players can really get or do each one on your server, explains why
when they cannot, and fixes it: missing core data, trainers, vendors, instances, creatures that were never spawned,
and loot, vendors and quests from world data files you import.

Français · Installation · The Forge · Spawns and imports · Configuration · Architecture · Changelog

• ForeverScribe 1.2.0 works with the game's newer addon API (C_MerchantFrame, C_Spell, C_CVar) as well as the older one. On clients without the old calls, vendors and casts were not noted. A game call that fails is now shown once in the chat (and kept in the notes) instead of failing silently.

Developed by FilinoDZ · MIT License · Unofficial tool, not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

See what your WoW Forever server is missing — and fix it.
What's new in 1.3.0
• ForeverScribe: a new addon for your game. While you play, it notes through the normal addon API what vendors sell (stock limits, costs), what creatures and chests drop (counted per corpse), who gives and takes quests, and where creatures stand. No character, realm or account name is kept.
• Automatic import: while ForeverTracker.exe runs, the new notes are imported every minute (each time you log out or /reload). The Forge › Imports previews and applies what your server lacks (vendors, loot, quest givers and enders), with a rollback. [collector] auto_apply = 1 applies them at once.
• Locator: creatures seen in game by ForeverScribe are placed where you met them, before Wowhead's positions.
• Vendors: the vendor search finds every creature by name or entry (the number in the Wowhead link), not only those already flagged as vendors, and says when a creature does not exist on your server. Selling at a creature adds the vendor flag it lacks, with its rollback.
• Spawning on the server: points without a nearby spawn to borrow a height from no longer end up under cities (Stormwind).

How to use ForeverScribe: The Forge › Imports › Install into the game (or Download the addon), play, then log out or /reload. Guide: Spawns and imports.
Install in three steps (Windows)
1. Download ForeverTracker-1.3.0.zip below and unzip it anywhere (for example next to your server). Updating: unzip over your folder, your config.ini and data/ are kept.
2. Double-click ForeverTracker.exe: it finds PHP and Python, starts the website and opens the setup wizard.
3. Follow the wizard: it finds your server and your game client by itself, tests the databases, asks for an administrator password and runs the first analysis.

You need: your TrinityCore WoW Forever server (a repack works) with its MySQL databases and data folder, the official game client on the same computer, PHP 8 with mysqli and Python 3.9+ (tick Add python.exe to PATH). Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the launcher is not signed: More info › Run anyway.

Full guide: README · Installation · Changelog

• Coverage of 13 resource types with a status, a score and the reason of every failed check; work list, search, English and French.
• Changelog of every client build, field by field, and in-game tooltips computed with the core's formulas.
• The Forge: core data (hotfixes), trainers, instances, vendors — previewed as SQL, applied in a transaction, safe to repeat (existing rows are never inserted twice), with a rollback in the history.
• Items: every item players cannot get, with the reason and the sources found in imported files.
• Spawns: the quest givers, objectives, vendors, trainers, rares and bosses nobody spawned, located on Wowhead's public maps and placed on the running server (core module .forge), in the database, or in game with the ForeverForge addon.
• Imports: world data files in WowPacketParser's SQL format — spawns, loot, vendors, quests, gossip — adding only what your server lacks.

addons.description:
Free tradeskill addons for WoW Forever. One download, one version; ForeverArtisan_Core is required, and each profession is its own module you can turn on or off in game (/fa).

Site, guides and feedback: https://foreverartisan.app
Layout
• ForeverArtisan_* – the fourteen addon folders (the game reads these through junctions in Interface\AddOns).
• docs\ – ARCHITECTURE.md (read first) and RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md.
• tools\release.py – sets the version in every TOC, syntax-checks, dates the changelog.
• tools\build_crafts.py – writes the crafting modules that share one engine (Alchemy, Leatherworking, Blacksmithing, Tailoring, Engineering, Enchanting) from tools\templates\. Edit the template, never the generated files.
Releasing
1. Add changes under ## x.y.z (unreleased) at the top of CHANGELOG.md as you go.
2. Run the in-game checklist in docs\RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md.
3. python tools\release.py . 0.9.2 – sets every TOC and dates the changelog.
4. GitHub Desktop: commit, then History > right-click the commit > Create tag v0.9.2 > Push origin.
5. The Release workflow builds the zip and uploads it to GitHub Releases, CurseForge and Wago.

Before launch builds are 0.9.x: they upload to the stores as Release so players can find them, and show no tag in game. Add -beta.N only for rough test builds (the stores hide those behind a Beta filter). Launch is 1.0.0; after that fixes are 1.0.1…, test builds 1.1.0-beta.1….

Tested on Classic WOTLK but should work on retail.

Type /mm or /macromanager to open the UI.

Built by Grumpy - Grumpyd on Nightslayer (Anniversary), Grumpy on Nazgrim (MoP Classic)
Features
• Clean and streamlined UI.
• Search and filter your macros.
• Uses the built-in macro system and your existing macros.
• Easily move macros between account-wide and character-specific.
• Share macros in chat like you share WeakAuras.
• Browse read-only snapshots of your other characters' macros, captured the last time each of them logged in.
UIUI - Character Macro SnapshotSpecial thanks to
• The kind folks at WoWUIDev Discord for helping me as I build my first addon.
• AceGUI for a great UI library.
• WeakAuras for the sharing code.
• LibAdvancedIconSelector for building a great icon picker.
• LargerMacroIconSelection for fixing the great icon picker to work with the latest APIs.

addons.changelog:
FlareUI 2.5.0
See when your interrupt is ready, jump straight to a setting from search, and spell ranks in the radial editor.
New
• Cast bars: an enemy's cast bar on the target, focus and boss frames turns green while your interrupt is ready (Kick, Pummel, Shield Bash, Counterspell, Earth Shock or Silence). While it's on cooldown the bar keeps its normal colour, and casts you can't interrupt stay grey.
• Settings: click the path above a search result to open its page, scrolled to the setting, which flashes briefly.
• Settings: new options can show a NEW label on their row, page and tab. Search for "new" to list them.
• Radial Menu editor: spells show their rank ("Frostbolt (Rank 3)"), so you can tell the ranks apart and search for one. Hovering a spell or item in the Catalog or the Buttons list shows its game tooltip.
Changed
• Unit, party, raid and boss frames: the hover highlight is brighter, a soft glow over the health bar that's easier to see.
• Settings: search ignores accents, so "ecran" finds "Écran".
Fixed
• Player and pet frames set to fade now stay visible while you're missing health.
• Cast bars: casts you can't interrupt now turn grey during combat too.
• Auto repair no longer says "Repaired" when you couldn't afford it. After selling junk it waits for the gold to arrive, then repairs.
• Auras: changing aura options no longer piles up hidden aura icons in the background.
FlareUI 2.4.5
Launch-day fixes: whisper tabs, Target of Target, and nothing reloads your UI in a fight.
Fixed
• Chat: a new whisper tab no longer opens with an empty window, and whisper tabs now fade in and out like your other chat windows.
• Target of Target and Target of Focus: health and power now update during the fight, not only when the target changes.
• Reload questions: if one was closed during combat, pressing Enter could still reload the UI. Enter now opens the chat as usual, and a dialog shown in combat no longer blocks your movement keys.
• Settings: closing the window in combat no longer leaves a clickable Reload now button on screen.
• Quest Tracker: Minimize in combat now works.
• Raid frames: Missing Buffs no longer throws errors when you die during a boss fight, and no longer marks members who are too far away to check.
• Raid frames: your own frame no longer flickers faded, and members whose range can't be checked are no longer faded.
• Quality of Life: turning the module off now puts back the game settings it changed (enemy nameplates, camera zoom, tutorials). Sync Blizz UI no longer copies "enemy nameplates off" from Combat Plates to your other characters.
• Radial Menu: Create macro now allows up to 30 character macros, and a Toggle keybind with no radial left no longer errors.
• Fake Cooldown Manager: bars no longer stay clickable after dropping a spell during combat.
• Target frame: the Elite & Rare icon follows changes, and an old ready check mark no longer shows on a new target.
• XP bar: hides more reliably when you reach max level.
FlareUI 2.4.4
Share your FlareUI profile as a text string.
New
• Profiles: Export and Import buttons under the profile options. Export shows the profile in use as a string to copy; Import takes a pasted string and adds it as a new profile (your current one is never overwritten). Radial menus and Blizzard's Edit Mode layouts aren't included.
Changed
• Profiles: the profile options sit in a Profile section.
• About: the note on copying links now ends the thanks line.
• Radial Menu: Game Menu is gone from the Panels library (it couldn't open the game menu from a radial).
FlareUI 2.4.3
Party frames in a row again, a modern combo bar for FlareUI Style, and Only My Buffs on the player frame.
New
• Party frames: Orientation is back (Vertical or Horizontal), between Style and Growth. In a row, Growth reads Right or Left. Each frame leaves room for its side auras, a pet or target on its right, and the ring in FlareUI and Forever Style.…
addons.description:
Your friendly UI overhowl for World of Warcraft: Forever.

FlareUI improves and extends Blizzard's own interface without replacing its look. Everything is split into modules you switch on one by one, so you only load what you actually use:
Action Bars, Unit Frames, Resource Bars, Buffs & Debuffs, Minimap, Chat, Damage Meter, Quest Tracker, Tooltips, Radial Menu and Quality of Life.

addons.description:
Updated and maintained fork of Atlas. This fork includes all maps from previous expansion map packs, as well as new SL, DF and TWW maps.
About Atlas
Atlas is an addon for World of Warcraft that includes detailed maps for every
instance in the game. Originally, Blizzard neglected to include maps for
instances. However, after a number of years Blizzard began to include official
maps for some instances. These official maps are in the same hand-drawn style
as the built-in world maps. Conversely, the Atlas maps are based on data used
by the minimap, which provides a more detailed, accurate, and colorful
representation. You can think of this as the difference between a street map
and a satellite image.

Furthermore, while the built-in maps mark the locations of some major bosses,
Atlas provides detailed and accurate information about all of the creatures,
NPCs, objects, and events you'll encounter in each dungeon. General information
about each zone is provided as well, including its location, level range,
player limit, attenuation requirement, and associated faction. All entrances,
exits, portals, and connections are labelled clearly. Because there are so many
instances in the game, you can categorize them by type, level, number of
players, continent, or expansion.

Finally, in addition to instances, Atlas comes with a handful of optional
components that add even more maps. These include outdoor encounter maps,
global transportation maps, dungeon location maps, and battleground maps. Each
optional component can be enabled, disabled or removed individually. A number
of third-party Atlas extensions are available as well, which further augment
the functionality of Atlas. AtlasLoot is the most popular of these, providing
detailed drop and item information for every encounter, but there are also
packages for quest information and major city maps as well.
Map Packs
Atlas (fork) v3 now includes the maps from the expansion addons (like Atlas Legion). It's recommended you disable or uninstall the expansion addons to prevent errors. The non-expansion addons (like Atlas Battlegrounds) aren't included directly, but will continue to work if you have those addons installed.
Past Contributors
• Arith - Project Manager
• dubcat - Artist
• Dynaletik - Co-author
• Resike - Co-author

addons.description:
Capture the moments that matter.

Memento is a World of Warcraft addon that automatically takes screenshots of selected gameplay moments. It works in the background while you keep playing.

> ⚠️ Important! This addon requires Arcane Wizard: Library. See Installation & Quick Start for installation details.
Key Features
Automated Screenshots - Choose which events trigger a screenshot and adjust how the images are captured.

Manual Screenshots - Take screenshots with a movable on-screen button and an optional countdown.
Features
Individual features and display options can be configured in the addon settings. Memento supports an account profile and character profiles.
Automated ScreenshotsRetail
• Captures level-ups, deaths, and logins.
• ✨ NEW Captures first visits to open-world zones and supported instances.
• Captures reputation rank and Renown increases.
• Captures personal achievements, guild achievements, and achievement criteria.
• Captures world boss victories.
• Captures boss victories and wipes in dungeons, raids, and scenarios.
• Captures Mythic+ dungeon completions.
• Captures completed Traveler's Log activities.
• Captures PvP events in duels, battlegrounds, arenas, and brawls.
• Captures new pets, mounts, toys, recipes, and housing decor.
• Captures special loot: items, gold, and currencies.
• Takes screenshots at regular intervals.
Forever
• Captures level-ups, deaths, and logins.
• ✨ NEW Captures first visits to open-world zones and supported instances.
• Captures reputation rank increases.
• Captures personal achievements.
• Captures boss victories and wipes in dungeons and raids.
• Captures PvP events in duels and battlegrounds.
• Captures new pets and recipes.
• Takes screenshots at regular intervals.
Classic
Shared by Classic, Burning Crusade - Classic Anniversary Edition, and Mists of Pandaria - Classic:
• Captures level-ups, deaths, and logins.
• ✨ NEW Captures first visits to open-world zones and supported instances.
• Captures reputation rank increases.
• Captures completed duels.
• Captures newly learned recipes.
• Takes screenshots at regular intervals.

Additional events in Mists of Pandaria - Classic:
• Captures personal and guild achievements.
• Captures new pets, mounts, and toys.
Manual Screenshots
• ✨ NEW Takes screenshots from a movable on-screen button.
• ✨ NEW Supports a custom key binding.
• ✨ NEW Offers an optional countdown from 1 to 10 seconds.
Capture Settings
• Each event can be activated separately.
• Automatic and manual screenshots have separate options to hide the user interface and show a capture notice with a timestamp.
• Supports JPEG, PNG, and TGA with adjustable JPEG quality.
• Offers several timestamp formats for chat notifications and the capture notice.
• A configurable sound effect can be played after a screenshot has been taken.
• Adds an adjustable delay between the event and the screenshot.
• In Retail and Forever, boss victories are saved, and screenshots can optionally be limited to the first victory per boss.
• In Mists of Pandaria - Classic and Retail, screenshots can optionally be taken for achievements already earned by another character.

[3.0.0] - 2026-11-01
In-game validation of audio playback and the recent Retail and Forever compatibility changes is still pending.
Added
• WoW: Forever / Camelot interface declaration (16001) and outgoing-message detection using the character name and surname API, with the previous name comparison retained as a fallback.
• Four integrated sound packs containing 148 extra sounds: Effect Pack 01 (61), Notification Pack 01 (48), Notification Pack 02 (27), and StarCraft Pack (12).
• A Sound packs settings page with individual toggles and a Reload UI button, including Brazilian Portuguese text. All packs are enabled by default; preferences are saved across configuration profiles and applied after reloading the UI.
• A README covering features, installation, configuration, game interfaces, sound packs, and support.
• Sound-pack regression tests covering defaults, saved preferences, reload behavior, independent activation, registration paths, and sound counts.
Changed
• Updated the Retail interface declaration from 120007 to 120105. Retained Mists of Pandaria Classic (50504) and Classic Era (11509).
• Integrated the sound-pack definitions directly into the main addon.
• Sound playback now reads directly from LibSharedMedia instead of depending on the sound-selection widgets' global table.
• Excluded development tests from release packages.
• Adopted the Keep a Changelog structure in CHANGELOG.md and configured tagged releases to publish only the matching version's notes.
Fixed
• Ignored words now treat Lua pattern characters, such as %, [ and +, literally while preserving existing case-sensitive word-boundary matching.
• Zone and custom channels now use independent notification intervals, so activity in one channel does not suppress another channel's notifications through the shared CHAT_MSG_CHANNEL timer.
• Missing or invalid sound references are skipped before playback. Failed playback attempts no longer consume the notification interval.
• Channel-specific rules now ignore unrelated chat events and avoid inspecting restricted channel names, IDs, or sender flags.
• Player-specific and ignore-list rules now skip invalid or restricted sender names safely.
• Added a local fallback for clients without the secret-value inspection function.
• Zone and Newcomer Chat settings no longer require their chat colors to be initialized before displaying their labels.
Removed
• Removed the four standalone sound-pack manifests and four redundant startup files. Each integrated pack now uses one sound-definition file and its audio assets.
addons.description:
Chat Sound Customizer adds configurable sound notifications to World of Warcraft chat, so you can hear incoming messages without constantly watching the chat window.

Choose different sounds for incoming and outgoing messages, individual players, player groups, and chat channels. The required libraries and extra sound packs are included.
Features
• Separate incoming and outgoing sounds for guild, officer, whisper, Battle.net whisper, party, raid, instance, community, say, yell, and emote messages where supported by the game client.
• Sound settings for General, Trade, Local Defense, Newcomer Chat, and custom channels.
• Custom sounds for individual players and user-defined groups of players.
• An ignore list for player names and words. Matching messages do not trigger notifications.
• A configurable notification interval to limit repeated sounds, with independent intervals for each zone or custom channel.
• Output through the Master, Sound Effects, Music, Ambience, or Dialog audio channel.
• Multiple chat types can be selected together to change their sounds in one step.
• Twelve built-in CSC sounds, Murloc Aggro, and four extra sound packs containing 148 sounds.
• Access to sounds registered by other addons through LibSharedMedia.
• Saved configuration profiles, a minimap launcher, and temporary muting.
• A LibDataBroker launcher for compatible display addons.

TemplateViewerv1.1.0 (2026-10-15)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Forever review fixes: beta-only addons, TOC selection tests, doc corrections
• Forever clients are beta/test builds today: the wiki lists only Forever Beta and Test
at 16001. So tools/flavors.lua gives Forever betaOrPTR = true, and its index keeps
OnlyBetaAndPTR addons. Blizzard\_PTRFeedback loads at login there, and UIPanelBugButton
is now in data/catalog\_forever.lua. Retail is unchanged. Flip the flag when Forever
launches.
• spec/toc\_spec.lua now checks that each flavor's client would pick that flavor's TOC,
following its suffix order through the existing tv TOCs, and that the packager
discovers it (BigWigs packager v2.6.1 release.sh:1402). This replaces tests that
restated the suffix config.
• ParseToc specs cover the forever game-type alias, in both inline and addon-level
directives.
• The fake client's flavor switch is internal: only WoWMock.Reset(flavor) switches it,
so loaded addons never carry over between flavors.
• Docs:
• side-effect counts per flavor (Retail 67, Forever 74);
• Forever's Camelot SharedUIPanelTemplates/NineSlice overrides;
• the Forever audit file path;
• the remaining Retail-only wording made flavor-neutral.
219 tests, luacheck clean.
• Support WoW Forever (tv\_Camelot.toc, Forever catalog, per-flavor fake client)
WoW Forever is a Mainline-family client: game type camelot (alias forever), build
1.60.1.70374, interface 16001. On this machine it is the \_classic\beta\ install. The
addon code needs no flavor branches. Everything tv uses exists at login on Forever, from
the same Blizzard\_SharedXML Mainline files: PortraitFrameTemplate, SearchBoxTemplate,
the ScrollBox list, InputBoxTemplate, UICheckButtonTemplate, both curated templates,
C\_XMLUtil and C\_AddOns. Only the template catalog differs per flavor.
• tv\_Camelot.toc: same files as tv.toc, Interface 16001, loads data/catalog\_forever.lua.
It uses \_Camelot because BigWigs packager v2.6.1 recognises that suffix
(release.sh:1175, :1402), not \_Forever; BetterBags ships \_Camelot too.
• tools/flavors.lua describes each flavor: TOC, catalog, source dir, the game types
matched by AllowLoadGameType/ExcludeLoadGameType, and what [Family]/[Game] expand to.
For Forever that's Mainline/Camelot, checked against folders like
Blizzard\_EditMode/Camelot.
• tools/ui\_source.lua builds one memoised index per flavor (UISource.For).
tools/generate\_catalog.lua writes every flavor's catalog. Forever has 3,280 templates,
708 from on-demand addons and 74 with side effects; there are 0 duplicates and 0
missing files.
• install-deps.sh pins the wow-ui-source forever branch (735496de, 1.60.1.70374) into
.libraries/wow-ui-source-forever.
• Fake client: WoWMock.Reset(flavor) and LoadTV(flavor) fake a given flavor's templates,
addons and GetBuildInfo. GetTemplateInfo skips undefined parents, because Blizzard's
Forever data has one gap: GarrisonMissionCompleteModelTemplate inherits a template
only Blizzard\_GarrisonUI defines, and that addon doesn't load on Forever.
• The FrameXML fakes were checked against Forever's source. What they model is
identical, or differs only in ways tv doesn't touch: HideUIPanel's extra EventRegistry
event, PortraitFrameBaseTemplate's focus mixin and hidden children, FitToText's
padding default, and ScrollBox SmartNav.
Specs:
• Both catalogs are checked for drift.
• Both TOCs are checked: files, own catalog only, Interface matches the source, and the
same file list.
• Every curated entry is checked on both flavors.
• Forever index facts: [Game]=Camelot, retail-only addons excluded, inline directives
applied.
• Login-inherits-on-demand and undefined-parent gaps are pinned per flavor.
• spec/forever\_spec.lua runs tv end to end on Forever: window, curated renders, clean
audit, anchors.
217 tests, luacheck clean. CI fetches both sources; docs cover the flavor table and how
to add another flavor.
addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon for previewing Blizzard's XML frame templates — like
TextureAtlasViewer, but for templates.

Pick a template from the list and tv builds a live instance of it with the client you are
running, so you see exactly how that template renders there: art, fonts, and any atlas
remaps that client applies. Underneath the preview, tv shows what the client reports
about the template — its widget type, what it inherits, its KeyValues, and the file that
defines it — plus the addon it comes from and the size the instance rendered at.

Every template is listed: the ~3,600 that Blizzard's UI defines (including those of
addons that load on demand) plus any other addon's templates the client knows about.
Curated templates come first. Many templates render nothing useful until they are given
text, a title or data, so a curated entry carries a small setup that does what
Blizzard's own UI would do, and renders as soon as you select it. Everything else renders
raw, without setup, when you ask for it.
Usage
• /tv or /templateviewer toggles the window; /tv opens it with the search
filled in. Search matches template names first, then a curated template's category or
another template's addon, then descriptions.
• Curated templates have gold names. For any other template, Render builds it raw;
tick Auto-render to render templates as you select them. Building a template runs
its scripts and the instance stays until you /reload, which is why it isn't automatic.
• Some templates change Blizzard's UI when built: they create frames with fixed global
names (replacing Blizzard's frames of that name) or register with Edit Mode. tv warns
before rendering those (Render anyway), Auto-render skips them, and /reload puts
everything back.
• Templates from addons that load on demand are dimmed until their addon is loaded;
Load loads it, which runs that Blizzard addon for the rest of the session.
• Scroll on the preview to zoom, drag to pan; Reset View fits the template back into
view, Background cycles the backdrop colour.
• Click the template name field to select it for copying.
• /tv audit compares the client's C_XMLUtil.GetTemplates() with tv's catalog and saves
the report to the TemplateViewerAudit SavedVariable (written on /reload or logout).
• The window won't open in combat and closes when combat starts, because some templates
are protected.
Status
Supports Retail and WoW Forever; each loads its own list of the templates its client
defines, so the same template can be compared across both. Curated so far:
UIPanelButtonTemplate, ButtonFrameTemplate. Classic flavors are planned.
addons.name: tv
