[0.5.0] - 2026-10-22
This version no longer exchanges with the earlier ones: everyone needs it to keep sharing.
Added
• Characters: your record now keeps each linked character's race, and when it reached the highest level, for features to come.
• Updates: once a session, Who's Who tells you in chat when another player's is a newer release than yours (any newer version while yours is a pre-release). You can turn it off in the settings, under Updates.
• /ww status and the Diagnostic page show the newest Who's Who version another player's add-on announced this session.
• Guilds: in My identity, "In my guilds" sets a nickname and a main for each guild your characters are in; only that guild's members see them.
• Guild requests: the guild master and officers can suggest a nickname or a main to a member, from the right-click menu in the Guild tab; the member accepts, edits or refuses it. Officers see each request, and whether it's done, in the member's panel and in a Requests list, and dismiss it there.
• Guild invites: from a character outside your guild, "Invitation…" on its line in My identity's "In my guilds" asks the guild's officers you know of to invite it (or whisper ginv to one); the officer is asked whether to invite it when another character of your identity is in the guild. • People: a player's old identity, whose characters now show under their new one, no longer stays in your saved data without any character.
• Guild sharing: in a group, the characters a guild enforcing linking adds to your record are no longer sent to group members outside that guild.

[0.4.3] - 2026-10-19Fixed
• Guild links: a member who logged in while no officer they had met was online no longer stays without the guild's links for the session: an officer passes them on as soon as one is online.
• Guild lists: a member whose list was more recent but lacked the guild's links or other members no longer waits for luck to get them: the first member holding them who takes that list announces its own back, and the member takes it.

[0.4.2] - 2026-10-19Changed
• Guild lists: in a large guild, Who's Who no longer freezes the game for a moment each time it announces you or receives a guild list: your own list is hashed again only when it changed.

• Messages from other players: Who's Who no longer handles them during combat, and handles at most one record or guild list per frame, so a burst of them no longer lowers your frame rate.
• Combat: Who's Who no longer checks signatures or sends records and guild lists during combat; they wait for its end.
Fixed
• Mac: Who's Who could fail to load on Mac, leaving an empty window on screen.

[0.4.1] - 2026-10-18Fixed
• Guild lists: logging out no longer makes guild members ask you for your guild list or settings, which you could no longer send.

addons.description:
Mentor and new-player matchmaking for WoW Forever. Flag a character as a
Sprout (new or returning, looking for help) or a Mentor (experienced,
offering help), see who else on your realm cluster has done the same, and
whisper or invite them from a roster window.
Usage
| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| /sprout | Toggle the roster window |
| /sprout role off\|sprout\|mentor | Set this character's role |
| /sprout note | Set the note others see next to your name (max 80 chars) |
| /sprout config | Open the settings panel |
| /sprout status | Show channel and roster status |
| /sprout debug | Toggle protocol logging in the chat frame |

A minimap button opens the roster on left-click and settings on right-click;
it can be hidden in settings. The roster window has two boxes, Sprouts and Mentors. Each row shows name,
level, class and zone. Left-click a row to whisper; right-click for Whisper,
Invite to party and Add/Edit private note. Hovering a row shows the player's
note and your own private note about them. Private notes are account-wide;
role and own note are per character.

Players are identified by their Forever name, "First Surname". There are no
realms on Forever; any -Realm suffix the client attaches is ignored.

Scope: discovery runs over a hidden custom chat channel, so it reaches your
connected-realm cluster and faction, not the whole game.
How it works
• On login the addon silently joins a hidden custom channel
(JoinTemporaryChannel with no chat frame) and retries until the channel
list has populated. Join/leave notices for it are filtered from chat.
• Presence is exchanged with addon messages over that channel using a
registered prefix. Messages are version;TYPE;key=value;... strings, so
fields can be added later without breaking older clients.
• Each active player broadcasts a heartbeat (HB) with role, level, class,
zone, note and its own heartbeat interval. The interval starts at 2 minutes
and stretches as the roster grows (up to 10 minutes) so per-client traffic
stays roughly flat on crowded clusters. BYE is sent when switching to Off
and, best effort, on logout.
• Roster entries expire after 3 missed heartbeats of the sender's own
interval. The roster is in memory only and rebuilt every session.
• WHO is sent on joining the channel and, for the first 2 minutes after
that, when the window is opened or refreshed. Beyond that heartbeats have
already filled the roster and WHO is not sent. Active peers answer HERE
after a 0-10 s random delay; requests arriving while a reply is pending
share that one reply, so bursts of logins do not multiply traffic.
• Characters set to Off still join the channel and can browse, but never
announce themselves or answer WHO.
• Sending goes through AceComm and ChatThrottleLib, which paces traffic and
re-queues messages the client rejects with the addon-message throttle.
Performance notes
Nothing runs per frame; all work is event or timer driven. Per client, a
heartbeat costs a few string matches and one small table, and roster memory
is a few hundred bytes per player. The roster window keeps a fixed pool of
row frames (only as many as fit on screen) and rebinds them to the visible
slice of the sorted roster, so drawing cost does not grow with population.
While open it redraws at most once per second on roster changes.
Layout

Levelbound1.2.1
Fixes:
• Leveling up outside a group no longer raises an "AddOn tried to call the protected function" error. The
game blocks addons from sending emotes on their own, so Emote Level-Up Message is now Print Level-Up Message and
shows the line in your own chat instead.
1.2.0
Gain indicator:
• The gain indicator can sit to the right or left of its bar, centered on it. Where there is no room beside the
bar, such as in fullscreen, it sits above that end of the bar instead.
• With segmented bars, gains beside the bar gather in one stack next to the whole row, labeled by type as when
detached, and grow in the chosen direction.
• A new Animate switch, on by default. Turned off, the indicator and the detached stack appear in place and fade
without moving.
• A new Animation Style for indicators beside the bar or detached: Rise, as before, or Slide Outward, away from
the bar. With Slide Outward, the segmented and detached stacks line up side by side instead of on top of each
other, and the detached stack can grow left or right.
• The Gain Indicator and progress type previews show the indicator beside the bar when it is set there.

Party level-up notices:
• Two new anchors, Right of Bar and Left of Bar, place the notices beside the bar, the first one centered on it.
Where there is no room beside the bar, they sit above that end of the bar instead.
• The same Animation Style as the gain indicator, for notices beside the bar or detached: Rise, as before, or Slide
Outward, with the notices side by side growing away from the bar. Detached, they can grow left or right.

Fixes:
• When a type gains again while its line is still in the detached stack, that line moves to the front, so the
stack's lines fade from the oldest first instead of an older line sliding back before it fades.
• All new text is translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and
Chinese.
1.1.0
New looks:
• A first-time install now asks you to choose a style: Blizzard or Modern, each with a preview of the experience bar.
• Blizzard border: the default experience bar's own frame, with beveled ends, Blizzard's dividers and the bar at
Blizzard's height. Text inside the bar is turned off, since there is no room for it.
• Levelbound Blizzard bar texture: the default experience bar's two-tone fill, in any bar color.
• Pip party markers: Blizzard's rested-experience tick, in each member's class color. On the Blizzard border they
start at Blizzard's own size and place.
• The 1 Pixel and 2 Pixel borders are now one Pixel border with a Border Width from 1 to 10. Your saved border is
kept.

More control:
• XP dividers can mark every 10% or every 5% of a level.
• Party markers can sit on the bar's center, top or bottom edge, with a vertical offset. Top-Edge Notch is now
Notch and points into the bar from either edge.
• Bar width moves in 1-pixel steps and can go up to your screen's width.
• Text shown on hover now fades in and out.
• Your level-ups are announced as an emote to players nearby while you are not in a group, so others see
Levelbound in action. It is on by default and can be turned off on the Level-Ups page's Announcements tab.
• Level-up messages in emote, party and guild chat now start with a star icon.

A tidier settings window:
• Settings are split into tabs. Layout, Appearance, Text and Visibility share one Layout page; the Gain
Indicator, each progress type, Markers and Level-Ups have tabs of their own.
• Every page has a short description under its title.
• A bar's own size and each text slot's style show whether they follow the shared setting, with a button to go
back to it.
• Previews keep the same size as you change settings, and draw bars at a steady width.
• The Appearance preview replays the gain effect while Gain Shimmer is on; hovering the Markers preview fades the
markers in as on the real bar.
• More of each preview can be clicked to find its setting: the ring around a bar finds Border Style even with no…
addons.description:
Levelbound replaces Blizzard's experience and reputation bars with its own. It shows how far you are through the level, how much rested and turn-in XP you have waiting, how fast you're leveling this session, and where the rest of your party is.

Download on CurseForge. Works on Retail and WoW: Forever.
Experience bar
• Rested XP and XP from completed quests you haven't turned in are drawn on the bar in their own colors.
• The bar tracks your XP per hour for the current session and estimates your time to the next level, pausing while you AFK.
• Time played, time at this level and session time are all available as text or in the tooltip.
• Custom notice for gaining exp.
Other progress
Levelbound also tracks these, when your game version has them:
• Pet XP
• Reputation
• Honor
• House Favor
• Neighborhood Endeavors
• Trading Post

Put them all on one segmented bar, stack them as connected bars, or place each bar separately with its own size.
Party markers
Party members who also run Levelbound show up as markers on your XP bar, placed at their own progress toward their next level. Hover a marker for detailed information on their progress and rate. When a party member levels up, you get a notice on screen, a chat line and a sound. Each one can be turned off.

Markers work in 5-player groups, including dungeon finder groups, and hide automatically in raids.
Sharing
• Shift-click a bar to put a line like [Levelbound] Level 42 · 63% · 18.4k to go · ~1h 12m at 48k XP/hr in your chat box.
• /lb share party (or instance, raid, guild, say) sends the line directly.
• Optionally announce your own level-ups to party or guild, and post an XP summary at the end of a dungeon or delve.
Customization
In-depth customization options so you can tailor the visuals to your liking.

Open settings with /lb, the minimap button or the addon compartment.

/lb edit opens edit mode, where you can drag the bars into place.
Translating
Translations are welcome by pull request. See TRANSLATING.md.

addons.description:
A World of Warcraft: Forever addon that replaces the bottom of the screen with
the Warcraft III console, with a theme for every playable race: Human, Dwarf,
Gnome, Night Elf, Orc, Tauren, Troll, Undead (Forsaken or Scourge) and
Skyborne (High Order and Windshapers).

The console is a port of a WoW 1.12 console addon: its layout, art, fonts and options menu,
rebuilt for the current engine (Edit Mode, secret values, protected frames).
All console art and the font in ReforgedUI/art are the original addon's. Reforged UI
adds the top bar with the day/night clock and data broker feeds.
What it does
Left to right, as in the original addon with its "Center UI" option, which is always on:
the console sits in the middle of the screen with the original addon's chat width (on a
16:9 screen it fills the width, on 21:9 and 32:9 screens the rest of the
screen stays free on either side).
• Minimap block: a square minimap with mouse-wheel zoom, the zone name on
its bottom or top edge, the tracking button in the round slot below it, the
mail slot (a grey letter when there is no mail) and three action slots
beside it. Other addons' minimap buttons go in a compartment: click the bag
just above the map's top-right corner to open or close a flyout of them
(Blizzard's own buttons line up along the top edge of the map); the minimap's day/night indicator is hidden (the top bar has the
clock).
• Portrait block: animated 3D portrait (click to target yourself,
right-click for your menu), health and power bars under it, rest/combat,
group leader and PvP icons. The background pulses red under the low health
threshold.
• Hero screen: name, level and class, the experience bar with rested
experience (hover for the numbers, right-click for its colour: purple,
blue or none) and four stat icons. Each shows main hand, off hand (block
chance and value with a shield), ranged, ammo (yellow under 400, red under
200), spell power, healing, armour (the default for the fourth),
strength, agility, intellect (with Warcraft III's hero attribute art),
crit chance (the best of melee, ranged and spell, with the Blademaster's
Critical Strike icon) or nothing (an empty socket), chosen per class from each icon's right-click menu
or the options menu. Druid forms and Ghost Wolf swap
the icons like the original addon.
• Target: by default the hero screen switches to your target, as
selecting a unit in Warcraft III: its portrait, name (coloured by reaction
or class), level and classification, health and power bars with numbers,
your combo points and its cast bar. Your own bars under the portrait stay
yours; clearing the target brings your hero back. "Wall plate" in the
options (or /rui target plate) instead puts the target in a small
portrait arch standing on the wall above the stats panel. Either way the
target's target is a small unit icon above the portrait (blue when it is
you, else green, yellow or red), with the target's buffs and debuffs
beside it (above the plate in plate mode). Those are Blizzard's own aura
icons: in combat the game lets no addon read a target's auras, so
Blizzard's target frame stays with everything but its auras made
invisible, and the "Reforged UI" Edit Mode layout places it (buffs on
top) so the icons land there.
Left-click targets, right-click opens the unit menu.
For the target's health nearer the middle of the screen, the options'
"Target bar" (or /rui targetbar on) adds a small free-standing bar with
its name, level, health and power, in either mode. It is click-through
until you hold Shift out of combat (or open Edit Mode), then drag it anywhere; its place
is saved on its own and never touches the Edit Mode layout.
• Action grid: action bars 1-3, twelve slots each. These are Blizzard's
own buttons, moved into the grid and reskinned, so bindings, paging,
cooldowns and proc glows work as usual. The stance buttons (Paladin auras,
Warrior stances, Druid forms, ...) stand in a row on the wall above the grid,…

Feed text was always anchored to the right of the icon, even when the
feed has no icon, so the zone name lost 16 pixels and truncated early.
Anchor it to the slot's left edge when there is no icon.

Reforged UI1.8.0 (2026-10-20)
Full Changelog Previous Releases
• Add a pet unit icon, and the theme's trim on it and the target of target (#27)
The pet gets a Warcraft III unit icon beside the target of target: name, portrait, health and power, its buffs and debuffs above, and a hunter's pet's happiness face with Blizzard's tooltip (C\_PetInfo). Shift-drag moves it; /rui pet reset puts it back. Both icons wear the theme's trim, and the target of target's reaction shows as a gem on it, crossed swords when an enemy has you targeted.

The pet buttons were locked in a row beside the stance buttons that ran past
the grid over the inventory and into the chat area, and couldn't be moved.

With the top bar hidden (menu checkbox or /rui topbar off), Blizzard's micro buttons stand on the minimap block's wall between the left end cap and the addon compartment, in up to three rows; the compartment's flyout opens above them when it would cover them, and buffs still where we put them move up to the screen's top edge.

addons.description:
Record your WoW: Forever journey from level 1 to 60, then relive it on the web.

Journey Forever turns the saved files your addons already write into a recap page for each character: the path you walked, levels, quests, dungeons, loot, gold, deaths, and screenshots of the big moments.
How it works
1. Play. Install the Journey Forever addon (plus, optionally, Road to Sixty and Journey Tracker for path and stats data).
2. Log out. WoW writes each addon's SavedVariables file to disk.
3. Upload. Drag your WTF\Account\ folder and your Screenshots folder onto the website.
4. Share. Each character gets a journey page, private by default, public with one switch.
What's in this repo
| Folder | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| addon/ | The in-game addon: automatic screenshots (dungeon cleared, epic loot, level up) and /jf note entries. |
| website/ | The site that reads your saved files and builds the journey pages. Hosted on Cloudflare; its README covers running it locally and deploying. |

Arc Weave changelog1.0.3New Features
• Auto Shot tab - A new Auto Shot tab next to Auto Attack. Pick abilities that also start Auto Shot on your target. An ability on both tabs shoots at range and keeps fighting in melee range. Off by default.
• Choose when the queue goes off - The Queue tab can queue your next-attack ability before or after the button's own spell. Before is now the default, so an ability that starts your attack, like Strider Kick, carries the queued Raptor Strike on its very first swing.
Improvements
• Works with EllesmereUI and Bartender4 bars - Picking abilities, keybinds and every pick now work on EllesmereUI and Bartender4 action bars, not only on Blizzard's bars.
1.0.2New Features
• Start your auto attack - A new Auto Attack tab under Next Melee Weave. Pick abilities that also start your auto attack on your target. Off by default.
• Pick the rank to queue - The Queue tab can queue a specific rank of your next-attack ability, for example a cheaper one, instead of always your highest. Highest rank stays the default.
• Pet abilities by family - Pet Weave can make a pet family use one of its own abilities instead of attacking, like a Wind Serpent's Lightning Breath. Afterwards the pet can keep fighting, stay where it is, or follow you so it never runs into melee. Pets without a rule attack as before.
• Pet choice per ability - On the Pet Weave Abilities list, each picked ability can follow your pet rules or always send your pet in to attack.
1.0.1New Features
• Queued swing bar color - A new option on the Swing Timer tab colors the main-hand swing bar while a next-melee ability like Raptor Strike is queued, so you can see at a glance that your next swing will use it. Give each tracked ability its own color on the Tracked tab, with a default color for the rest. The bar goes back to normal as soon as the attack lands or you cancel it. Off by default.
• Queued tick rides the swing - The Swing Timer tab's "Ready or queued marker" choice has a new option, Queued rides the swing: once you queue an ability, its tick and icon ride the swing bar's moving fill to where the attack lands. The other two choices, stays where it came back and jumps to where the swing lands, work as before.
Bug Fixes
• Macros on picked buttons - Picked action bar buttons that hold a macro now run the macro again. Before, pressing them only sent your pet.
1.0.0
First public release, for WoW Forever.
New Features
• Ticks on the swing timer - Your next-melee abilities (Raptor Strike, Heroic Strike, Maul, Cleave) are drawn on Blizzard's swing bar, so you can see when each comes back and on which swing it lands. Gold means it is back during this swing, amber +N means N swings out, green means ready, blue means queued, red means further out.

addons.description:
Weave abilities and pet commands into your swing rhythm, in WoW Forever.

No macros needed. /arcweave opens the options.
Next Melee Weave
• Queue a next-attack ability - pick the ability to queue (Raptor Strike, Heroic Strike, Maul, Cleave) and then pick which of your abilities queue it. Press Mongoose Bite, Wing Clip or drop a trap, and Raptor Strike is queued for your next swing at the same time. It stays queued even if you spam the button.
• Pick the rank to queue - your highest rank by default, or a specific rank, for example a cheaper one.
• Ticks on the swing timer - your next-melee abilities drawn on Blizzard's swing bar, so you can see when each comes back and on which swing it lands. Gold = back during this swing, amber +N = N swings out, green = ready, blue = queued, red = further out.
• Queued marker - a queued ability's tick stays where it came back, jumps to where the swing lands, or rides the swing bar until the attack lands.
• Queued swing bar color - the swing bar changes color while an ability is queued, with its own color for each ability.
• Off-hand lane - the same ticks on the off-hand bar when you dual-wield.
• Start your auto attack - picked abilities also start your auto attack on your target.
• Start Auto Shot - picked abilities also start Auto Shot. An ability picked for both shoots at range and keeps fighting in melee range.
Pet Weave
• Send your pet from your own buttons - pick the abilities that should also send your pet at your target, on their keybinds and on mouse clicks. The ability itself still casts normally.
• Pet abilities by family - have a pet family use one of its own abilities instead of attacking, like a Wind Serpent's Lightning Breath. Afterwards it can keep fighting, stay where it is, or follow you so it never runs into melee. Pets without a rule attack as before.
• Pet choice per ability - each picked ability can follow your pet rules or always send your pet in to attack.
• Stays out of the way in vehicles and pet battles - your keybinds go back to normal there automatically.
How picking works
You pick abilities by clicking them on your action bars. Picks follow the ability, not the slot: move it to another button and it keeps working, and a second copy on another bar works too. Macros on your bars can be picked too, and it works on Blizzard, EllesmereUI and Bartender4 action bars. Small corner markers show what each picked button does.

Needs Blizzard's swing timer turned on for the tick display.

Made by Arc. WoW Forever only.

addons.changelog:
Forever Item Finder changelog1.2.0New Features
• Item tooltips: hover an item to see whether it is new or changed in Forever, and how to get it (Settings > Items > Tooltips).
• Alt+click: Alt+click an item in your bags or a chat link to open it in the Item Database.
• Guild and group sharing: finds also reach your guild and group.
Bug Fixes
• Mounts: mounts no longer show as changed from Classic.
1.1.0New Features
• What changed: a button in the item box shows what changed from Classic.
• Map counts: see how many items each zone and dungeon holds (Settings > Places on the Map).
• Zone filter: show one zone's items in the Item Database.
• Found bar: see how many new items have been found so far.
• Quest items: a new Quest category.
Improvements
• Truer changes: changed items now match what actually differs from Classic.
• Map tooltips: hover a marked item on the map for its full tooltip.
1.0.4Bug Fixes
• Map pins in every zone: favorites and marked items now show on the World Map in zones you have explored, instead of being hidden under the map.
1.0.3Improvements
• Question marks last: items with no picture (shown as a question mark) now sit at the bottom of the Item Database, so the list opens on items you can recognize.
Bug Fixes
• Map marks stay: an item you mark with Mark on Map stays on your maps after a reload or a new session, until you take the mark off.
1.0.2Improvements
• Troublemakers can be shut out: players who abuse the sharing channel can be banned, and everyone's addon then ignores their finds and requests.
• Fewer wrong mutes: players who reload a lot, or run a newer version of the addon, are no longer muted by others.
1.0.1New Features
• New finds count: the Live Feed tab shows how many finds from other players came in since you last looked, and the minimap button's tooltip says it too.
Improvements
• Smooth logins: when many finds arrive at once after you log in, the open window takes them in with a light update every couple of seconds instead of redrawing for each one.
• Lighter map pins: favorites on the World Map, continent maps and minimap use far less CPU when zooming, moving and loading in after login.
• Sharing stays up: if someone takes over or locks the sharing channel, the addon moves everyone to a backup channel on its own.
• Only real names: creature, zone and finder names on shared finds come only from the game and the addon's own data, so nobody can put their own words on a find.
• Lighter in raids: when a whole raid sees the same new loot, a few players' addons share it instead of everyone's.
Bug Fixes
• Every find gets shared: items you find while no one else with the addon is online now reach other players once they come online, instead of staying only in your copy.
1.0.0
• Initial release.
addons.description:
Finds new and changed items in World of Warcraft: Forever, shares them with other players, and keeps a searchable
database of what drops where.
Features
• Item Database: every known Forever item, searchable by name or zone, filtered by level, quality, slot, class,
source, zone, and dungeon or raid.
• What changed: one click shows what changed from Classic, better in green, worse in red.
• Where it drops: bosses, mobs, vendors, quests and containers, with map pins.
• Favorites on your map: star the items you want and they show on your World Map, at the spot or the dungeon
where they drop.
• Map counts: how many items each zone and dungeon holds (Settings > Places on the Map).
• Live Feed: new and changed items you and other players find, newest first, with where each one dropped.
• Pop-ups: a card when a new find comes in, filtered the way you choose.
• Found bar: how many of the new items players have found so far.
• Sharing: finds go to other players on your ruleset, your guild and your group by themselves, under your
character's name or anonymously.
Use
/fif opens the window. So does the minimap button. Alt+click an item in your bags or in a chat link to open it in
the Item Database.

Known Issues:
==============

==============
= Change Log =
==============

v1.54.04 (Oct. 20, 2026)

• Enhancement:
• Create mapNPCButtonClearMarker() and mapNPCButtonSetMarker() to centralize map's labeling adding, not just for large frame, but also
for both normal and small Atlas frames
• Map module which would like to use dynamap labeling should set DynamicMarkers = true in map data

addons.description:
Atlas is the core map browser and plugin framework for the World of Warcraft
Atlas addon family.

> Maps are installed separately. Install Atlas together with at least one
> compatible map module or plugin. This repository contains the core addon,
> not the complete collection of Atlas maps.
Overview
Atlas displays detailed maps and reference information supplied by separately
installed map modules and plugins.

Available content depends on your installed packages and WoW client version.

addons.description:
Dungeon location maps for the World of Warcraft Atlas addon.

Atlas Dungeon Locations is an optional Atlas plugin that provides maps showing
where dungeons are located. It requires the Atlas core addon and does not run
as a standalone addon.
addons.name: Atlas-Dungeon-Locations

addons.description:
Transportation maps for the World of Warcraft Atlas addon.

Atlas Transportation is an optional Atlas plugin for browsing transportation
nodes on the maps included in the package. It requires the Atlas core addon
and does not run as a standalone addon.

addons.description:
Coordinates Tracking is a lightweight World of Warcraft addon that displays your current map coordinates on-screen and on the World Map.

It is designed for players who want clear, configurable coordinate information for exploration, questing, gathering, farming, travelling, and following map-based guides.
FeaturesOn-Screen Coordinates
Coordinates Tracking provides a movable on-screen coordinate frame that shows your current position.
• Drag the frame to any position outside combat.
• Right-click the frame to open the options panel.
• Reset the frame position from the options panel if it is moved off-screen.
• Optionally show your current zone name alongside the coordinates.
• Show the zone name in a tooltip when the zone-name display is disabled.
World Map Coordinates
The World Map can display:
• Your current player coordinates.
• The coordinates beneath the mouse cursor.

This makes it easier to follow coordinate-based guides, locate points of interest, and share map locations with other players.
LibDataBroker Support
Coordinates Tracking supports LibDataBroker (LDB).

If you use a compatible LDB display addon, you can show coordinate information in its panel and disable the on-screen coordinate frame for a less cluttered interface.
Appearance and Precision
Customize the coordinate display to suit your interface:
• Font face, size, color, and outline.
• On-screen frame scale, background, and transparency.
• World Map coordinate font settings.
• Tooltip scale and transparency.
• Number of decimal places shown for coordinates.
Why Coordinates Tracking?
Coordinates Tracking focuses on providing essential coordinate information without adding waypoint navigation, map markers, or unnecessary interface complexity.

It is a straightforward option for players who want to see their position, check World Map cursor coordinates, and customize how that information appears.

addons.description:
Currency Tracking is a lightweight, standalone World of Warcraft addon that displays your selected currencies and stackable items directly on your game screen.

Use the movable tracking frame to keep important resources visible wherever you prefer. Track currencies alongside stackable items such as meat, crafting materials, parts, potions, herbs, and other profession-related items.

Hover over the on-screen tracker to view a tooltip containing your available currencies. You can also choose to display your character's total money.
Features
• Track selected currencies directly on your screen
• Track selected stackable items, including crafting materials and consumables
• Move the tracking frame anywhere on the screen
• Show or hide item and currency amounts
• Optionally show your total gold, silver, and copper
• Optionally hide entries with a zero quantity
• Configure icon placement, scale, transparency, and layout
• Set a maximum number of tracked entries per row
• Automatically hide the tracking frame during combat, pet battles, or battlegrounds
• View your currency information in a tooltip
• Right-click the tracker to open the addon options
How to use
Manage tracked currencies and items from the addon's options window.

When the on-screen tracker is visible, right-click a tracked currency or item to open the options directly. From there, you can choose what to track and customize display settings such as icon order, visibility, scale, transparency, and frame position.

You can track as many currencies and items as your screen layout allows.
Compatibility
• Supports LibDataBroker (LDB) displays
• Supports Titan Panel
• Compatible with ElvUI
• Supports current World of Warcraft clients as listed in the project file information
Donations
If you enjoy Currency Tracking and would like to support its continued development, donations are greatly appreciated—no matter the amount.

addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon library for retrieving currency information and
localized currency-category metadata.
Overview
LibCurrencyInfo is an embedded library for World of Warcraft addon authors.

It combines live currency information from the WoW client with curated
currency-category data maintained by the library. It provides currency
categories, localized category names, category-membership lookups, and formatted
currency tooltip text.

LibCurrencyInfo does not provide a standalone user interface or gameplay
feature by itself.
Features
LibCurrencyInfo provides:
• Live currency information by currency ID.
• Library-maintained currency categories and category membership.
• Localized category names for supported WoW locales.
• Currency IDs grouped by category.
• Formatted currency tooltip text suitable for use in GameTooltip.
• A positional-return API for compatibility with existing addons.

Depending on the running WoW client and the requested currency, live currency
information can include the current quantity, icon file ID, weekly progress,
weekly cap, total cap, discovery state, and quality.

addons.description:
A lightweight boss-warning addon for WoW: Forever.

ForeverBoss is built for players who want useful encounter warnings without turning the screen into a cockpit. It stays out of the way until something actually matters, shows one clear warning, then disappears.
What it does
• Automatically warns for boss casts the client marks as interruptible.
• Supports curated warnings such as MOVE, DEFENSIVE, DISPEL, STACK, SPREAD, and STOP.
• Uses a single compact warning near the top-center of the screen.
• No permanent boss window.
• No giant timer stack.
• No automatic chat spam.
• Sound is off by default.
• Includes a debug mode for capturing spell IDs and encounter IDs during live testing.
Commands
• /fboss test — show a sample warning.
• /fboss mute — toggle warning sounds.
• /fboss debug — toggle debug capture for boss casts.
• /fboss on — enable the addon.
• /fboss off — disable the addon.
• /fboss status — show current settings.
• /fboss reset — reset settings to defaults.
Current status
ForeverBoss is in its first WoW: Forever testing build. The warning engine is ready, but the curated mechanic database will only contain mechanics that have been verified against Forever data or live gameplay. We are intentionally not shipping guessed boss mechanics.

addons.description:
Forever DPS v0.1.0
A deliberately simple DPS meter for World of Warcraft: Forever.

The goal is not to replace a full combat-analysis suite. Forever DPS answers one question quickly:

> How am I doing compared with the rest of the group?
What it shows
• Live DPS ranking from Forever's server-side C_DamageMeter data.
• Class-colored bars.
• Your own row highlighted.
• A persistent YOU: #x / y readout during combat.
• After combat: your DPS and your percentage of the #1 player's DPS.
• Current and Overall views.
• In groups with more than 10 damage dealers, the top 9 plus your row if you are outside the top 10.
Chat behavior
Forever DPS posts nothing to chat by default.

Optional chat features are opt-in only:
• /fdps chat on — print your finished-fight summary only to your own chat window.
• /fdps announce party — automatically post finished-fight summaries to party chat.
• /fdps announce raid — automatically post finished-fight summaries to raid chat.
• /fdps announce instance — automatically post finished-fight summaries to instance chat.
• /fdps announce off — disable automatic group posting (default).
• /fdps report — manually post the most recent finished-fight summary to your current group.

addons.description:
A deliberately small WoW: Forever dungeon helper. When you enter a dungeon, it checks the dungeon's loot against the gear you are wearing and briefly tells you whether anything inside is a meaningful upgrade.

It is not a dungeon journal and it is not meant to stay open.
How the Forever stack works
• ForeverLoot — knows what drops from each dungeon and boss.
• ForeverUpgrade — decides whether an item is an upgrade for your current Warrior setup.
• ForeverDungeon — combines those two and shows only the upgrades when you enter the instance.

No AtlasLoot dependency is required.
What it does
• Detects when you enter a dungeon or raid.
• Reads the current instance, encounters, and loot from ForeverLoot.
• Uses ForeverUpgrade for the actual gear comparison and active Arms/Fury/Protection profile.
• Shows a small temporary notification such as 3 upgrades available • best: +8.4%.
• Automatically disappears after a few seconds.
• View Upgrades opens a compact list showing only upgrade items and the boss/source.
• /fd reopens the latest list whenever you want it.
• Updates the list after gear, level, or talent changes while you are in the instance.
• Uses the same upgrade threshold as ForeverUpgrade by default.
• No permanent window and no minimap button.
addons.name: ForeverDungeon

addons.description:
A lightweight dungeon and raid loot browser made specifically for World of Warcraft: Forever.

ForeverLoot is meant to do the useful part of AtlasLoot without turning into a giant always-open database addon. It opens when you want it, stays out of the way when you don't, and exposes a small API that other Forever addons can use.
Current build: 0.1.0Features
• /fl opens or closes the browser.
• Browse Forever dungeons -> bosses -> loot.
• Separate Dungeon / Raid / All filters.
• Hover items for the normal WoW tooltip.
• Shift-click an item to link it in chat.
• Compact window; nothing stays on screen by default.
• Reads loot from Forever's own Encounter Journal data at runtime.
• Whitelists Forever content so unrelated modern-client instances are ignored.
• Public API for ForeverDungeon and future Forever addons.
Commands
• /fl
• /fl scan
• /fl status
• /fl api
• /foreverloot
ForeverDungeon integration
Other useful calls:

ForeverLoot.API_VERSION is currently 1.
Data philosophy
ForeverLoot does not copy AtlasLoot's full database. It reads Forever's Encounter Journal loot data at runtime and keeps only a small content whitelist/fallback layer.

Because Forever does not launch until November 4, 2026, version 0.1.0 is a pre-launch build and needs live-client testing. The addon includes /fl scan and graceful API checks specifically for that first test.

https://github.com/avp9320/ForeverTalentGuide
addons.description:
A small World of Warcraft: Forever Warrior addon that answers one question:

> I leveled up. Where does my talent point go?

The addon shows a compact next-point popup and, when the Blizzard talent window is open, attempts to glow the recommended talent directly in the tree.
v0.1 scope
• Warrior only.
• Three selectable profiles:
• Leveling - Fury
• Level 60 DPS - Fury
• Level 60 Tank - Protection
• Icy Veins is the editorial source of truth.
• No chat spam during normal play.
• No automatic talent purchasing.
• Talent nodes are resolved from the live C_Traits tree by talent name instead of hard-coded node IDs.
• /ftg opens the guide.
• /ftg leveling
• /ftg dps
• /ftg tank
• /ftg status
• /ftg source
• /ftg on
• /ftg off
Important pre-launch limitation
As of November 1, 2026, Icy Veins' Warrior leveling pages still contain the beta-tested talent route only through level 30. This addon intentionally stops there rather than inventing levels 31-60.

The level-60 Fury DPS and Protection profiles are already included for respec guidance.
Source policy
Build recommendations come from Icy Veins' WoW Forever Warrior guides:
• Fury leveling:
https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/fury-warrior-melee-dps-pve-guide
• Fury level-60 PvE talents:
https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/fury-warrior-melee-dps-pve-spec-builds-talents
• Protection level-60 PvE talents:
https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/protection-warrior-tank-pve-spec-builds-talents

The build data lives in Builds.lua, separate from addon logic. That means a weekly guide refresh can update build recommendations without changing Core.lua or UI.lua.
Tuesday update policy
The intended maintenance rule is:

1. Check the three Icy Veins Warrior guide pages every Tuesday.
2. Compare their current recommended talents/build split against Builds.lua.
3. If Icy Veins changed the recommendation, update Builds.lua.
4. Bump the addon patch version.
5. Publish a GitHub release so WowUp can see it.
6. If nothing changed, publish nothing.

This is deliberately not performed from inside WoW. WoW addons cannot fetch arbitrary websites during play.

addons.description:
A tiny threat indicator built for WoW Forever.

ForeverThreat does not create another combat meter window and does not use overhead enemy nameplates. Instead, it attaches a thin threat strip directly to the enemy target frame you already look at for health and power.
Default behavior
• Attaches automatically to the stock target frame.
• No movable ForeverThreat window.
• Does not require overhead enemy nameplates to be enabled.
• Only appears in combat against a hostile target.
• Hidden while solo by default.
• Auto-hides whenever threat information is irrelevant.
DPS / non-tank display
• SAFE below 80%
• WATCH at 80-89%
• DANGER at 90-99%
• AGGRO when you have pulled the target

Example: WATCH • 87%
Tank display
When you are currently tanking the target, ForeverThreat watches the highest threat among the rest of the group:
• HOLDING while the group is comfortably behind you
• WATCH when another player reaches 85%+
• LOSING when another player reaches 95%+
Commands
• /fthreat test - preview the target-frame strip; target anything first so the target frame is visible
• /fthreat solo - toggle display while solo
• /fthreat show - enable
• /fthreat hide - disable
• /fthreat reset - reset ForeverThreat settings
addons.name: ForeverThreat

addons.changelog: Automated installable release for WoW: Forever. See CHANGELOG.md for details.
addons.description:
Forever Upgrade v0.2.0
Warrior-first item upgrade scoring for World of Warcraft: Forever.
What it does
• Automatically detects the Warrior tree with the most points (Arms / Fury / Protection), or lets you force a profile.
• Uses separate Leveling and Endgame weight sets. Auto mode switches to Endgame at level 60.
• Adds an estimated upgrade/downgrade percentage to item tooltips.
• Adds green arrows and optional percentages to upgrades in Blizzard's bags.
• Marks the best gear upgrade among quest reward choices.
• Correctly treats rings/trinkets as two-slot items, Fury one-handers as possible main/off-hand upgrades once Dual Wield is available, and two-handers as replacing both hands.
• Supports editable weights and Pawn-style import/export.
• Reports the source of the active weights with /fu source.
Weight modelLevels 1-59
Leveling profiles are deliberately practical estimates. They use WoW: Forever mechanics plus Warrior leveling priorities rather than pretending a level-60 raid sim is mathematically correct for a level-27 character.
Level 60
Arms and Fury offensive secondary-stat values are now based on MythicSim WoW: Forever EP measurements where the simulator directly publishes a usable value.

Current v0.2.0 snapshots:
• Arms 39/10/2 — MythicSim engine a667dce84, client 1.60.1.70425, 10,000 iterations. Published EP: Crit 1.19, Haste 1.03, Strength 1.00, Expertise 0.98, Agility 0.91, Attack Power 0.45, Armor Penetration 0.21.
• Fury 18/31/2 — MythicSim engine a667dce84, client 1.60.1.70707, 10,000 iterations. Published EP: Crit 1.28, Strength 1.00, Agility 0.94, Haste 0.92, Hit 0.88, Expertise 0.80, Attack Power 0.45, Armor Penetration 0.20.
• Protection 0/20/31 — MythicSim threat EP is used for offensive/threat stats; survival stats still use conservative heuristics until Forever Upgrade gains separate Threat and Survival scores.

Two important exceptions are intentionally not disguised as sim data:
• MythicSim's published Arms and Protection reference builds are already Hit-capped, so their published Hit value is zero for those exact reference characters. Forever Upgrade therefore keeps a clearly documented pre-cap fallback instead of declaring Hit worthless for every Warrior.
• MythicSim's public EP tables do not publish a generic weapon-DPS EP value, so weapon DPS remains a practical fallback weight for now.

Use /fu source or /fu weights in-game to see exactly which source/profile is active.
addons.name: ForeverUpgrade

addons.description:
A tiny vendor-quality-of-life addon for World of Warcraft: Forever.

Forever Vendor has one job: get gray junk out of your bags without putting another permanent window on your screen.
Features
• Automatically sells poor-quality (gray) items when you open a merchant.
• Re-checks every item immediately before selling it.
• Never intentionally sells white, green, blue, purple, or higher-quality items.
• Ignores gray items with no vendor value.
• Prints one compact summary after a sale, for example:
• Forever Vendor: Sold 8 junk items for 1g 42s 5c.
• Says nothing when there is no junk to sell.
• No minimap button.
• No permanent UI.
• No external database or dependency.
Commands
• /fv status — show current settings.
• /fv on — enable automatic junk selling.
• /fv off — disable automatic junk selling.
• /fv summary on — show the compact sale summary.
• /fv summary off — sell silently.
• /fv sell — manually trigger a junk sale while a merchant is open.

addons.author: azeroth-db
addons.changelog:
World Recorder is an addon for WoW Forever. See your recorded loot and gathering on your
World Recorder page: items by quality, looted
corpses and objects, and the materials you gathered most.

The addon listens while you play and keeps its records on your computer. It sends nothing
by itself. The World Recorder program sends the save each time the game writes it and keeps the
addon up to date, so nothing is uploaded by hand. Read the data-disclosure section below before
linking a computer.
Changes in 1.7.7
• When azeroth.wiki does not answer, the program sends your records to wowdb.wiki and opens its pages there, so nothing stops while the address moves.
Install
Install from this site's app, or copy the WorldRecorder folder from the zip into
World of Warcraft/forever/Interface/AddOns/.

To send your records to Azeroth DB, install the uploader once:
• macOS: download World Recorder for Mac from https://wowdb.wiki/forever/guides/world-recorder,
open the zip, then open World Recorder. The first time, macOS asks before opening an
app from the internet: open System Settings, then Privacy & Security, and choose Open
Anyway.
• Windows: download World Recorder setup from the same page and open it. If Windows shows
"Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway.

The setup starts the uploader at login, installs the addon into your WoW Forever client
and opens Azeroth DB so you can link this computer to your account: sign in and choose
Link this computer. Records are sent only from linked computers.

Without the uploader, the addon records just the same and you send its save yourself. The
game writes the save when you log out or exit, or when you type /wrsave. Sign in at
https://wowdb.wiki/account/world-recorder and choose WorldRecorder.lua under Send a save
file. It is in World of Warcraft\forever\WTF\Account\\SavedVariables\ on
Windows and in /Applications/World of Warcraft/forever/WTF/Account//SavedVariables/
on macOS. Send it after each session and before every game update: the addon starts its
records afresh with each new game version. Only the file you choose is sent.

Step by step, in ten languages: https://wowdb.wiki/forever/guides/world-recorder
Privacy
• What is sent. Everything the addon saves: loot, kills, quests, NPC services, fishing,
creature observations, auction prices and the snapshot
of each character, including its name, realm, guild, level, money, equipment, talents,
professions and completed quests, and the save's own random id. With it go a random install
id and the uploader version. The account folder name, file paths and your computer's user
name are not sent. The computer's name is sent once, when you link it, as that computer's
name on your profile.
• To whom. Only to Azeroth DB, over HTTPS, with the key of the account you linked.
• What is shown. Your characters appear on your Azeroth DB profile. They are public on
your public profile unless you clear Public for a character; money is never shown
publicly. Totals of what you recorded (kills, loot, gathering) appear on your profile
and stay private unless you show them publicly. Everything else is combined with other
players' records.
• How to stop. On your Azeroth DB profile, under Linked computers, choose Unlink; the
uploader then stops sending from that computer. To remove it, run
wowdb-recorder uninstall from its folder (~/Library/Application Support/wowdb-recorder
on macOS, %AppData%\wowdb-recorder on Windows) and delete
Interface/AddOns/WorldRecorder.
• Privacy notice: https://wowdb.wiki/privacy
addons.description:
A WoW Forever addon and a desktop program for Azeroth DB. The addon records
your loot, kills, quests, NPC services, fishing, auction prices and your characters while you play;
the program sends them to your Azeroth DB account after every logout. See them on your
World Recorder page: items by quality, looted corpses
and objects, and the materials you gathered most.

addons.changelog:
Forever Hearthstone 1.0.1Fixes
• No more error inside dungeons and raids. Midnight's addon restrictions,
which Forever shares, hide some unit details inside instances. Kill rewards
and the duel range check tried to use those hidden values and raised a Lua
error. They now treat a hidden value as unknown: kills still pay, exactly
once. One trade-off: inside an instance an elite counts as a normal mob,
because its classification is hidden. Bosses still pay through their
encounter.
Look and feel
Found by photographing every screen inside the real client and reviewing the
shots (docs/39):
• Windows open sized to your screen (16:9 at about 86% of its height) instead
of a fixed 1280x720. Resizing works as before.
• Minion attack and health numbers are larger, with Hearthstone's heavy outline.
So are damage numbers.
• At the end of a game the whole table drains to grey, not just the cloth.
• Effects shed soft glowing motes instead of small hollow gold rings.
• "YOUR TURN" rises out of a gold glow.
• Settings, Progression and the confirmation popups use Hearthstone's
parchment with dark lettering. The General tab is sized to what it holds.
• Deck boxes show each deck's signature card (its rarest, then costliest) rather
than the same class portrait on every deck. Basic-only decks keep their hero.
• Deck list tiles: the mana crystal sits fully inside the tile, the cost digits
are bold and centred on the crystals (here and in the mana filter), and the
card art fades in instead of starting at a hard edge.
• Pack opening: the class captions under revealed cards are caption-sized.
• Disenchanting: the inspected card's keyword notes no longer draw over the
confirmation, and the collection's own Craft/Disenchant buttons no longer
show through the inspect view.
• The Victory and Defeat portraits fill their arches.
Installation
Replace the old ForeverHearthstone addon folder with the folder from
ForeverHearthstone-1.0.1.zip, then restart WoW completely. Saved collections
carry over unchanged.
Validation
All 1,286 automated suites pass (98,155 assertions). The visual changes were
checked in four in-client screenshot runs on retail Midnight, the test client.
A final look on a Forever client is still recommended. Network protocol
unchanged (10).

players standing next to you in the world.

addons.description:
All your characters at a glance: level, gold, where they are, rested experience, professions and bag space. An addon for World of Warcraft: Forever (client 1.60.x).
What it does
AltBoard keeps a line on every character on your account and shows them all in one window, from whichever character you are playing:

| Column | |
|---|---|
| Character | Name, in their class colour |
| Level | |
| Gold | With a total across all characters at the bottom |
| Last seen in | The zone they were in |
| Rested | Rested experience, as a share of a level |
| Professions | With skill levels |
| Bags free | Free slots out of total |
| Played | How long since you last played them |

Click a column heading to sort by it; click again to reverse. Hover a row for more detail.
Using it
Click the AltBoard button on the minimap, or type /alts.

A character appears in the list once you have logged in to them with AltBoard enabled, and their line is brought up to date each time you play them. Characters you have not played since installing it are not listed yet.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| /alts | Open the list |
| /alts forget | Remove a character you no longer have |
| /alts button | Show or hide the minimap button |

You can also remove a character with the small x at the end of their row; it takes two presses.
Good to know
• Rested experience is estimated for characters you are not playing. AltBoard knows how much they had when you logged out and whether they were in an inn or city, and works out how much has built up since. Estimates are marked with ~.
• Nothing is sent anywhere. The list is saved on your own computer with the game's other saved settings.
• It records the bags a character carries, not their bank.
More from this author
Other small addons for World of Warcraft: Forever, all free:
• GatherTrail remembers ore, herbs, fishing pools, skinning spots, chests and rares across all your characters, and guides you back to the best spots.
• MouseTip shows tooltips at your mouse cursor.
• RangeShade shades action buttons red when your target is out of range.
• VendorMate sells junk and repairs at vendors, and warns when your gear is wearing out.
• SwiftQuest accepts quests and hands them in as soon as you talk to the quest giver, without ever choosing a reward for you.
• SessionRecap keeps a running tally of your play session: gold, experience per hour, quests, gathering and loot.

addons.description:
Shades action bar buttons red when your target is out of range. An addon for World of Warcraft: Forever (client 1.60.x).
What it does
When an ability cannot reach your target, World of Warcraft only turns the small keybind text on its button red. RangeShade tints the whole icon red, so it is obvious at a glance.

It covers the eight standard action bars. When a button is back in range it gets the game's normal colour back, including the blue out-of-mana tint and the grey unusable one.
Options
Type /rangeshade to open the options, or use the addon's entry in the minimap's addon list.

| Setting | What it does | Command |
|---|---|---|
| Shade out-of-range buttons red | Turns the addon on or off | /rangeshade on, off, toggle |
| Melee abilities too | Also shades melee attacks (see below) | /rangeshade melee |
| Shading | Strong or soft red | /rangeshade strong, soft |
Melee abilities
On the Forever client the game reports melee abilities as "in range" however far away the target is, so RangeShade measures the distance for those itself. The shortest distance the game will measure for an addon is about 10 yards, so a melee button clears a little before you are actually close enough to hit.
Known limits
• The pet bar and stance bar are not covered.
• During combat the game restricts what addons may read. Where it will not report range, a button is left unshaded.
• /rangeshade debug lists what the game reports for each button, which helps explain why one is or is not shaded.

• Reading quests aloud has been removed, with everything that came with it: the voices, the reading bar, the key bindings, the Listen button and the reading commands. SwiftQuest is back to accepting and handing in quests, and its saved reading settings are cleared away.

0.2.1

addons.description:
Accepts quests and hands them in as soon as you talk to the quest giver. An addon for World of Warcraft: Forever (client 1.60.x).
What it does
Talk to a quest giver and SwiftQuest does the clicking:
• accepts the quests they offer, and
• hands in the quests you have finished, straight through to the reward.

Hold Shift while talking to someone to do it all by hand that time, for instance when you want to read the quest.

• Choose a reward for you. A quest that offers a choice stops at the reward window.
• Pay for a quest. One that asks for money is left for you to confirm.

| Hand in finished quests | /swiftquest turnin |

• First release on CurseForge. No changes to how the addon works.
0.3.0
• Reading quests aloud has been removed, with everything that came with it: the voices, the reading bar, the key bindings, the Listen button and the reading commands. SwiftQuest is back to accepting and handing in quests, and its saved reading settings are cleared away.
0.2.4
• "Read quests aloud" and "Wait for the reading before accepting" are now kept for each character, so a new character starts with them off. They were shared across the account, so turning reading on for one character turned it on for all. After updating, turn reading on again on each character you want it for. Voices, speed and volume are still shared.
0.2.3
• Fixed the real cause of quests being accepted before the reading ended: a safety timer left over from one sentence could cut the next one short. Each timer now belongs to its own piece of speech.
• The game's reports of when speech starts and ends turned out to be accurate, so they now drive the reading; the clock is only used if the game reports nothing, and slow speech is waited for.
0.2.2
• Fixed: with "Wait for the reading before accepting" on, quests were accepted while still being read. The game can report a piece of speech as finished when it has only passed it to Windows; such early reports are no longer believed, and only reports about SwiftQuest's own speech count.
• In that mode, choosing a quest from a conversation now waits for the greeting to be read too.
• /swiftquest ttsdebug shows the game's speech reports in chat.
0.2.1
• Voice names are shortened ("David" rather than "Microsoft David Desktop - English (United States)") so they fit in the options window.
0.2.0
• Reads quests aloud with the game's text to speech (off until you turn it on): the story and objectives when you pick a quest up, and what the quest giver says when you hand it in. The quest is still accepted at once and the reading carries on.
• A female voice for female quest givers and a male one for the rest, each chosen in the options, with speed and volume.
• "Wait for the reading before accepting", for hearing the story first.
• The quest giver's greeting is read before the quest.
• Grey and repeatable quests are not read while they are left to you.
• A bar with Skip and Stop while reading, key bindings for Stop, Skip and Replay, a Listen button in the quest log, and /swiftquest read for any quest in your log.
• Leaves the reading to Forever TTS if that addon is installed.

addons.changelog:
• Pixel-art street: every page banner, all 32 Hall of Fame portraits, the crest and the minimap button are redrawn as pixel art. The window, signs and menus stay as they were.
• Small touches: buttons and the sidebar light up and fade smoothly, Soft Res and Roll Call glow when they want you, saying Yeah gets a green burst, and crowns and boss kills go off in gold on their sign.
• The soft-res sign's item name is easier to read (an epic's purple was lost on the green), and the 25-deaths badge is now Graveyard Regular, so Frequent Flyer only means flight paths.

Guildies: run Update Greenfields (or turn on auto updates), then restart WoW.
First time? Download GreenfieldsUpdater.zip, unzip it, double-click Update Greenfields.
On a Mac, or doing it by hand? Download Greenfields.zip, unzip it and drag the folder with Greenfields.toc directly inside it into World of Warcraft/forever/Interface/AddOns, replacing any old one.
addons.description:
The guild addon for Greenfields on WoW: Forever. Est. Mandurah, WA 6210.

Rostering and raid signups, soft reserves with a loot desk, attendance, a Hall of Fame (and Shame) with 32 titles, a guild profession browser, a raid buff and camp planner, and the Neighbourhood Watch feed.
addons.name: greenfields-addon

releases.changelog:
• Pixel-art street: every page banner, all 32 Hall of Fame portraits, the crest and the minimap button are redrawn as pixel art. The window, signs and menus stay as they were.
• Small touches: buttons and the sidebar light up and fade smoothly, Soft Res and Roll Call glow when they want you, saying Yeah gets a green burst, and crowns and boss kills go off in gold on their sign.
• The soft-res sign's item name is easier to read (an epic's purple was lost on the green), and the 25-deaths badge is now Graveyard Regular, so Frequent Flyer only means flight paths.

Guildies: run Update Greenfields (or turn on auto updates), then restart WoW.
First time? Download GreenfieldsUpdater.zip, unzip it, double-click Update Greenfields.
On a Mac, or doing it by hand? Download Greenfields.zip, unzip it and drag the folder with Greenfields.toc directly inside it into World of Warcraft/forever/Interface/AddOns, replacing any old one.

• New look, after dark: a new painted night on every page and a new crest, and the art and the jokes moved closer to where we actually came from. Three titles got new names to match: Been Up Since Tuesday, Loot Fiend and On The Gear.
• Residents only: from the moment Forever goes live, Greenfields only runs for characters in the Greenfields guild. On any other character it stays quiet and the window says why. It opens by itself when you join, with nothing to reload. It also only listens to people who've been on the guild roster, and only hands guild data to people on it.
• The richest and poorest boards now share a much rougher score. The amount stays hidden on screen, and the score only gives your gold away to within about double. Same-band ties go by name.
• First login on a character prints three lines on what the addon needs from you: open your profession windows, set a main, and how the wealth boards work.
• Who's Home now lists people near your level first, then people in your zone. Right-click anyone on it for the full menu, including invite.
• New installs learn who has the addon within seconds, not half an hour: hello replies now reach people. Invites now go to the full name, and Invite the signed says invites are on the way, not that anyone's in.
• Opening the world map no longer counts as an emote, one death can't count twice, and the weekly boards turn over at the same moment for everyone: Wednesday midnight in Mandurah.
• Crown changes now go in the Watch without a sign, and a crown takes a small score to claim, so launch night doesn't hand them round for one jump. Parties under 60 aren't marked out of 100 any more, and buffs nobody can learn yet don't count as missing. Raids are graded as before.
• Two guildies with the same first name: the addon can't tell them apart, so that name gets no officer or GM rights, whispers or invites until one of them's gone. The GM gets told in chat and /gf doctor warns about it.
• New /gf install: the download links and a post to paste in Discord, for getting a mate set up. It works on any character, and the links always get the newest version. On a Mac, or don't want the updater? /gf update and the README now have steps for doing it by hand.
• New /gf report: errors now survive a /reload, and it puts them in a box with everything else Spencer needs, ready to copy and paste. /gf doctor no longer gives up halfway and answers more questions, and new /gf mic posts one test line to your group and reads one /roll back.
• Smaller things: jokes go through the whole pile before repeating, even across logins, and the Watch's loot, moving-in and moving-out reports have a few lines each. Roll call no longer sticks on "still loading" after being kicked and reinvited. The addon keeps working if Blizzard renames the client, and through the next small patch (1.60.2).

Guildies: run Update Greenfields (or turn on auto updates), then restart WoW.
First time? Download GreenfieldsUpdater.zip, unzip it, double-click Update Greenfields.
On a Mac, or doing it by hand? Download Greenfields.zip, unzip it and drag the folder with Greenfields.toc directly inside it into World of Warcraft/forever/Interface/AddOns, replacing any old one.

addons.changelog:
Bleakfiber's Action Bars - v1.1.4🛠️ Fixes & Improvements
• Bags Bar Position Persistence & Mover Point Symmetry: Preserved relativePoint (elPoint) across SaveMoverPosition and ApplyMoverPosition to eliminate anchor drift and ensure moved bar coordinates accurately restore to user placement.
• Blizzard Bag Button Hijacking Protection: Hooked Blizzard's BagsBar.Layout, BagsBarMixin.Layout, and MainMenuBarBagManager.OnExpandBarChanged, plus added protective hooks on bag slot buttons (ClearAllPoints, SetPoint, SetParent) to prevent opening /bac or other UI dialogs from ripping bag buttons off the Bleakfiber container to bottom-center defaults.
• Live Re-Anchor on Refresh: Ensured /bac options load and refresh callbacks explicitly re-assert ApplyMoverPosition(BagsBar) and LayoutBagsBar().
• Documentation & Legal: Standardized README.md, added Source-Available Restricted License (LICENSE.md), and updated .toc metadata to match the Bleakfiber Addon Suite standard.
📦 Installation
Extract BleakfibersActionBars-Forever 1.1.4.zip into World of Warcraft/forever/Interface/AddOns/.

Bleakfiber's Action Bars is a modular, high-performance, standalone action bar suite crafted specifically for World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001).

Engineered from the ground up as a lightweight, pixel-perfect replacement for the default Blizzard action bar system, it delivers bespoke Dark Slate & Gold visual styling alongside advanced combat features: 10 independent movable action bars, a dedicated skinnable Bags and Keyring container, Shaman Totem and Paladin Aura/Stance bars, instant Cast on Key Down activation, cooldown pulse animations, shiny golden proc activation glows, an integrated hover keybinder, and seamless synchronization with the Bleakfiber Addon Suite.

Runs 100% standalone out of the box with zero required third-party libraries or addons.

• Pure Standalone Power: Zero external dependencies required. Embedded libraries (Ace3, LibSharedMedia-3.0) ensure complete stability out of the box.
• 10 Independent Bars: Bar 1 (Main Action Bar), Bars 2–5, Pet Bar, Stance/Shapeshift Bar, Totem Bar, Micro Menu Bar, and Dedicated Bags Bar.
• Dedicated Bags & Keyring Container: Freely movable and scalable container housing your Backpack, 4 character bags, and Keyring with Blizzard Layout hijacking immunity.
• Shaman Totem & Paladin Aura Support: Fully integrated Totem Bar with customizable orientation (horizontal/vertical), slot padding, and active duration timers.
• Cooldown Pulse Animation: Visual burst and pulse animation over action button icons the instant abilities finish their cooldowns.
• Spell Activation Proc Glows: Golden proc overlay borders that illuminate when reactive abilities (Overpower, Revenge, Execute, etc.) become usable.
• Cast on Key Down: Instant spell activation on button press (ActionButtonUseKeyDown) rather than button release for maximum responsiveness.
• Visual Hover Keybinder: Quickly assign or unassign keybindings by hovering over any action button and pressing your desired key combination.
• Non-Destructive Profile Capture: Instant profile synchronization with BleakfibersAddonConfig-Forever that captures active settings upon creating a new profile instead of resetting to defaults.

Take complete control over your interface layout:

• Pet Action Bar: Dedicated 10-button pet bar with auto-hiding when no pet is summoned.
• Micro Menu: Compact, customizable bar housing Blizzard game menu buttons.
• Button Grid Visibility: Toggle between always-visible empty button slots and clean contextual fading.
• Range & Mana Tinting: Visual out-of-range red desaturation and out-of-mana blue tinting.
2. Dedicated Bags Bar & Keyring Container
An independent container for inventory management:
• Houses the Backpack, Bag 1 through Bag 4, and the classic Keyring button in a unified frame.
• Fully movable via mover mode with configurable scale, button spacing, and orientation.
• Blizzard Layout Hijacking Protection: Hardened against Blizzard internal layout overrides to ensure bag buttons never jump back to screen bottom-center when opening configuration menus.

Bleakfiber's Addon Config is the centralized master configuration hub and profile orchestrator for the Bleakfiber Addon Suite in World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001).

Engineered to unify your UI management into a single, cohesive Dark Slate & Gold interface, it integrates directly into the native Escape Game Menu, provides a global master mover system that coordinates on-screen positioning across all suite addons, and enforces non-destructive profile synchronization across every installed Bleakfiber addon.

Runs 100% standalone out of the box with zero required external dependencies.

📑 Table of Contents
• Key Highlights
• Feature Showcase
• 1. Centralized Master Hub GUI
• 2. Escape Game Menu Integration
• 3. Global Master Mover Mode
• 4. Non-Destructive Profile Synchronization
• 5. Module Registry API

🌟 Key Highlights
• Unified Master Hub: Seamlessly embeds options and controls for every installed Bleakfiber addon into a single window.
• Native Escape Menu Button: Adds a stylized Bleakfiber's Config button directly inside the standard Blizzard Game Menu (GameMenuFrame) below Macros.
• Combat Lockdown Immunity: Automatically disables configuration access and displays explanatory tooltips during combat encounters to prevent UI taint.
• Global Mover Coordination (/bac mover): Unlocks on-screen position movers across all suite addons simultaneously, hiding redundant individual addon positioning modes.
• Non-Destructive Profile Synchronization: New profiles capture active settings across all addons rather than resetting them to factory defaults.
• Zero External Dependencies: Self-contained, lightweight implementation with ultra-fast loading times and minimal memory footprint.

🎯 Feature Showcase1. Centralized Master Hub GUI
Say goodbye to remembering separate slash commands for each addon. Type /bac or /bleak to access a single window with sidebar navigation for:
• Bleakfiber's Action Bars
• Bleakfiber's Maps
• Bleakfiber's Quest Tracker
• Bleakfiber's Unit Toggles
2. Escape Game Menu Integration
Effortless access right where you expect it:
• Dynamically attaches a Bleakfiber's Config button beneath the Macros / Options buttons on the main Escape menu.
• Compatible with both modern WoW button pools (GameMenuFrame.buttonPool) and classic layout templates.
• Automatically adjusts frame height and button spacing to preserve Blizzard UI visual harmony.
• Combat lockdown guard dims the button and provides tooltip notifications during combat.
3. Global Master Mover Mode
Streamlined interface layout customization:
• Toggle mover mode via /bac mover or through the hub interface.
• Activates anchor frames across Action Bars, Quest Tracker, Bags Bar, Totem Bar, and Maps simultaneously.
• Replaces individual addon positioning modes with a unified coordinate grid and snap assistance.
4. Non-Destructive Profile Synchronization
Effortless character and specialization management:
• Create, switch, and delete profiles across the entire suite with one click.
• When creating a new profile, current active settings are safely cloned instead of wiping to defaults.
• Switching profiles updates all registered Bleakfiber addons in lockstep.
5. Module Registry API
Designed for modular expansion:
• Simple registration hook (BAC:RegisterModule) allows suite addons and third-party/community addons to register their presence, configuration tables, profile sync callbacks, and mover controllers.
• Community addons automatically appear under the dedicated OTHER ADDONS sidebar group.
• Full API documentation, widget toolkits, and boilerplate code are provided in the Developer Integration Guide.…

Bleakfiber's Bags - v1.4.0
Advanced item intelligence, recent items engine, equipment usability scanning, specialty container slot indicators, and custom category tagging.
🌟 Key Features
• Recent Items Engine & Smart Category: Automatically captures looted items from chat and elevates them into a dedicated high-priority 'Recent Items' virtual category with an eye-catching cyan indicator.
• Equipment Usability Scanner & Red Tint: Identifies equipment restricted by character level, class, or armor/weapon proficiencies, applying a subtle red overlay so players instantly know what gear cannot be equipped.
• Specialty Container Slot Recognition: Detects profession and class bags (Soul Bags, Herb Bags, Mining Sacks, Enchanting Bags, and Quivers/Ammo pouches) and color-codes empty specialty slots.
• Custom Item Category Overrides: Alt + Right-Click any item in your bags or bank to open an instant Dark Slate & Gold context menu and reassign it to any desired category.
• Advanced Search Keyword Syntax: Full search syntax support including binding keywords (\ oe\, \ op\, \soulbound\), category terms (\quest\, \junk\, \gear\, \consumable\, \eagent\), rarity keywords (\poor\, \common\, \uncommon\, \are\, \epic\), and numeric level comparison queries (\>30\, \<20\).
📦 Installation
Extract \BleakfibersBags-Forever 1.4.0.zip\ into your \World of Warcraft\classic\Interface\AddOns\\ directory.

Added

• Balanced 10/10 Column Layout: Reorganized the interface into two symmetrical 10-toggle columns (Friendly Units & World on the left; Enemy Units & Titles on the right).

addons.description:
Spell tooltips that show the math: where each number comes from and which talents change it. Hold a key while hovering a spell.

> This addon was written with AI assistance (Claude). The code is generated and then tested in game by a human. Read it with that in mind, and expect some rough edges.
What it shows
Hover a spell and hold a key:

| Held | You see |
|------|---------|
| nothing | the game's normal tooltip |
| Alt | your numbers (damage with your spell power or attack power, crit and hit, auras) and the talents you have picked, each with its effect on that number |
| Alt + Shift | also talents you could still take, and locked talents with the points still needed |

With the hold key down, the mouse wheel steps through the listed talents. Release the key to open the selected talent in the talent window.

Example (Revenge, holding Alt+Shift):

Weapon abilities show the weapon, attack power and ability parts. Wands show the wand's own damage range.
Settings
Type /spelltips (or /stips), or click the minimap button. A live preview tooltip appears where your tooltips normally do.
• Hold key and more key: Alt, Ctrl, Shift or None.
• Always shown level: show numbers or talents without holding a key.
• Preview spell: pick which spell the preview uses.
• Colors: every color the tooltip uses, with a picker.
• Reset all.

Settings are saved in SpellTipsDB.
Slash commands
| Command | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| /spelltips | open the settings window |
| /spelltips reset | reset all settings |
| /spelltips minimap | show or hide the minimap button |
| /spelltips report | text of what the last tooltip showed, to copy |
| /spelltips enum [name] | list the client's Enum tables (developer tool) |
| /spelltips desc [spellID] | where a spell's description text is (developer tool) |
| /spelltips debug | toggle debug output in chat (developer tool) |
| /spelltips probe | every rank of a spell: learn level, predicted numbers and the game's own text (developer tool) |
| /spelltips pick | the lowest known healing rank that covers that much missing health (developer tool) |
| /spelltips secrets | whether the client lets addons read health numbers right now; run it in combat, then /spelltips secrets show (developer tool) |
| /spelltips curve | whether a secret health number can still drive a display (curve helpers, widgets); run it like secrets (developer tool) |
| /spelltips demo | show or hide a small window testing whether secret health can drive a display (developer tool) |
| /spelltips heal | experimental heal labels: on each unit frame, the smallest heal that covers the missing health. Set it up in the settings window, under "Heal labels..."; this command just turns it on, heal off turns it off |
| /spelltips verify [name] | check every talent's numbers against the game's own text (developer tool) |
| /spelltips ranks | a talent's text at each rank and the data rows behind it (developer tool) |
| /spelltips talent | open the talent window on a talent (developer tool) |
