Changelogv0.3.1
Fixes found in a second replay of the paladin's readings, where some temporary effect raised
every Holy number by 40% for a while.
• A temporary boost (a buff or effect that comes and goes) is set aside instead of being read
as scaling, and the readings on both sides of it are kept. This fixes Seal of Command and
Seal of Righteousness reading as scaling with block value, after a boost started as a
shield went on and ended at a level-up.
• Two-stat formulas follow the same rule as one-stat ones: a level-up can raise a spell's
base, never lower it.
• Once readings have been set aside, a stat is only named after the number has changed at
least twice between level-ups (three times for two-stat formulas).
• Removed the tick-rounding guess and the loose-rounding fallback. Forever's tooltips round
once, and the fallback let coincidences through.
v0.3.0
Fixes found by replaying a real paladin's and shaman's saved readings (tools/replay.lua).
• Spells whose base damage grows with your level, as most classic ranks do, are learned
properly. Readings are compared within a level and the base may step up at level-ups, so
stats that rise when you level are no longer blamed for it. This fixes results like
"SP + -54% block value" on Earth Shock. The browser notes "base rises with level".
• A number that changes for some other reason at the same moment as a gear swap (a talent, an
effect) is no longer pinned on whatever stat moved. Coefficients have to be positive, a stat
can't account for more than the whole number, and old readings are only set aside where a
number visibly jumped. This fixes Holy Shield's block chance reading as "-42% AP".
• Both ends of a "46 to 51" range now pool their evidence, so ranges sharpen faster.
• When spell power and healing have only moved together, "SP + 1/3 healing" is listed as a
possibility too, since it would give a different coefficient.
• The guess that damage-over-time totals are built from rounded ticks now needs four different
values to agree first. Forever's tooltips don't round per tick, and round numbers like 20%
and 30% were triggering it.
v0.2.0
• Reads your talent tree too, including talents you haven't taken, so you can see what a
talent scales with before spending points. They're tagged "talent, not taken" in the
browser; search for "not taken" to list them.
• Tooltips are only annotated when their title matches the spell, so a tooltip can never
show another spell's numbers.
v0.1.0
• First release: learns spell scaling from your tooltips as your stats change, annotates
spell tooltips with the coefficients, and lists everything in a browser (/ss).
addons.description:
A World of Warcraft: Forever addon that learns how your spells scale with spell power, attack
power and your other stats while you play. It then writes the coefficients into your spell
tooltips, the way modern games show them:

> Hurls a fiery ball that causes 87 to 96 (42.9% Fire SP) Fire damage and an additional 36 (20% Fire SP) Fire damage over 4 sec.

Nothing is datamined or hardcoded. Every number is worked out from your own character, so it
stays correct as Blizzard tunes spells during the beta.
Why it works this way
Forever runs retail's Midnight-era addon rules. Addons can't read the combat log, and damage
numbers are hidden from them, so "watch the damage and work backwards" isn't possible.

Forever's spell tooltips are live, though: the numbers in them already include your current
spell power. So whenever your stats change (gear, buffs, levels), SpellScale reads the
description of every spell in your spellbook and talent tree, and stores the numbers next to a
snapshot of your stats. That turns out to be better than damage logs anyway. Tooltips have no
crits, resists or random damage rolls in them, just rounding.
How it learns
Every number in a tooltip is a formula, base + coefficient × stat, rounded to a whole number.
For each stat it might depend on, SpellScale works out the exact range of coefficients that
reproduces every reading it has seen. For example:
• Your spell power goes from 100 to 105 and Fireball goes from 150 to 152. Rounding could hide
up to a point of difference, so the coefficient is anywhere from about 20% to 60%.
• Your spell power goes from 100 to 300 and Fireball goes from 150 to 236. Now it's between
42.5% and 43.5%.

Each reading narrows the range further. A stat that doesn't explain the numbers runs out of
possible coefficients as soon as your gear moves stats in a different proportion, which is how
the addon tells spell power apart from intellect, healing, and so on.

Many classic spells also gain base damage as you level, until the rank tops out. Your stats
rise at a level-up too, so SpellScale compares readings taken at the same level, and lets the
base step up between levels. It also keeps two rules every tooltip follows: numbers grow with
stats, and a stat can't account for more than the whole number.

The stats it considers: spell power (overall and per school), bonus healing, spell power plus
a third of bonus healing (Forever's healing-to-damage rule), attack power, ranged attack
power, main-hand weapon damage, shield block value, strength, agility, stamina, intellect,
spirit, and character level.
Reading the annotations
| Annotation | Meaning |
|---|---|
| (42.9% SP) | Learned, precise to a tenth of a percent |
| (43% SP) | Learned; your stats haven't spread far enough yet for a decimal |
| (~43% SP) | Still rough (more than ±5%); sharpens as your stats spread out |
| (43% SP?) in gold | It scales, but your gear has only ever moved two stats together (say spell power and healing) |
| (+2.0 per level) | Scales with character level rather than a stat |
| (25% Holy SP + 15% AP) | Scales with two stats at once |

Numbers that don't scale, like durations and ranges, are left alone.
Talents
SpellScale reads your whole talent tree the same way, including talents you haven't taken, so
you can see what a talent scales with before you spend points on it. The annotations show up
in the talent window's tooltips too.
Teaching it faster
• Change one thing at a time. Swap a ring that only has spell power, or take a buff that
only raises intellect. Two readings that differ in just one stat settle the question
immediately.
• At low levels, undress. Taking off all your gear outside combat, then putting it back on,
gives it a zero-spell-power reading next to your geared one. That's the widest spread you
can make, and the spread is what makes the numbers precise.
The browser

• Removed the tick-rounding guess and the loose-rounding fallback. Forever's tooltips round
once, and the fallback let coincidences through.
v0.3.0
Fixes found by replaying a real paladin's and shaman's saved readings (tools/replay.lua).
• Spells whose base damage grows with your level, as most classic ranks do, are learned
properly. Readings are compared within a level and the base may step up at level-ups, so
stats that rise when you level are no longer blamed for it. This fixes results like
"SP + -54% block value" on Earth Shock. The browser notes "base rises with level".
• A number that changes for some other reason at the same moment as a gear swap (a talent, an
effect) is no longer pinned on whatever stat moved. Coefficients have to be positive, a stat
can't account for more than the whole number, and old readings are only set aside where a
number visibly jumped. This fixes Holy Shield's block chance reading as "-42% AP".
• Both ends of a "46 to 51" range now pool their evidence, so ranges sharpen faster.
• When spell power and healing have only moved together, "SP + 1/3 healing" is listed as a
possibility too, since it would give a different coefficient.
• The guess that damage-over-time totals are built from rounded ticks now needs four different
values to agree first. Forever's tooltips don't round per tick, and round numbers like 20%
and 30% were triggering it.
v0.2.0
• Reads your talent tree too, including talents you haven't taken, so you can see what a
talent scales with before spending points. They're tagged "talent, not taken" in the
browser; search for "not taken" to list them.
• Tooltips are only annotated when their title matches the spell, so a tooltip can never
show another spell's numbers.
v0.1.0

spell tooltips with the coefficients, and lists everything in a browser (/ss).

addons.description:
Live-Ticker für eure WoW-Forever-Gilde – gebaut für den Stream.
Zeigt Pop-ups im Spielbild, wenn jemand aus der Gilde:
• ein Level aufsteigt (alle 10 Level als Meilenstein, Level 60 als Max Level)
• stirbt – inkl. Gegner bzw. Ursache (Sturz, Ertrinken …) und Gebiet
• der Gilde beitritt oder sie verlässt

Alle Events werden gespeichert (GildenPulsDB) – Grundlage für die spätere Statistik-Seite.
So funktioniert's
| Event | Mit Addon beim Spieler | Ohne Addon beim Spieler |
|---|---|---|
| Level-Up | sofort | mit bis zu ~20 s Verzögerung (über die Gildenliste) |
| Tod | sofort, mit Ursache | ❌ nicht erkennbar |
| Beitritt / Austritt | über die Gildenliste | über die Gildenliste |

→ Je mehr Gildenmitglieder das Addon installieren, desto vollständiger der Ticker.
Befehle
| Befehl | Funktion |
|---|---|
| /gp test | alle Beispiel-Pop-ups nacheinander |
| /gp test tod | einzelnes Beispiel (level, meilenstein, max, tod, join, leave) |
| /gp unlock / /gp lock | Position verschieben / speichern |
| /gp scale 1.2 | Größe |
| /gp dauer 7 | Anzeigedauer in Sekunden |
| /gp sound | Sound an/aus |
| /gp joinleave | Beitritte/Austritte an/aus |
| /gp verlauf 10 | letzte Events im Chat |
| /gp wer | wer online das Addon nutzt |
| /gp reset | Verlauf löschen |

releases.changelog:
Wanderer Auction 0.5.3Changed
• An item the server refuses to post (some items with stats of their own, "of the owl", meet the game's "internal error" with every addon) is remembered: a red chip says so, Sell everything no longer offers it, and when it was set aside for the auction house in Wanderer Bags it becomes junk, sold at the next merchant. Posted after all one day, it is forgotten.
• An item nobody sells right now is judged by the price it was last known at: better at a merchant, it becomes junk too, even the one you chose.
Fixed
• "Nobody sells it right now" no longer runs out of the market's card.

Wanderer Auction 0.5.0New
• Sell everything: every item that brings more at the auction house than at a merchant, posted one after the other at the price and duration you choose. The game asks a gesture for each sale: a click on the button, a notch of the mouse wheel over it, or a key of yours (Key Bindings). A click on an item leaves it aside.
• An optimized price, the default: just under the first credible offer, weighed against the market's value of the last 14 days. Offers far too low (bait, sold low to be resold dearer) are left out.
• A History tab: an item's prices over the last 14 days in a small chart, its market value, today's cheapest, and whether now is a good time to sell.
• The prices' journal: what the looks for prices and the sales did, a line each, in a window beside the auction house.
• Better at a merchant (on by default, with Wanderer Bags 0.5.2): an item set aside for the auction house that would bring more at a merchant becomes junk, and is sold at the next merchant. Said in the chat each time.
Changed
• Looking up the prices asks for all your items in one look, then the missing ones one by one; a line says where it is, what was found and what got no answer.
• Prices are never rounded: gold, silver and copper kept exactly.
• On the Buy page, a Shift+click on an item in your bags searches for it, even while the search box is written in.
Fixed
• Posting an item no longer fails with an internal error (a starting bid is always given).
• The look for prices no longer stays stuck when the game does not answer.

Wanderer Auction 0.4.1Fixed
• A line of the shopping list kept "always on you" can be made "once" again, even when you carry enough.
• An item the auction house cannot look up no longer stops the others from being priced.

Wanderer Auction 0.4.0New
• At the banker (an option, off): what your shopping list lacks is taken from your bank first, your character's then the account's, exactly what is missing; only the rest is left to buy. Shift skips it.
Changed
• The shopping list and the buying on arrival are now each character's own; each starts from the list you had. The cap per visit is set in the shopping list's window.
• Every action is a real button.
• Needs Wanderer 0.43 or later.

Wanderer Auction 0.3.0New
• A new auction house window: Sell, Buy, Follow (your auctions and bids together) and Shopping list, sortable tables, the game's own durations (2, 8 or 24 hours). Resizable by its corner, its size kept.
• On the selling page, "Look up the prices" finds the price of all your items one by one, how far it is said as it goes.
• Your shopping list anywhere, in a small window: from the bags' heading (Wanderer Bags), a tab on the merchant's window, Wanderer's menu, a key of yours or /wauction. A click changes how many you want, a Shift+click on an item adds it.
• Lines "always on you": a count you always want to carry (reagents, ammunition, food). They never leave the list and are filled up at each merchant.
• At a merchant who sells items of your list, a "+N" link beside them buys exactly what is missing. An option (off) buys it all on arrival, for gold only, never above a cap per visit (5 gold by default), Shift skipping it. Also from the shopping list's window.
• In a profession's window, "To the shopping list" sends the reagents you lack for the recipe shown (as many times as asked).
• Items leave the list by themselves once you carry enough, wherever they came from; their tooltip says "Shopping list: 3 / 20".
Changed
• Items your quests ask you to carry are never offered for sale.
• Needs Wanderer 0.42 or later.

addons.changelog:
Wanderer Campfire Game 0.3.0
First release, an extension of Wanderer (0.43 or later).
New
• A campfire game in a tall window, read at a glance: the fire always in sight, the tabs at the bottom (the fire, the camp, the companions, the expeditions, more), pages opened from others with their way back. Light animations and the game's own icons.
• A clicker: stoke the fire, buy its producers, their ranks and the click's upgrades. The embers count up while you look, and the fire burns while you are away (twelve hours, more with the ashes).
• Seven tiers of the fire; the seventh, the eternal blaze, never ends, each of its levels asking more. Very large numbers said with letters past Q (AA, AB...).
• A new fire: once this one has grown, let it go out for its ashes. Only the fire begins again; the tier, the buildings, the companions, the expeditions and the resources stay. Each ash makes every fire after it stronger, for good, and the ashes' tree opens between two fires only.
• Six buildings (kitchen, forge, apothecary, tents, storehouse, watchtower), the peddler and the feasts, and four resources: embers, provisions, renown, supplies.
• Companions in the colors of WoW's classes, protectors, healers and fighters, each with a trait; they level up on the road, choose a talent at levels 20, 40 and 60, wear the gear your forge makes, and work better with those they often travel with.
• Real-time expeditions to forty zones, nineteen dungeons and seven raids: who goes and how long, the odds, the provisions and what it should bring said before you leave. A short notice when they come back.
• Your real journey feeds the camp: a zone opens with its exploration achievement, your level opens the fire's tiers and the dungeons, your professions strengthen the camp and fill the quartermaster's orders (goods shown from your bags or bank, never taken), each quest handed in, fish caught and dish cooked brings its share, a boss you kill in a dungeon or a raid makes it lived for good.
• The traveler's heritage (a first camp that matches the road you have already traveled), a card of what the camp did while you were away, fireside events with choices, incidents on the road, stories over three nights, trophies in every place, feats of the camp, champions of your exalted factions.
• In ten languages; opened from Wanderer's menu, a key of yours or /wcampfire. It gives nothing in the real game and runs nothing while its window is closed.

• Companions in the colors of WoW's classes, with roles, traits, talents and forged gear, set out on expeditions across Azeroth in real time (forty zones, nineteen dungeons, seven raids).
• Your real journey feeds the camp: exploration achievements open zones, your level opens tiers and dungeons, your professions strengthen it and fill the quartermaster's orders, the dungeons you clear bring more for good.
• Six buildings, fireside events with choices, incidents on the road, trophies and feats.
• It gives nothing in the real game and runs nothing while its window is closed. Opened from Wanderer's menu, a key of yours or /wcampfire.

Wanderer Quests 0.3.1Fixed
• The Gear tab says when Wanderer's gear comparison is turned off, instead of showing no piece.

Wanderer Quests 0.3.0New
• A Gear tab: two character sheets side by side, what you wear and the best piece your quests can give for each slot, how much better, a click opening the quest.
• What you play, chosen at the top of the gear sheet and kept for each character: the best pieces are judged for it.

Wanderer Quests 0.2.0New
• A quest's rewards as the game gives them, all the choices included, learned when you see the quest; a green arrow on the quests whose reward is better for you.
• Its sheet says what comes next (the follow-up and who gives it) and what a quest still needs before you can take it.
• "Open in Quests" beside a quest's details in the game's quest log, and in the right-click menus of the log and the objective tracker: the quest shown here, its sheet open.
• Near a dungeon, at its levels, a quiet notice says how many of its quests you could still take before going in (an option, off).
Changed
• Easier to read: a less transparent window, long names and texts wrapped instead of cut. The window can be resized by its corner.
• Needs Wanderer 0.42 or later.
Fixed

Initial public GitHub release of Shield Aura Forever.
Shield Aura Forever is a lightweight curved absorb-shield HUD for World of Warcraft Forever.
Highlights:
• Curved segmented absorb-shield display
• Exact remaining absorb value
• Dynamic depletion as damage is absorbed
• Optional shield-loss animation
• Configurable drain direction
• Mirrored left/right curve
• Absorb value can be shown above or below the bar
• Movable and scalable HUD
• Movable settings window and minimap button
• Tested with Priest Power Word: Shield and Warlock Voidwalker Sacrifice

v1.0.1 also includes the CurseForge packaging fix adding the required ShieldAuraForever.toc file alongside the Forever-specific ShieldAuraForever_Camelot.toc.
No gameplay or HUD behavior changed from v1.0.0.

Shield Aura Forever displays the player's remaining damage absorb as a curved segmented gold shield aura near the character, with an optional numeric absorb value.

Shield Aura Forever is a clean-room addon inspired by the general segmented shield-HUD concept. It does not include or reuse nanShield / WeakAuras source code or artwork.

addons.description:
The shared toolkit for Dyre's AddOns on World of Warcraft: Forever. It does
nothing on its own; the Dyre's AddOns you install use it. The CurseForge app
installs it with them.
What it gives you
• One layout mode. /dyre unlock shows every Dyre's AddOn's frames, so
you can drag them where you want; /dyre lock locks them all again. Each
AddOn's own unlock command does the same.
• Snapping. A frame you drop near another snaps beside it, also when the
other frame belongs to a different Dyre's AddOn. Shift-drag moves a group of
snapped frames together.
• A grid while frames are unlocked, with red lines through the center of
the screen. Its size is a setting. With Snap to the grid (on by default), a dropped
frame near a red center line centers on it, or puts its nearer edge on it.
Elsewhere, an edge within a quarter of the grid size (8 at 32) of a grey
line lines up with it. When both edges (left and right, or top and bottom)
are that close, the one that moves the least wins, so the frame may line
up at its lower-right corner rather than its upper-left: check both.
Snapping to another Dyre's frame comes before the grid; a Shift-dragged
group snaps to the grid as one block. Hold Ctrl as you drop a frame to
place it exactly, with no snapping.
• Move without unlocking. Hold Ctrl and drag a frame by a button or
a box's header to move it while frames are locked, as with Questie's
tracker. It goes exactly where you drop it. Frames move only out of combat.
• A minimap button. Left-click locks or unlocks frames. Right-click opens a
menu: lock or unlock, the grid switches, the settings, and each installed
Dyre's AddOn's settings. /dyre minimap hides or shows the button.
• One settings home. Options → AddOns → Dyre's AddOns holds these
settings, with each Dyre's AddOn's page under it. /dyre opens it.

Frames always start locked when you log in. Frames move only out of combat.
Commands
| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| /dyre | Opens the settings (out of combat) |
| /dyre unlock, /dyre lock | Unlocks or locks every Dyre's AddOn's frames |
| /dyre grid | Shows or hides the grid while unlocked |
| /dyre snap | Turns snapping to the grid on or off |
| /dyre minimap | Shows or hides the minimap button |
| /dyre debug | Until you reload: says in chat when another AddOn's hook into the toolkit fails, and lists those so far |

/dyretoolkit works the same, in case another AddOn uses /dyre.
For nameplate and unit frame authors
Dyre's AddOns that predict DoT damage draw a block and a DIES badge on
mob health bars. If your AddOn draws its own bars, or the badge covers
something of yours, DyresToolkit.HealthBars lets you say where your bar
is, where the badge goes, and when to draw nothing. You can also read the
prediction to show it your own way. See
docs/HEALTHBARS_API.md.
Compatibility
For the Forever beta client 1.60.1, build 70450, Interface 16001.

Forever Profiles v0.2.1
Graphics configuration profiles for the WoW Forever release client (1.60.1, build 70707, Interface 16001).
Changes in v0.2.1
• Updated graphics CVar allowlist and bounds for the WoW Forever release client (videoOptionsVersion "54"):
• Extended giQuality / RAIDgiQuality (1..4) and graphicsLightMode / raidGraphicsLightMode (0..3, with "Ultra" summary label) for presets 9/10 and 10/10.
• Extended LowLatencyMode (0..5) to support Intel XeLL (5), SpellDensity (0..5), lodObjectMinSize (0..1000), and lodObjectFadeScale (0..5000).
• Added Forever preset derived and shared CVars (terrainLodDiv, doodadLodScale, entityLodDist, entityShadowFadeScale, pbrLiquidDetail, reflectionDownscale, volumeFog, particulatesEnabled, clusteredShading, spellClutter, spellVisualDensityFilterSetting, bloomUserMult, and bloomEnable), while preserving backward compatibility with profiles saved during the beta.
• Hardened event argument handling in Core.lua to filter Midnight/Forever secret values before any comparison on ADDON_LOADED and CVAR_UPDATE.
• Updated addon branding assets (Media/Logo.tga and wordmark/square logos) and forever/Interface/AddOns/ForeverProfiles documentation.
• Added 2 new behavior tests (31 total Lua 5.1 behavior tests + UI and binding checks).
Installation / CurseForge upload
Use ForeverProfiles-0.2.1.zip, attached below. It is the installable addon package; the automatically generated GitHub source archives have a different folder structure.

Extract the ZIP into your WoW Forever client's forever/Interface/AddOns directory. The resulting path must be forever/Interface/AddOns/ForeverProfiles/ForeverProfiles.toc. Restart WoW if this is a newly installed addon, enable Forever Profiles, and open /fp.

The same ZIP is prepared for a manual CurseForge file upload targeting WoW Forever. It contains one ForeverProfiles/ root folder with the TOC, runtime Lua/XML, and icon. Development files, tests, caches, and Git metadata are excluded.
Validation
• 31 Lua 5.1 behavior tests, UI lifecycle checks, binding actions, and package integrity checks passed.
• Archive entries were verified against the tagged Git snapshot (e6ad8d899deb903d74b5c938920394f1a777214e). A SHA-256 checksum is attached.
• Real-client graphics behavior and visual rendering remain covered by the repository's in-game checklist.

Profile switching does not automatically apply a profile at login. The temporary restore point is reset by /reload or a game restart.
addons.description:
An addon for WoW Forever 1.60.1 / Interface 16001. Save your custom graphics settings and switch between configurations using a compact window, a favorites bar, or a keyboard shortcut.
Getting started
Copy this repository's contents into forever/Interface/AddOns/ForeverProfiles in your World of Warcraft installation. The ForeverProfiles.toc file must be directly inside that folder. If you added the addon while WoW was running, restart the game so it discovers the new folder. Enable Forever Profiles in the addon list.

1. Configure your graphics in the game's options and click Apply.
2. Open /fp, click Save current settings, and name the profile "High quality".
3. Configure and apply your performance settings in the game, then save a second profile.
4. Select the profile you want and click Apply profile.
5. Add up to three favorites with the Favorite button. Open the Favorite bar tab and enable Show favorite quick bar to switch with one click.

Selecting a profile lets you inspect it. Only applying a profile changes your game settings. Creating or duplicating a profile captures or copies settings without applying them. Profiles are not automatically applied at login.
Features
• A WoW-style window with charcoal surfaces, metallic edges, gold headings, beveled buttons, and a red Apply profile action. Profiles and Favorite bar tabs keep profile management separate from bar preferences.
• Up to 40 profiles, with renaming, duplication, updating, and deletion. Updating or deleting a profile requires confirmation.
• General graphics settings, separate raid/battleground settings, and the native raid settings toggle saved together, when exposed by the client.
• Render scale, antialiasing, vertical sync, and FPS limits supported by the client.
• A movable bar with 3 favorites: drag its handle or background to move it. The FP button opens the main window.
• A Lock favorite bar checkbox in /fp → Favorite bar: fixes the bar's position and hides its drag handle while keeping its buttons usable. Uncheck it to move the bar again. The lock setting is saved between sessions.
• Bar scale adjustable from 60 to 180% in the main window or with the mouse wheel over its handle. Buttons and text scale together. Position and scale are saved between sessions.
• Independent width and height in /fp: width from 160 to 1,000 and height from 28 to 120. Buttons share the available space without stretching the text. Dimensions are set before the overall bar scale and saved between sessions. Auto width restores sizing based on the number of favorites. On small screens, each dimension is constrained separately to the available space.
• Restore previous settings returns to the configuration captured before the last switch. This temporary backup lasts for the current session; /reload or restarting the game clears it.
• Active, Modified, and Applied partially statuses based on current values. After a partial application, the profile shows settings that differ, with their reasons in tooltips.
• A movable window that adapts to small screens and closes with Escape.
• The interface, dialogs, tooltips, shortcut labels, and messages stay in English on every client locale. Existing profile names are preserved as entered.
• Configurable shortcuts under Options → Key Bindings → Forever Profiles for the window, three favorites, and restoration. An entry is also available under Options → AddOns.
Commands
| Command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| /fp or /foreverprofiles | Open or close the window |
| /fp save High quality | Save current settings under this name |
| /fp apply High quality | Apply the named profile |
| /fp restore | Restore the configuration preceding the last switch |
| /fp quick | Show or hide the favorites bar |
| /fp list | List profiles and their statuses |
| /fp diagnostics | Show the version and number of accessible settings |

SessionScout 0.1.0 - Forever

Choose how much time you have and see up to three unfinished personal tasks that fit.

This first regular release brings the tested session planner and task-management redesign together:
• This session focuses on your time budget, suggested tasks and next-session reminder.
• My tasks separates unfinished and completed tasks, with a dedicated editor and Undo.
• Custom minutes accepts 1-240 whole minutes. Invalid entries keep your current budget.
• If nothing fits, the planner explains the shortest unfinished estimate and offers a route to your tasks.
• Existing tasks, completion and reminders keep the same saved-data format.

Open /scout. In My tasks, choose New task and enter your own time estimate and priority. Return to This session and select a preset or enter Custom minutes, then Apply. Task definitions are shared across characters; completion can be per-character or shared. Editing or deleting a definition affects every character.

Targets WoW Forever 1.60.1 (interface 16001). The new controls were exercised in 1.60.1.70450 using physical mouse and keyboard input: create/edit/cancel, complete/undo, confirmed deletion, 120/90-minute budgets and invalid input. After one reload, all 11 original tasks, completion records and character settings matched their pre-test values. The disposable task was removed. The release differs from that tested alpha.4 package only in its two version strings.

Validation includes 71 automated model, mocked integration and Python tooling checks. Actual reset crossings, alternate characters, combat transitions, extreme UI scales, long sessions and every restart/bag/durability case remain unverified. Earlier scoped checks include reminder persistence; this latest window preserved the existing empty reminder. No full Lua-error or taint audit was performed.

This is a manual task planner. It does not discover game activities, detect quest completion, measure how long tasks take, or calculate gear upgrades. It has no external service or telemetry. CurseForge-app detection, installation and updating for Forever have not been verified.

To install manually, close WoW and extract the SessionScout directory into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. SessionScout/SessionScout.toc must be directly inside it. Keep your WTF/SavedVariables data when updating.

Source and issue reports: https://github.com/jdlarssen/SessionScout
Validation record: https://github.com/jdlarssen/SessionScout/blob/codex/sessionscout/docs/CLIENT_TESTING.md

An opt-in test build for WoW Forever 1.60.1, interface 16001.

Fix: completed reminders after a reset
A daily or weekly task could still show Task completed / Undo after its
recorded server reset when Scout was closed and no inventory/combat event
refreshed the screen. Its completion had already expired in the task model.

The visible completion card now refreshes every 30 seconds and clears on the
first refresh after that reset. It does not choose another task. Hiding,
dismissing or undoing the card stops the timer; unfinished and one-time tasks
do not start this timer. Task definitions, saved completion rules and the
SavedVariables format are unchanged.

This build also includes the alpha.3 default-position adjustment for a tracker
without a saved position. Existing saved positions are retained. The default
can still overlap other UI; drag the tracker background to suit your layout.
Included from alpha.2
Choose your own task, keep its reminder visible with Scout closed, and use
Done, Undo, Open Scout or Choose next from the tracker. An optional
Guide: Library books link opens the separately installed
Librarian Books Forever
journal. Opening a guide does not complete a Scout task. No companion addon is
required for ordinary tasks, and none is bundled.
Validation and limits
92 automated checks passed: 15 model, 58 mocked WoW integration and 19 tooling
checks, plus Lua 5.1 syntax and source CI.
Two new regressions reproduce the stale card against the old UI and pass with
the fix. Checks also cover timer cancellation, no automatic selection and
preservation of unrelated progress and settings.

Done/Undo and opening Librarian. Manual movement was subsequently reported on

current beta uses _classic_beta_/Interface/AddOns. Keep your SavedVariables
when updating. Start WoW, enable the addon and use /scout.

Keep your chosen task visible
• Choose an unfinished task and close Scout. A compact tracker keeps the chosen task visible. Drag the background to place it where it works for your layout.
• Use Done directly from the tracker. The confirmation offers Undo and Choose next, so another slash command is unnecessary. Scout does not choose a replacement task automatically.
• Open Scout returns to the planner. Use suggestions clears your manual choice.
Optional library-book guide
Install Librarian Books Forever separately and enable it. Edit a Scout task, choose Guide: Library books, save, and choose the task. Book guide then opens Librarian's journal from the task card or tracker.

Librarian supplies the book catalogue, locations and its own progress detection. It is not bundled or required for ordinary Scout tasks. Guide links are per character. Missing or incompatible Librarian leaves normal tasks usable and displays an explanation. Scout completion remains manual: opening the journal does not establish that your particular collection goal is complete. Browser checkmarks are not imported.
Installation
Extract the SessionScout folder from the ZIP into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder, preserving SavedVariables. Restart WoW if a newly installed addon does not appear in AddOns after reload. This build supports Forever 1.60.1 only.
Validation and feedback
89 automated checks passed: 15 model, 55 mocked integration and 19 tooling checks, plus Lua 5.1 syntax validation. Source CI passed. Mocked tests do not establish in-game layout, input, combat or compatibility behavior.

See the tracker and guide test record. When reporting an issue, include the game/addon version, selected task action and actual result. Remove personal information from screenshots and do not attach full SavedVariables files.

Source: 68a53db955243a1ec7d60443e443f88451cfb6b7.

Choose your own task for the session. This experimental build adds manual selection alongside SessionScout's existing suggestions.

This is an opt-in test build for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (interface 16001). The new controls have passed automated checks and source-derived layout previews, but have not yet been checked in the actual WoW client. If you prefer the client-tested release, use 0.1.0.
Try manual selection
1. Back up your existing SessionScout addon and saved data before installing a test build.
2. Extract the attached ZIP so that SessionScout.toc is directly inside Interface/AddOns/SessionScout, then start WoW or use /reload at a convenient time.
3. Enter /scout, select Choose myself, then Choose beside an unfinished task. You can also choose directly from a suggestion or My tasks.
4. Change task opens the picker again. Use suggestions returns to automatic planning.

The chosen task is saved per character. Choosing does not complete a task, alter its estimate or change your available time. Tasks that exceed your time remain selectable with a warning. Completing or deleting the chosen task clears the choice. Existing editor drafts are preserved while using the picker.
Validation and feedback
Source: 9734a72f854d2d9a6bfbbf1869e8b2ce7646a040.
• 80 automated checks passed: 15 model, 46 mocked integration and 19 Python tooling checks.
• Lua 5.1 syntax and CI passed on that source.
• Source-derived layouts were visually inspected using fictional tasks. These are not WoW screenshots or proof of client compatibility.
• Actual-client checks of the new picker, buttons and saved selection remain pending. Other WoW flavors are not supported by this package.

The short test plan gives expected behavior. Use temporary tasks for deletion/completion checks and preserve your real tasks.

If you try it, report the addon and game versions, steps and result. It is also useful to know whether the suggestions helped you decide or whether selecting your own task mainly helped you keep track of a decision already made. Please remove personal information from screenshots and do not attach complete SavedVariables files.

1bafd2bd0b5c6be2318b323ca2c48d9d44c0a32504dd22caeae20b0c6c4c0dac

SessionScout 0.1.0 - Forever

Choose how much time you have and see up to three unfinished personal tasks that fit.

This first regular release brings the tested session planner and task-management redesign together:
• This session focuses on your time budget, suggested tasks and next-session reminder.
• My tasks separates unfinished and completed tasks, with a dedicated editor and Undo.
• Custom minutes accepts 1-240 whole minutes. Invalid entries keep your current budget.
• If nothing fits, the planner explains the shortest unfinished estimate and offers a route to your tasks.
• Existing tasks, completion and reminders keep the same saved-data format.

Open /scout. In My tasks, choose New task and enter your own time estimate and priority. Return to This session and select a preset or enter Custom minutes, then Apply. Task definitions are shared across characters; completion can be per-character or shared. Editing or deleting a definition affects every character.

Targets WoW Forever 1.60.1 (interface 16001). The new controls were exercised in 1.60.1.70450 using physical mouse and keyboard input: create/edit/cancel, complete/undo, confirmed deletion, 120/90-minute budgets and invalid input. After one reload, all 11 original tasks, completion records and character settings matched their pre-test values. The disposable task was removed. The release differs from that tested alpha.4 package only in its two version strings.

Validation includes 71 automated model, mocked integration and Python tooling checks. Actual reset crossings, alternate characters, combat transitions, extreme UI scales, long sessions and every restart/bag/durability case remain unverified. Earlier scoped checks include reminder persistence; this latest window preserved the existing empty reminder. No full Lua-error or taint audit was performed.

This is a manual task planner. It does not discover game activities, detect quest completion, measure how long tasks take, or calculate gear upgrades. It has no external service or telemetry. CurseForge-app detection, installation and updating for Forever have not been verified.

To install manually, close WoW and extract the SessionScout directory into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. SessionScout/SessionScout.toc must be directly inside it. Keep your WTF/SavedVariables data when updating.

Source and issue reports: https://github.com/jdlarssen/SessionScout
Validation record: https://github.com/jdlarssen/SessionScout/blob/codex/sessionscout/docs/CLIENT_TESTING.md

Experimental Alpha for WoW Forever 1.60.1. Automated logic and packaging checks passed; the new controls' rendering and keyboard interaction in the actual client remain unverified. This is an opt-in prerelease.

SessionScout now lets you enter your available minutes directly in the planner. Previously the visible choices stopped at 60 minutes, so players with longer tasks could see no recommendation despite having more time available.
Changes
• Set 1–240 whole minutes in Custom minutes and choose Apply, or press Enter. The 15/30/60 presets and /scout 120 still work.
• When nothing fits, see the shortest unfinished task's estimate. Completed tasks are distinguished from tasks that are too long for the chosen session.
• Invalid input preserves the current budget and recommendations. Timer and inventory refreshes preserve an entry while the field has focus; Escape cancels it.
• Task estimates, priorities, saved-data format and selection rules are unchanged. A 120-minute task still does not fit a 90-minute session.
Use and installation
Open /scout, enter the time you actually have in Custom minutes, and press Apply. Choose 120 only when you have two hours. Tasks and completion remain manual.

Download SessionScout-0.1.0-alpha.3-forever.zip from Assets below. With WoW closed, extract the ZIP's SessionScout folder into _classic_beta_/Interface/AddOns. Earlier scoped alpha workflows were tested on build 70338; they do not prove this new control works. addons.description:
Chess, cards, dice, puzzles and more, inside World of Warcraft.

Play your guildies and friends one move at a time, or play on your own.

Forever Games is an addon for playing games with your guildies and friends. You challenge
someone, make your move, and go back to whatever you were doing. They answer whenever they're next
online, even if that's tomorrow. When it's your turn again, the addon lets you know.

Nobody around? Nearly every game for two or more can be played against the computer, and there are
puzzles and solo games with a new challenge for your guild every day.
• Install
• The games
• Getting started
• Playing with other people
• How to play each game
• Commands and options
• Good to know
• Making a game of your own
Install
1. Download ForeverGames-.zip from the
latest release.
2. Unzip it into Interface\AddOns, inside the folder for the version of the game you play in your
World of Warcraft folder. Create the AddOns folder if it isn't there.
3. You should now have eight folders there: ForeverGames, ForeverGames_Freedoom,
ForeverGames_Freedoom_Maps, ForeverGames_Pinball, ForeverGames_Runeweave,
ForeverGames_Starfall, ForeverGames_Where and ForeverGames_Where_Places. Keep all eight.
Freedoom, Pinball, Runeweave, Starfall and Where in Azeroth are addons of their own. ForeverGames_Freedoom_Maps holds
Freedoom's maps and ForeverGames_Where_Places the places of Where in Azeroth, which is why
the download is large. The maps are only loaded when you play Freedoom, and a place's pictures
only when you are taken there.
4. Restart the game if it was running, and check Forever Games is ticked in the AddOns list on the
character screen.

To update, unzip the new version over the old one. Your games in progress and your best times are
kept.

Everyone you play needs the addon too. Try to stay on the same version as your friends: if yours
differ, the challenge tells you.
The gamesWith friends, or against the computer
| | Game | Players | |
|---|---|---|---|
| | Chess | 2 | Take as long as you like between moves. |
| | Checkers | 2 | Jump to capture, reach the far side to be crowned. |
| | Reversi | 2 | Trap discs between yours to flip them. |
| | Mancala | 2 | Sow seeds round the board, land in your store to go again. |
| | Connect Four | 2 | Four in a row: across, up or diagonal. |
| | Nim | 2 | Take stones from one row a turn, and take the last. |
| | Dominoes | 2 | The classic Block game, to 100 over several hands, or the Draw game. |
| | Tic Tac Toe | 2 | Over in a minute. |
| | Battleship | 2 | Hide your fleet, then hunt for theirs. |
| | Backgammon | 2 | Race your checkers home by the roll of the dice. |
| | Chinese Checkers | 2, 3, 4 or 6 | Hop your marbles across the star. |
| | CarcassonneWoW | 2 to 5 | Lay tiles to build Elwynn Forest, and put footmen on its towns, roads, abbeys and fields to score them. |
| | Crazy Eights | 2 to 6 | Match the suit or the rank. Eights are wild. |
| | Words with Warcraft | 2 to 4 | A Scrabble-style word game where Azeroth's names count, and score extra. |
| | Yacht-Z | 1 to 4 | Five dice, three rolls, thirteen boxes to fill. |
| | Wormcraft | 2 to 4 | Artillery the way Worms played it, with fireballs, grenades and sheep. |
On your own
| | Game | Daily challenge | Race a friend | |
|---|---|:---:|:---:|---|
| | Solitaire | Yes | | Klondike. |
| | FreeCell | Yes | Yes | Every card face up, four free cells. Microsoft's numbered deals. |
| | Minesweeper | Yes | Yes | Three field sizes, best time kept for each. |
| | Sudoku | Yes | Yes | A fresh puzzle every time, Easy to Expert. |
| | 2048 | Yes | | Slide and merge tiles. Boards of 3, 4 or 5. |
| | Tetris | Yes | Yes | Marathon, 40-line Sprint, or two minutes for points. |
| | Warcraftstein 3D | Yes | Yes | Fight through the Scarlet Monastery in first person, as your own class. |
| | Freedoom | | Yes | The free version of Doom, drawn inside WoW. Race the ghost of your best run. |…

addons.description:
Auto-play music during Bloodlust / Heroism / Time Warp

Features
• Automatically plays start music when Bloodlust, Heroism, Time Warp, or similar raid-wide haste buffs are cast
• Automatically plays end music when the buff fades away
• Supports all Bloodlust-family spells:
• Bloodlust / Heroism
• Time Warp (Mage)
• Ancient Hysteria / Primal Rage (Hunter)
• Fury of the Aspects (Evoker)
• Custom audio file support — use your own MP3 files (see Custom Audio)
• Independent duration control for start and end music
• Audio channel selection: Master, Music, SFX, Ambience, Dialog
• Built-in volume slider per channel
• Multi-select dropdown — choose multiple audio files, random playback each time
• Preview on click — instantly preview a file by selecting it in the dropdown
• Standalone preview buttons for start and end music
• Stops playback automatically on player death
• Stops playback on UI reload or logout
• Clean Blizzard settings panel (/bl or /blm)
• Lightweight, no unnecessary libraries or dependencies
Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| /bl or /blm | Open BLMusic settings panel |
How to Use
1. Install the addon and type /bl to open settings
2. Select start and end music files from the multi-select dropdowns (choose multiple for random playback)
3. Set playback duration for each (how many seconds before auto-stop)
4. Optionally select audio channel and adjust volume
5. Next time Bloodlust/Heroism/Time Warp is cast in your group, the music plays automatically!
Custom Audio
Simply dropping a file into the Media/ folder is not enough — you must also register it in MediaTable.lua so it shows up in the in-game dropdown.

1. Put your audio file into the Media/ folder
2. Open MediaTable.lua and register the file in the matching list:
• ns.start — start music (Bloodlust/Heroism/Time Warp begins)
• ns["end"] — end music (buff fades)
• ns.pi — Power Infusion music (file name must start with pi-)
3. Add an entry in that list, e.g. { path = "yourfile.mp3", name = "Display Name" }
4. /reload the UI — the file now appears in the dropdown for selection

Supported formats: MP3 / OGG.

中文说明功能特色
• 施放嗜血 / 英勇 / 时间扭曲等团队加速技能时自动播放开始音频
• 效果消失时自动播放结束音频
• 支持所有嗜血系技能：嗜血、英勇、时间扭曲（法师）、远古狂乱/原始狂怒（猎人）、巨龙之怒（唤魔师）
• 支持自定义音频文件：放入 Media 文件夹并在 MediaTable.lua 登记后，即可在下拉菜单中选择（详见下方"自定义音频"）
• 开始音频和结束音频可分别设置播放时长
• 音频通道可选：主音量 / 音乐 / 音效 / 环境 / 对话
• 内置音量滑块，快速调节当前通道音量
• 多选模式：可同时选择多个音频文件，播放时随机选取
• 试听模式：勾选时自动播放预览，也可通过独立试听按钮播放
• 死亡时自动停止播放，重载/退出时自动停止
• 使用暴雪原生设置面板，简洁轻量
使用方法
1. 安装插件后输入 /bl 打开设置界面
2. 从多选下拉菜单中分别选择开始/可用时音频（可多选，随机播放）
3. 设置各自的播放时长（多少秒后自动停止）
4. 可选音频通道和音量
5. 下次团队开嗜血/英勇时，音乐自动响起！
自定义音频
仅把音频文件放进 Media/ 文件夹是不够的，还需要在 MediaTable.lua 中登记，才能在游戏内下拉菜单里显示出来。

1. 将音频文件放入 Media/ 文件夹
2. 打开 MediaTable.lua，把文件登记到对应列表：
• ns.start — 开始音乐（嗜血/英勇/时间扭曲施放时）
• ns["end"] — 结束音乐（效果消失时）
• ns.pi — 能量灌注音乐（文件名必须以 pi- 开头）
3. 在对应列表中新增一条，例如 { path = "你的文件.mp3", name = "显示名称" }
4. 重载界面 /reload，即可在下拉菜单中选择

支持格式：MP3 / OGG。
作者
简繁 — 无尽之海 (CN)

如需自定义音频或反馈问题，请在 /bl 设置中点击"联系作者"，或发送邮件至 32655163@qq.com

addons.description:
A World of Warcraft addon that scans the auction house, shows prices in item
tooltips and a searchable window, finds deals, advises what to sell, and keeps
a ledger of your gold and trades.

With the Goldbook app, the addon syncs with the
Goldbook website: a price history for
every item, and your characters' gold, bags, bank and trades. Get the app from
the website's Download page.

This addon-only repository is a generated mirror of
jkc-be/goldbook/addon.
The public upstream also contains the desktop app, server, and web UI. Make
changes in the upstream repository; an approved mirror update replaces this
copy. upstream.json records the exact source commit.
Requirements
World of Warcraft with the modern auction house API (C_AuctionHouse). The
addon declares interface 16001, the 1.60 "Forever" client. On another client
version the game lists it as out of date.

addons.description:
Graphics settings for World of Warcraft that aren't in the game's options menus, on one options page
(Options → AddOns → Advanced Graphics) in Blizzard's settings style.

Retail (Interface 120100) and WoW: Forever (Interface 16001). Settings a client doesn't have are left off the page:
the HDR section and Linear Lighting / Bloom are WoW: Forever only.
Settings
• HDR (WoW: Forever): HDR output, highlight strength, and overrides for peak brightness and paper white (nits).
• Lighting: Linear Lighting and Bloom (WoW: Forever), surface shine, light draw distance.
• Sharpening: sharpen even without FSR upscaling, sharpness amount, crisper CMAA2 anti-aliasing.
• World Detail: ground clutter density, distance and fade, weather density, cloud detail, object detail and fade
distance, footprints, soft edges.
• Distance & Detail: how far terrain, buildings and characters keep full detail, where the distant landscape
begins, small-object culling and keep distance, and full-quality (uncompressed) character textures.
• Screen Effects: full-screen glow, the gray death effect, the nether effect.

Each control reads and sets the game's own setting (console variable), so the game saves it in its config; the addon
saves nothing. Defaults puts every setting on the page back to the game's default. Some of these (clutter,
object detail) are also set by the menus' quality presets, so moving the matching menu slider later replaces them.

Slash commands: /advancedgraphics or /advgfx (opens the options).
addons.name: advanced-graphics

addons.description:
Sets the font size of chat bubbles in World of Warcraft, including the speech bubbles NPCs use while questing and
players' /say and /yell bubbles (they all share Blizzard's ChatBubbleFont).

Retail (Interface 120100) and WoW: Forever (Interface 16001).
Features
• Font size from 6 to 24 pt, set from Options → AddOns → BubbleFont (Blizzard's slider with arrow steppers).
• "Reset to default" returns to the game's own bubble font size.
• The size is saved and reapplied at login. Bubbles size themselves to their text when they appear, so a change
applies to every bubble shown afterwards (ones already on screen keep their size).
• The options page is built from the addon's own frames rather than Blizzard's pooled Settings controls, so it
can't taint Blizzard's own settings pages.

Slash commands: /bubblefont (options), /bubblefont (set the size), /bubblefont reset.

addons.description:
Keeps your weapons drawn in World of Warcraft when the game puts them away on its own, such as when you loot or
leave combat. Weapons you put away yourself stay away.

Retail (Interface 120100) and WoW: Forever (Interface 16001).
Features
• Drawn again after the game sheathes them. If your weapons were out and the game puts them away (looting,
leaving combat), they're drawn again once the loot window closes.
• Your choice wins. Putting them away with the Sheathe/Unsheathe key (Z by default), sitting or an emote is left
alone.
• After eating or drinking. Weapons that were out are drawn again once the food or drink is gone and you get up
and move.
• Out of the way. Mounting, druid forms and Ghost Wolf, swimming, taxis and vehicles, and dying all put weapons
away on purpose, so those are left alone too.
• Optional triggers: draw your weapons when you target an enemy, or when you enter combat.
• Sheathe after combat (optional): put your weapons away once you've been out of combat for a set delay
(0.5 to 10 seconds).
• Per character. Enable on This Character is saved per character, so it can stay off on a caster.

Options are in Options → AddOns → Smart Sheathe.

Slash commands: /smartsheathe (options), /smartsheathe on / off (this character), /smartsheathe trace (prints
what it sees and does to chat, and keeps the last 500 lines in SmartSheatheDB.traceLog in the saved variables file,
written on /reload or logout), /smartsheathe trace clear (empties the saved trace).

addons.author: WoW Forever
addons.description:
Petit site privé pour la guilde sur World of Warcraft: Forever : qui joue quoi, qui a quels métiers,
agenda des sorties. Le cahier des charges complet est dans docs/cahier-des-charges.md.
Développement local
Prérequis : uv, Node 20.19+ (ou 22), Docker.

En développement, SITE_URL vaut http://localhost:8000 et FRONTEND_URL vaut http://localhost:5173 :
l'URL de retour OAuth à déclarer côté Discord est donc http://localhost:8000/api/auth/discord/callback/.
Commandes utiles
| Où | Commande | Rôle |
|---|---|---|
| backend | uv run pytest | tests |
| backend | uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format . | lint + format |
| backend | uv run python manage.py createsuperuser | accès à /admin/ (demande un ID Discord) |
| backend | uv run python manage.py seed_gamedata | recharge les données de référence sans toucher aux ajouts manuels |
| backend | uv run python manage.py discord_setup_channels | crée les salons agenda / demande-de-craft en lecture seule et les enregistre (rejouable) |
| backend | uv run python manage.py runbot | lance le bot Discord (outbox, rappels, commandes slash, révocation, synchro de l'onglet Événements) |
| backend | uv run python manage.py import_gamedata | télécharge les tables du client WoW Forever (wago.tools) et importe objets, sets, enchantements, talents, recettes (~2 min, rejouable) |

En production : docker compose exec web python manage.py import_gamedata après la première mise en ligne, puis
à chaque patch du jeu. Les ajouts manuels faits dans l'admin (lignes « gérées à la main ») sont conservés.
| frontend | npm test / npm run lint / npm run format | tests, lint, format |
| frontend | npm run gen:api | régénère openapi.json et src/api/schema.d.ts depuis le backend |

L'API est documentée sur http://localhost:8000/api/docs/ (Swagger).

Sans application Discord, on peut tester en créant un superutilisateur puis en se connectant sur
/admin/login/ : la session est reconnue par le site.
Application Discord
Dans le Discord Developer Portal, créer une application :

1. OAuth2 : récupérer Client ID et Client Secret, ajouter l'URL de retour dans Redirects.
2. Bot : créer le bot, copier son token, activer l'intent privilégié Server Members. Inviter le bot sur le
serveur avec les scopes bot et applications.commands, et les permissions Voir les salons, *Envoyer des
messages*, Gérer les messages, Intégrer des liens, Lire l'historique, Créer des événements et
Gérer les événements (onglet Événements synchronisé avec l'agenda ; Discord sépare les deux), Gérer les salons et Gérer les rôles (commandes de
configuration). Puis manage.py discord_setup_roles et manage.py discord_setup_channels créent les rôles
et les salons #agenda / #demande-de-craft (lecture seule pour les membres) et les enregistrent dans
Guilde › Paramètres, où le GM peut aussi choisir les salons dans une liste.
3. Activer le mode développeur dans Discord pour copier l'ID du serveur, des rôles autorisés et du premier GM.

Les variables à remplir sont décrites dans deploy/.env.example.
Addon du jeu
addon/WoWForeverGuilde/ est l'addon WoW (Lua pur + LibDeflate) qui collecte la progression de chaque personnage et
produit le code d'export que le site importe (Profil › Importer depuis le jeu), ou que le compagnon enverra tout
seul. Cahier des charges, étape 11.
• Installation à la main (tant que le compagnon n'existe pas) : copier le dossier WoWForeverGuilde dans
World of Warcraft/forever/Interface/AddOns/, puis /wfg en jeu.
• Carte de la guilde : chaque membre qui coche « Partager ma position » dans /wfg apparaît en point couleur de
classe sur la carte du monde des autres (survol : nom, niveau, zone, talents ; clic : inviter ou chuchoter). Les
positions circulent par messages addon dans le canal de guilde, jamais hors du jeu. Avec : points sur la minimap,
liste « Guilde en jeu » par zone (/wfg qui, roster + positions), recherche de groupe (/wfg lfg texte) et appel à…
addons.name: WoW Forever Guilde
addons.summary: Remonte la progression de tes personnages sur le site de la guilde (export ou compagnon).

addons.changelog:
Changelog
All notable changes to OneKeyFishing are listed here. The format follows
Keep a Changelog and the project uses
Semantic Versioning.
[1.0.0] - 2026-10-23
First public release, for WoW Forever.
Added
• One key for the whole fishing loop: cast, hook the bobber and loot. The same key also applies a lure
(the best one in your bags that is not on cooldown) and opens fished clams and containers.
• Fishing mode: one toggle that sets up auto loot, soft-target interact, the camera and your fishing gear,
and puts everything back when you leave it, after a /reload, a disconnect or a crash.
• Gear swap: the best pole in your bags (or the one you chose) plus your extra fishing items. Only the slots
that were changed are restored. Alt+Click items in your bags to add or remove them.
• Action indicator with the next action, a cast bar, a "No bobber" warning and the session timer.
• Catch notifications.
• Statistics per session, per zone and in total: casts, catches, misses, fishing time (paused while AFK),
catch value, catches per hour and gold per hour. The window explains every row, updates when something
happens (only the time ticks while you fish), has a Refresh button and shows the date of the last
auction scan.
• Auction house scan of everything you have caught; the catch value uses the higher of the vendor and the
auction price.
• Fishing rank cap warning with where to learn the next rank.
• Minimap button and Addon Compartment entry with a menu for every action; a settings panel for every feature.
• /okf debug: a report to copy into bug reports.
• Works with a game client in any language. The interface is in English for now.
addons.description:
Fish with one key in WoW Forever: the same key casts, hooks the bobber and loots. No mouse, no clicking on the bobber.

Every action in the game is a real key press. The addon never reacts to a bite by itself, does not listen to sounds and uses no external tools, so it stays within Blizzard's add-on rules.

It works with a game client in any language. The addon's own interface is in English for now.
Features
• One key for everything: cast → hook → loot. The same key also applies a lure (the best one that is not on cooldown) and opens fished clams when needed.
• Fishing mode: one toggle that sets everything up and puts it all back afterwards.
• Gear swap: equips the best pole in your bags (or the one you chose) plus your fishing items. On exit it restores only the slots it changed.
• Auto loot while fishing, and the soft-target icon over the bobber.
• Indicator: shows what the key will do next (Cast, Hook!, Apply lure, Open), a cast bar and a warning when the bobber is in the water but not targeted.
• Catch notifications for every catch and every miss.
• Statistics: casts, catches, misses, fishing time and value of the catch. Kept per session, per zone and in total.
• Auction scan: prices of everything you have ever caught, used for the catch value.
• Rank cap warning: tells you when your Fishing rank is full and where to learn the next one.
• Camera zooms in while fishing and back afterwards.
• Safe in combat: when attacked, the weapons come back at once and fishing mode ends after the fight.
• Minimap button with a menu: every action is available without typing a command.

addons.description:
Add-on for World of Warcraft: Forever (interface 16001, client 1.60.1) that extends
the built-in Cooldown Manager:
• Custom spells: add any spell, including instants with no cooldown like Swipe, into the
Essential or Utility row next to Blizzard's icons. Each icon shows the cooldown/GCD swipe,
charges, usability and range tint, and proc glow. Icons follow your highest learned
rank (an entry for Swipe rank 1 shows rank 5 once you learn it). Unlearned spells
stay hidden. Lists are saved per class, or per class and spec if the client reports one.
• Form bars (druids): a separate Essential and Utility bar for each form (Caster, Bear,
Cat...). The bar swaps when you shift. A spell can go on several bars and forms. Spells Blizzard already shows in that bar keep Blizzard's
icon; the rest use ours.
• Centered layout (Cooldown Manager Centered behaviour): Essential/Utility rows are
centered (or left/right aligned) and grow down or up, buff icons can be centered and
buff bars grow from the top or bottom. In Edit Mode the bar's selection handle stretches to
cover the added icons too, and Edit Mode's placeholder icons are hidden once the bar has
icons of its own.
Using it in game
Custom spells are managed in Blizzard's own Cooldown Settings window (Spells tab; druids use
the form tabs instead, see Form bars below):
• Add: Not Displayed already lists every active spell you know that the Cooldown Manager
doesn't track itself (Swipe, Shred, Maul…), once each at your highest rank. Your class's
spells that you haven't learned yet (trainer spells and talents, from a built-in Classic list)
follow them, grayed out like Blizzard's own unlearned tiles; you can already place them, and
they appear on your bars once learned. Drag one into
Essential or Utility Cooldowns, at the spot you want. Drag it back to Not Displayed to stop
tracking it. For anything that isn't in your spellbook, click the + tile and type a name
or spell ID.
• Move / reorder: drag a custom tile (marked with a green dot), or click to pick it up and
click to drop, just like Blizzard's tiles. Right-click cancels a drag.
• Right-click a custom tile: move it to Essential/Utility, stop displaying it, or remove it.
• Custom tiles follow the search box. Unlearned spells show desaturated and stay off your bars.

Options (row alignment and growth, buff icons and bars, custom icon behaviour) are in
the same window: click the Advanced Cooldown Manager side tab (add-on icon) below Spells,
Auras and Group Buffs. Click one of Blizzard's tabs to go back. Esc → Options → AddOns only
links there.

Form bars (druids only, always on): Blizzard's Spells tab is replaced by one side tab per
form under Auras / Group Buffs (Caster, Bear, Cat...; the tooltip marks your current form), and
Cooldown Settings opens on your current form's tab. A form you haven't edited shows the default
layout (Blizzard's tracked cooldowns plus custom spells); your first edit saves its own copy.
Each tab works like the Spells tab:
• Essential Cooldowns, Utility Cooldowns and Not Displayed sections (click a header to
collapse it). Not Displayed lists every spell that isn't on this form's bars.
• Drag tiles to reorder, between sections to move, into Not Displayed to remove. Hold Shift
while dropping into the other bar to keep it in both. The search box filters these tabs too.
• Right-click a tile: move to / also show in the other bar, add to that bar in every form,
don't display. The + tile adds any spell by name or ID.
• Copy to... copies this form's bars to another form (or all), or resets it to the default
layout.
• Your bars' contents and order come from the form tabs. Spells Blizzard shows in a bar keep
Blizzard's icon. Dire Bear counts as Bear Form. Saved per class (or spec).

Commands: /acm opens Cooldown Settings, /acm options opens it on
the options tab, /acm add Swipe, /acm add 779 utility 3, /acm remove Swipe, /acm list, /acm formbars (druids: opens your current form's tab), /acm forms…

addons.description:
All-you-can-buff. Raid buff coordination for every class, not just paladins.

Targets World of Warcraft: Forever (interface 16001, client 1.60.1).

Buffeteria works out who casts what, and a one-click tracker serves it. Players can
choose their own buffs, while paladins can manage class blessings for the whole group,
including players who don't have Buffeteria installed. No PallyPower addon is required.
How it works
• You order, the kitchen cooks. Each player ranks the paladin blessings they want
(drag to reorder) and lights up the buffs they care about (Fortitude, Spirit, Shadow
Protection, Mark of the Wild, Arcane Intellect). In /buff, these appear as
three named panels: Blessings, Buffs (including Battle Shout for warriors
and Inner Fire for priests), and Tank role (Righteous Fury for paladins and
Thorns from a druid). Each buff row names its caster; missing casters are grey.
• Smart assignments. Paladins serve your highest available blessings, subject
to their spells and the class plan. Greater Blessings cover a whole class, so
each class gets what most of its players ranked highest. Priests, druids and mages split the raid groups by
work: a group is one cast for someone with the group spell (Prayer, Gift, Arcane
Brilliance) but one cast per player without it, so the work evens out. On a tie, a
caster keeps their own group, where they are in range. Everyone should update
together: copies that split groups differently disagree on who buffs which group.
• Personal priorities. With Use my own order ticked, put less useful
blessings at the bottom, for example Salvation while tanking. Paladins serve
your highest available blessings first. With it off, you get your class's
blessings from the shared plan, including manual assignments.
• No raid leader needed. Every copy of Buffeteria computes the same answer from the
same preferences. Players without the add-on get sensible class defaults.

Blessing rankings use larger rows. While dragging, the lifted row follows your
cursor, an outlined slot marks where it will land, and the other rows slide aside.

New installs start from a class default ranking: warriors and rogues want Might
first; mages, warlocks, priests, druids, paladins, and shamans want Wisdom first;
hunters want Kings first (Might doesn't raise ranged attack power). Kings and
Salvation follow for everyone. Might is last for mages, warlocks and priests;
Wisdom is last for warriors and rogues. All six blessings remain eligible;
lower-ranked blessings are served when enough paladins can provide them. Saved
rankings keep their blessing order when the old divider is removed.
Players without the add-on are planned from the same defaults,
and so are classes Auto and Lock in Auto picks cover on the Paladins tab. If your saved
ranking still matches the old Kings-first default, it moves to the new one; a
ranking you reordered is kept.

Warriors see Battle Shout in the Buffs panel. It is on by default; click it to
skip it. The tracker reminds you when your own shout is missing or reaches
the configured percentage of its duration left (by default, 5% of its two
minutes is six seconds), and the big button casts it once you have enough rage. Other
classes never see it, and warriors without Buffeteria aren't tracked for it.

Priests likewise see Inner Fire in the Buffs panel, on by default and skippable.
The tracker reminds you when it is missing (including after its charges run out)
or reaches the configured remaining percentage (by default, 5% of its ten
minutes is 30 seconds), and the big button casts it
once you have the mana. Other classes never see it, and priests without
Buffeteria aren't tracked for it.

Battle Shout and Inner Fire are also tracked during combat. When combat starts,
the head is set to cast your shout or Inner Fire, so if it runs low or falls off
mid-fight the head demands it and a click recasts it. Other buffs wait until combat…

releases.changelog:

who can resurrect are served first; feigning hunters and players already

addons.description:
A local-first Windows companion for World of Warcraft: Forever. It backs up
and restores your WTF folder, tracks your characters and gold, adds alt-aware
item tooltips through the ForeverBuddy addon, turns addons on or off per
character, and shows your macros. Its core features work offline, with your data kept on your PC.

> Not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment. World of Warcraft
> and Blizzard Entertainment are trademarks or registered trademarks of
> Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.

Built with Tauri 2, React, Tailwind CSS 4,
shadcn/ui, and the Warcraft-styled components from
warcraftcn/ui (MIT).

Specs and the addon bible live in the wow-forever-buddy mycelium room (context/specs/, procedures/addon-bible/).
Offline by design
Everything the UI needs ships inside the app — no CDN, no Google Fonts:
• The warcraftcn components and their art live in
src/components/ui/warcraftcn/. Their stylesheet originally hot-linked
images from warcraftcn.com; it now points at the local copies.
• Fonts (Cinzel, Geist) come from @fontsource packages and are bundled at
build time.

If you add more warcraftcn components, check the new files for https://
URLs, and fetch binary assets straight from the GitHub repo — the shadcn CLI
has corrupted the .webp files it installed from the warcraftcn registry.
Develop
Needs Node 20+ and Rust (plus the
Tauri prerequisites for your OS).
Releases
Publishing a GitHub release runs .github/workflows/release.yml, which builds
on Windows and attaches to the release:
• WoW Forever Buddy__x64-setup.exe — installer
• WoW Forever Buddy__x64_en-US.msi — MSI installer
• a plain .exe — portable, runs without installing (needs WebView2, which
ships with Windows 10 and 11)

Bump version in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json (and package.json) before
tagging. Start the release notes from .github/release-notes-template.md,
which carries the not-affiliated notice. The builds are unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen will warn the first
time you run one: More info → Run anyway.

Alts Forever 1.0.1
Fixes found in a full review of the code before the live launch.
• Rulesets (Normal, PvP, Roleplaying, Hardcore) are now named from what the game says it's running, not only from the realm name, so the overview and tooltips name them correctly on live realms whatever they're called.
• Moving to the live game: characters from the beta are recognised in older saves too (from before 0.12, which didn't record realms), and a live character whose realm couldn't be read once is never taken for one of them.
• Played time no longer counts time spent logged out.
• Professions: a profession you drop is no longer offered for crafting or skill-ups, and its recipes are forgotten (learn it again and its recipes read "Not scanned" until you open it). A login where the game hasn't sent your professions yet no longer loses them.
• Recipe tooltips: recipe lines no longer go missing after hovering a recipe before it has loaded.
• Upgrades: the same item with a better random suffix ("of the Monkey") now shows as an upgrade; a second copy of a ring that isn't unique can go on the other finger; an off-hand weapon is never compared with a shield.
• Bags window: a character's bank you haven't visited no longer shows their bags instead; a bag name that loads late fills in.
• Search: opened from another ruleset's bags window, it finds that character's items; item names that load slowly are waited for.
• Overview: the Mail column updates while the overview is open when you read your inbox or mail an alt.
• Gold history: days start at local midnight during daylight saving time too, not an hour off.
• Character sheet anvils: worked out once when a batch of items arrives instead of once per item; forgetting a crafter updates them.
• Sturdier saved data: more kinds of damage are repaired at login instead of causing errors.
• Hovering the same Waylaid Crate again is quicker.
Alts Forever 1.0.0
Ready for the launch of WoW Forever. Thank you to everyone who tried Alts Forever during the beta and sent ideas and reports: many of the features here came from you.
• Item names for use outside the game (off by default; options, or /af itemnames): for players who read Alts Forever's saved file with their own tools. Bags, bank and mail store only item IDs and counts there; with this on, the name and quality of every item your characters have are saved too when you log out. It adds nothing in the game and uses a little more memory, so leave it off unless you read the file. Thanks to the player who asked for this!
• Ready for the live game: the first time you log in on a live realm, Alts Forever forgets your characters from the beta, who don't carry over, along with their gold history and Legacy points, and tells you in chat (your settings are kept). A new character with the same name as one of your beta characters starts fresh instead of inheriting the beta one's bags, bank and gold.
• Sturdier saved data: if Alts Forever's saved file is damaged (edited by hand, or written by another copy of the addon), it's repaired when you log in instead of stopping the addon from loading. Only the damaged values are dropped and recorded again as you play; everything else is kept.
Alts Forever 0.16.0
• Export your characters (the note button in the overview's title bar, or /af export): every character's level, XP, rested, Well Rested, Legacy points, gold, professions, mail expiry, zone, time played and when you last played them, ready to copy with Ctrl+C, grouped by ruleset and faction like the overview. Pick the format: Spreadsheet (columns that paste straight into Excel or Google Sheets, with gold, percentages and dates as numbers), Text (readable lines for notes or chat) or Markdown table (for Notion, Obsidian and the like). (A player's request.)
• The overview's "Online" (your own row, under Last seen) is now in your game's language.

addons.description:
By Kadmai.

A World of Warcraft: Forever addon that adds a total and a per-character breakdown of an item to its tooltip:

Locations are shown as icons: a linen bag (bags), banker (bank), mailbox (mail) and white shirt (wearing). You can pick your own icons, or words instead, with /af icons.

The current character always comes first. Other characters are sorted by count. Already have counts from a bag addon such as Baganator? Turn ours off with Show item counts in the options (or /af counts); everything else in the tooltip stays.

Hovering the money at the bottom of your bags lists each character's gold and the total, laid out the same way (also in ElvUI's bags, and in EllesmereUI's when its own gold tracking is turned off). Hovering the experience bar lists your other characters still levelling, with their level, XP and rested XP, and hovering the reputation bar lists their standing with the faction you're watching.

Type /af to open the overview: every character with level and XP, rested XP (including what they've built up since logging out), Legacy points left to spend and their Well Rested rank, gold, main professions, zone, time played and when you last played them, with total time played at the bottom. With characters on more than one ruleset or both factions, they're grouped under headings such as "Normal · Horde", each with its gold total; click a heading to collapse it. Hover a row for details such as rested XP until full, hearthstone location and item level. Alts Forever 1.0.1
Fixes found in a full review of the code before the live launch.
• Rulesets (Normal, PvP, Roleplaying, Hardcore) are now named from what the game says it's running, not only from the realm name, so the overview and tooltips name them correctly on live realms whatever they're called.
• Moving to the live game: characters from the beta are recognised in older saves too (from before 0.12, which didn't record realms), and a live character whose realm couldn't be read once is never taken for one of them.
• Played time no longer counts time spent logged out.
• Professions: a profession you drop is no longer offered for crafting or skill-ups, and its recipes are forgotten (learn it again and its recipes read "Not scanned" until you open it). A login where the game hasn't sent your professions yet no longer loses them.
• Recipe tooltips: recipe lines no longer go missing after hovering a recipe before it has loaded.
• Upgrades: the same item with a better random suffix ("of the Monkey") now shows as an upgrade; a second copy of a ring that isn't unique can go on the other finger; an off-hand weapon is never compared with a shield.
• Bags window: a character's bank you haven't visited no longer shows their bags instead; a bag name that loads late fills in.
• Search: opened from another ruleset's bags window, it finds that character's items; item names that load slowly are waited for.
• Overview: the Mail column updates while the overview is open when you read your inbox or mail an alt.
• Gold history: days start at local midnight during daylight saving time too, not an hour off.
• Character sheet anvils: worked out once when a batch of items arrives instead of once per item; forgetting a crafter updates them.
• Sturdier saved data: more kinds of damage are repaired at login instead of causing errors.
• Hovering the same Waylaid Crate again is quicker.

ready layouts for all nine classes, and a shared settings panel in nine languages.

Download the latest release
and choose the attached complete-suite ZIP.

KerimAnka UI brings class artwork, action-button backgrounds, unit frames,
minimap presentation, quest tracking, experience and reputation displays,
threat, sound controls, and profile management into one settings panel.
Class designs and ready layouts
KerimAnka UI includes class-specific action bar artwork and ready layouts for
Warrior, Paladin, Hunter, Rogue, Priest, Shaman, Mage, Warlock and Druid.
The package includes all nine classes; it is not limited to Hunters.

Open Profiles, choose your current class's ready layout, review the
confirmation and apply it. The preset sets up the class-themed appearance and
layout together. Ready layouts are tuned for 1920 x 1080; other resolutions or
UI scales may need adjustments.
Screenshots
**The screenshots below show the Hunter design as an example. Each of the nine
classes listed above has its own themed design and ready layout.**
Hunter ready layoutShared settings panel
Class Art settings ·
Unit Frames preview and settings

These screenshots show the Forever client. The world is shown at night, and native
game text follows the player’s German client language.
Compatibility
Supports Forever (Interface 16001) and Classic Era (Interface 11509).
The same complete-suite ZIP includes separate client loaders. Classic Era uses
separate saved settings; its new features have not been ported to Forever yet.
Retail support is not claimed.

Ready layouts are tuned for 1920 x 1080, with the Classic layouts prepared
at 100% UI scale. Other resolutions or UI scales may need manual positioning;
automatic rescaling of saved layouts is not included.

• Ready layouts for all nine classes, with optional Bartender4 and Blizzard layout transfer.
• In-game layout editing with quick settings, previews and save/cancel.
• Combined bags and bank, item cooldown counters and saved inventory views.

• Optional World latency (MS) beside FPS, disabled by default.

These Classic additions use their own code path. Existing Forever functionality
is retained; this release does not claim the new Classic features for Forever.

• Ready layouts for all nine classes, with confirmation before applying a layout.
