• Sound controls, ready mute groups and custom sound FileDataID entries.
• Hunter range and aspect reminders.
• English, German, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, Spanish,
Brazilian Portuguese and Russian panel languages.

keep personal reports private and require separate consent for guild statistics.
Replays are idempotent, conflicting reports retain the original with an explanation,
and consent revocation excludes reports from corroboration and shared statistics.

Officers can choose the optional Battlegrounds page in /setup start status:true
to install or repair localized groups, results and statistics panels. Existing
channels and permissions are preserved; manual channel selection is available.
Installation does not enable capture, automatic posts or awards.

Leaderboards now keep advanced filters collapsed until needed, show only the
selected edition's classes, simplify date formatting and explain a counted-score
example. Help menus fit narrow viewports. Companion connection tests explain
missing setup and refresh actions no longer imply successful sync when unconfigured.

addons.description:
Raid and guild management for **WoW Forever, Classic Era/Hardcore, Burning Crusade Classic,
Mists Classic and Retail**: an in-game addon, a Discord bot and a small
Windows companion app that connects the two (optional for the addon alone, needed for Discord and website features; Windows only).
Free for noncommercial use (license).

| Part | What it does | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Addon | Raids, attendance, EPGP, four loot systems (GP bids, loot council, soft reserves, EPGP priority), recipes and cooldowns, the guild calendar, gear and consumable checks, a live Ready page, a friendly window (gold coin on the minimap). Works alone, no Discord needed. Party/roll games are in the separate optional Guilded Games Alpha. | addon/Guilded/ |
| Discord bot (optional, hosted Guilded Lite with approval for full access, or independent hosting) | Raid signups with roles and waitlist, raid cores with a bench and their own loot system and item prices, weekly raids, EPGP standings, loot log, soft reserves, who can craft what, guild calendar sync, dungeon challenge, craft board, readiness board, polls, Warcraft Logs, applications, moderation helpers. | src/ |
| Windows companion (optional for the addon alone; needed for Discord and website features) | Tray app that sends the addon's saved data to the bot after each /reload or logout and writes standings back into the game. Get it from Microsoft Store first; the unsigned GitHub download is the fallback. Windows only. | companion-app/, companion/ |
| Phone app (optional, not a store release) | Public leaderboards, plus Discord sign-in for linked characters, reserves, wishlist, raid standings and on-device raid reminders. It does not read the game's saved files. | mobile/ |

Every in-game and Discord command, and who can run it, is in COMMANDS.md.
What changed in each version: CHANGELOG.md.

Latest release: 8.4.2, fixing a companion startup crash on launch and polishing the
Link everything screen (8.4.1 added that screen, the redesigned owner console, quick
reference page, achievement cards and guild rank). See the
release notes and acceptance checklist.
GitHub and CurseForge downloads are 8.4.0 until a newer one is uploaded; the Microsoft Store companion updates separately (8.4.1.0 is live; do not rely on it, 8.4.2 fixes its startup crash).
Quick start
• Guildmates or addon-only players: follow the member install guide.
Install into the client you actually play: the folder beside the game's .exe (the beta used
_classic_beta_; check again on 4 November). To connect the companion, choose Sign in with Discord
(a /character pair code still works).
• Add the hosted bot: add it to your server and run /setup start; no hosting or database account needed. Guilded Lite (setup, help, bug reports, dungeon groups, basic signups) works right away; KCaron's approval unlocks addon sync, EP/GP, seasons and the guild page. Optional support never buys approval.
• Run your own guild's bot: follow the illustrated beginner walkthrough, with Discord and Oracle account links, screenshots and success checks.
• Plan a quick installation: use the 30-minute setup checklist, including what must be ready first.
• Optional Windows companion: install Guilded Companion from Microsoft Store, or use the standalone installer from GitHub Releases. Store installations update through Microsoft Store. Check the version offered by each channel.
• Want an AI to guide you: copy a setup or troubleshooting prompt.

Current version: 8.4.2 (3 November 2026, protocol 2). Release notes and acceptance record.
Supports Forever, Classic Era/Hardcore, TBC Anniversary, Mists Classic and Retail
across the addon, Discord bot and companion, including several guilds in one Discord.
Use the edition-specific ZIP from GitHub Releases.
The unsuffixed ZIP is the Forever build.

The owner authorized release before the unavailable Forever two-PC tests.
Game checks remain pending follow-up; benchmarks are provisional.…

Guilded 8.4.0 — Private battleground records and launch fixes
This candidate adds opt-in, own-character battleground capture for the Forever
adapter, private history, withdrawal corrections and scoped participation
statistics. Reports remain provisional: no verified match totals, rankings or
automatic awards are inferred. The client adapter is capability gated and still
requires live Forever acceptance.

Discord /bg privacy, /bg history, /bg result, /bg correct and /bg stats
keep personal reports private and require separate consent for guild statistics.
Replays are idempotent, conflicting reports retain the original with an explanation,
and consent revocation excludes reports from corroboration and shared statistics.

Officers can choose the optional Battlegrounds page in /setup start status:true
to install or repair localized groups, results and statistics panels. Existing
channels and permissions are preserved; manual channel selection is available.
Installation does not enable capture, automatic posts or awards.

Leaderboards now keep advanced filters collapsed until needed, show only the
selected edition's classes, simplify date formatting and explain a counted-score
example. Help menus fit narrow viewports. Companion connection tests explain
missing setup and refresh actions no longer imply successful sync when unconfigured.

Existing published8.3 artifacts remain unchanged. Actual acceptance and provider
availability are tracked separately in the release acceptance checklist.

Guilded 8.3.0 — Simpler navigation and optional automation
Prepared for the October 30 launch. Provider availability is separate from
source readiness. Acceptance: V8_3_0_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE.md.
• Website: direct My Guilded and leaderboard navigation, clearer edition
context, season boundaries and weekly-versus-selected-period explanations.
Short EN/FR member quick starts link separately to officer/self-hosting help.
• Companion: Home with a state-specific next action, direct guild/ranking
shortcuts, simpler navigation and optional tools. Web sync is retained for
browser/non-Windows use; Windows provides local background watching. Both
still need WoW to save addon data with reload/logout.
• Optional automation: private member weekly recap DMs, approved weekly
questions and opt-in vacancy alerts. Quiet hours, pause, delivery state,
permission/consent checks and duplicate suppression apply. Everything begins
off; configure it with /automation. No automatic awards.
• Private Battleground organization: EN/FR Create, Join, My groups and Upcoming
controls, one-off scheduling, owned-character edition/level checks and
waiting lists. Retail Blitz has a reviewed duo/healer queue policy. Other
formats remain explicitly planning-only until their queue rules are verified.
Limits and testing
BG capture and statistics are not included. Normal-realm/faction choices are
player declarations, not verified game telemetry. Hardcore BG remains disabled.
Game acceptance is NOT RUN — timing waived until after launch by the owner;
Forever tests cannot precede its November 4 opening. This is not a claim that
native, game or multi-account tests passed. Security, migration/recovery, CI and
non-game checks remain release gates. Frozen 8.2.0 provider files are unchanged.
Français
• Navigation plus simple : Mon Guilded, classements, édition choisie et périodes
visibles. Guide membre EN/FR court, séparé des références officiers/hébergement.
• Compagnon : accueil avec prochaine action, raccourcis et outils facultatifs.
La synchronisation Web reste disponible; Windows surveille les fichiers en
arrière-plan. WoW doit toujours enregistrer via recharge/déconnexion.
• Automatisations facultatives : bilan privé, question hebdomadaire et places
disponibles, avec accord, silence, pause et contrôle des doublons. Désactivées
par défaut; /automation permet de les configurer. Aucun point automatique.
• Organisation JcJ privée : formulaires, inscriptions personnelles et attente.
Les formats de file non vérifiés restent en planification seulement.

Les tests en jeu sont reportés après lancement, non exécutés, et ne sont pas
présentés comme réussis. Aucune capture ni statistique JcJ n'est publiée.

Guilded 8.2.0 — Release preparation
October 30, 2026. Protocol remains 2. Publication and final installed-client
acceptance are tracked separately in the integration record.
Use the 8.2.0 acceptance checklist for final testing.
This includes the 8.1 improvements and the additions below.
For members
• My Guilded has private calendar export, a personal data centre and shortcuts
for upcoming raids, sync and the private weekly recap (/report stats personal:true).
Calendar export is a manually refreshed snapshot of raid signups and team responses;
it includes cancellations and stable event identifiers, with UTC times for DST safety.
• Raid plans show approved playbooks, missed-raid catch-up notes and dated resources.
Private officer notes are never copied into them. Resource dates are supplied by
the author; Guilded does not fetch or independently verify the linked advice.
• Supply plans calculate targets from confirmed signups. Members can voluntarily
pledge supplies and record deliveries, change their own pledge or withdraw it.
Deliveries are self-reported, not verified inventory. A revised plan needs fresh pledges.
• Optional onboarding tracks professions and a first raid without restricting access.
• Targeted dungeon watch preferences and cooperative challenges reuse existing
participation data. Challenges are cosmetic and do not award competitive points.
For officers
• Preview and explicitly approve versioned raid playbooks, recaps and supply plans.
Concurrent stale edits are rejected. Withdrawal and revision history support recovery.
• Explainable bench advice uses recorded benches, signup order and role capacity.
Unknown history does not count against a member. Officers retain final selection;
the advice never changes a roster or awards points.
• The private handover page collects recent audit activity, pending reviews, upcoming
raids and delivery state. It links recovery procedures without claiming a backup was verified.
• Weekly community questions have preview, Post, Skip and Pause controls. Automatic
recurring delivery remains disabled until audience, channel and cadence are approved.
Reliability and polish
• Companion Activity distinguishes saved, uploaded and bot-received evidence for the
same snapshot, with edition, character, selected source and the next step. Receipt
does not imply officer approval. Diagnostic previews omit identities and paths.
• Stronger personal pairing, guild/realm/edition checks, browser revocation, stable
update notices, retry delivery, diagnostic audience checks and character correction.
Correcting a provisional character preserves its identity and dependent records.
• Test raids use disposable pools and exclude real members from simulated awards.
Cleanup removes referenced bot-authored test signup posts; older orphan posts still
require manual removal. Raid-edit confirmations now respect French guild language.
• Retail no longer displays the fallback Classic dungeon catalog without a season.
Clearing a simulated result dismisses its card. Setup backgrounds, translated
controls and save-button sizing are corrected in both addons.
Availability and testing limits
All five recognized WoW editions retain separate packages and data scopes.
Retail testing does not establish Forever compatibility; Forever opens November 4.
The authorized upcoming Season 1 timing review sets Forever Deadmines to 30 minutes,
Blackfathom Deeps to 35 and City of Dalaran to 40. These are provisional design
targets informed by authored guide ranges, not measured calibration. Other ordinary
editions retain their own design estimates; Retail native Mythic+ timers stay
mode-specific. Historical runs and active season snapshots are not rescored.
The five exported rule files carry timing provenance; production installation
requires a separate verified upcoming-season receipt.
Battle.net discovery still requires the server owner's Blizzard application setup.…

Guilded 8.1.0 release candidate 1
Testing prerelease for the November 4 launch. Application version: 8.1.0; protocol 2. Exact source: 6bdc80e97dd8294bb4226774dfc15c2552385706.

Includes confirmed RCLootCouncil/Gargul history import, per-device/background sync, optional Battle.net linking, editable December raid pricing and companion pricing/leaderboards. Existing pools are not automatically enabled.

Choose the addon ZIP for your actual WoW edition. Back up addon folders and SavedVariables before installation. The optional Windows EXE is unsigned and is the standalone distribution, not a Microsoft Store update. Preserve your existing profile; do not run two companions against the same game folder. Stable Store and CurseForge downloads remain 8.0.2.

Automated Linux/PostgreSQL/restore and Windows packaging checks passed on this exact source: https://github.com/kevincaron28/Guilded/actions/runs/40947760250 . Backend and authenticated browser checks passed; actual WoW gameplay, cross-PC sync and candidate installer execution remain unperformed.

Full notes: https://github.com/kevincaron28/Guilded/blob/6bdc80e97dd8294bb4226774dfc15c2552385706/docs/V8_1_0_RELEASE_NOTES.md
Pricing guide: https://github.com/kevincaron28/Guilded/blob/6bdc80e97dd8294bb4226774dfc15c2552385706/docs/RAID-PRICING.md

This prerelease does not replace the stable 8.0.2 release. Verify downloads using SHA256SUMS-v8.1.0-rc.1.txt.

Guilded 8.0.2 Release
Safety and reliability corrections from the final 8.0.1 audit. All agreed 8.0
features and the complete FR/DE/ES addon catalogues are retained. Protocol stays 2.
• In-game /guilded sheet protects formula-like text in spreadsheet cells,
including raid titles and loot fields. Numbers and formatted decimal values
stay numeric. Exporting does not alter SavedVariables or original field values.
• /participation status calculates season/weekly totals in PostgreSQL and
returns at most six rows. Old helper awards reversed this week, season/guild
scope, caps and financial history keep their existing behavior.
• Historical development notes now point to the published feature inventory.

This is a new patch release; published 8.0 and 8.0.1 files are preserved. Keep
SavedVariables and connection profiles when updating. The companion, bot and site
remain English/French; the addons also include German and Spanish.

The free Microsoft Store companion
uses Store signing and Store updates. The optional GitHub EXE remains unsigned.
No paid signing service or license change is introduced.

Validation/publication: release completion.
Forever game data and live calibration remain dependent on game availability;
the owner's earlier manual testing waiver remains recorded.

Current publication, installed Microsoft Store signature/profile verification and acceptance limits: 8.0.2 release evidence.

addons.description:
This addon alllows changing the colors of various background images and text, allowing you to not be blinded by the bright spellbook colors when opening the spellbook.

This includes options for:

Spell Text
Large Text (like the Specialization and Class)
Sub-Text (such as what indicates a spell being passive)
Separators (art pieces below each Large Text)
Bookmark
Page Number Text
Backplate / Backplate Highlight (the faint texture behind each spell text)
Background

In addition to these features, this addon also allows the ability to fade the spellbook frame (including the specialization and talents) when moving, similar to the default behavior of the map.

An option to show/hide the "Spellbook Colors" button can be found in the AddOn Compartment Frame, located by the Calendar Button on the Minimap. It is purposefully not clickable in the settings menu in case it's accidentally clicked.

addons.description:
This is still a work in progress addon.

This effects the following type of items: Quest items, items that start quests, some cooking recipes, and learnable mounts. Many of these items can be found / filtered here.

It's just meant to add a little bit of immersion into the game without a vast negative impact.

If you've found a quest item missing flavour text, you can send it here.

If there's a grammar or lore mistake, you can send it here.

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found here.

Slash Commands

There's 3 main slash commands:

/lit or /litt or /loreitemtooltips

This will bring up the colour picker to change the colour of the custom flavour text on items. You can also do /loreitemtooltips or /loreitemtooltip just in case some other addon has the same chat command of /lit (Legion Invasion Timer)

/lit reset

This will reset the colour back to the default yellow, but it'll also tell you the previous colour you had chosen in case you didn't want to actually reset so you can choose the colour values again.

/lit credits

This will bring up a list of people who've helped contribute to this project:

Small addon I thought I might as well share that sheaths your weapon. It's a very simple script and likely incompatible with Stay Unsheathed / Sheath. It doesn't have any extra options or customisation, so use one of the others if that's what you want.

addons.description:
Did you think that Vanilla was the best expansion? Do you miss your old artwork that sat behind those cookie cutter talents? Well I'm here to bring that back!

Yes, that's right. I change the artwork in the talent frame. I've used a mixture of artworks from Blizzard's concept art, Blizzard class website page, and the Artifact trait backgrounds.

Why? Well, this addon actually has a little bit of history. It's one of the first addons I actually worked on, and originally it was for the purpose of placing the old artworks back into the talent frame. Before the Dragonflight talent rework, they didn't have a background image. The talents were boring to look at. For the most part, it was nostalgia. The current ones are great, and now they're just the default option that's selectable as a new option in a dropdown menu in the Interface Addons pane under TalentArt.

I've had this idea to reintroduce the addon for a long time, but it wasn't until recently I was able to bring it back.

To do list:

More artworks.

Background Color Selection / Texture Color Selection.

Re-build compatibility with ElvUI, Aurora, and other Skin-like addons.

This is a screenshot album of some of the older addon

Thank you so much to everyone who supported me while making this addon! I've spent almost ~~20+~~ many hours working on this between the artwork and making sure everything was right. Beyond that, I'm going to lose track.

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found here.
addons.name: TalentArt

addons.description:
Because sometimes some unit frame addons (unintentionally) remove the targetting / deselect sounds.

Very simple script for playing the target selection sound and deselecting a target. Many unit frame addons will (unintentionally) lose this sound as a result of replacing the target unit frame. All this does is bring if back. If you play without an addon that skins the target unit frame, you probably won't see any difference.

Should work in all versions of the game including Dragonflight.

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found here.
addons.name: TargetSwapSound

addons.description:
This addon absolutely requires Total RP 3 as it is a module for such. What it does is allow the ability to change the Target and Player unit frame names, text color, and backdrop color for readability. It will also add a button which can be toggled on/of that will allow opening your own or your targets profile, with a few options to move the button around a bit. There is also the option for selected colors to apply to NPCs to help with readability, however it's very limited.

This is not meant to be a replacement of the default unit frames, but rather a bridge between them and the Total RP 3 addon. For the time being, this is untested with other unit frame addons and may be incompatible, however in time I may make compatibility options for the most popular projects.

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found here.
addons.name: Total RP 3: Unit Frames

addons.description:
Crafting profit helper for the WoW Forever client (Interface 16001), using Auctionator prices.

Deutsch weiter unten.
Features
• Profit list – every recipe of your character with reagent cost, sale price (after the 5% AH cut) and profit, sorted by profit.
• Prices from Auctionator – full scans, normal searches and the selling tab all feed the list. Vendor prices for reagents (thread, salt, flux …) are used when cheaper.
• Sub-recipes – reagents you can craft cheaper yourself (e.g. Cured Light Hide) are calculated at their crafting cost, recursively.
• Market check – number of listings at the AH, median price, warnings for old prices (~) and price spikes (!).
• Queue & shopping list – queue recipes with quantities; the shopping list subtracts bags and bank and is sent to Auctionator as list ForeverProfit.
• Craft list – craft the queue step by step (“Craft next”), intermediate steps first. The queue counts down automatically.
• Professions bar – left-click opens a profession, right-click filters the list.
• Leveling mode – recipes that still give skill, sorted by estimated cost per skill point.
• Custom prices – /fp price [item] 1g20s.
• German and English (follows the client language).
Requirements
• WoW Forever client (_classic_beta_, Interface 16001)
• Auctionator

addons.description:
Small quality-of-life features for World of Warcraft: Forever, in one addon. Each feature has its
own on/off switch, so you keep what you want and turn off the rest.

Download the latest release

| Feature | What you get | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| Quest Trash | A keep or delete verdict on quest item tooltips. /fqt lists everything in your bags (and bank) you can throw away. | QuestieDB |
| Kill Value | Expected gold per kill on creature tooltips: coins plus each drop's chance times its price. Learns real drop rates from what you loot. | Nothing (Auctionator optional) |
| Setups | Save a character's action bars, keybindings, macros, Edit Mode layout, interface settings and addon list, then apply them to another character. New characters can start from a saved setup. | Nothing |

All three are on by default.

Kill Value tooltip (earlier 1.12 version; a Forever screenshot is coming).
How it behaves
• Advice only. Quest Trash and Kill Value never delete, sell, loot or click anything for you.
Setups is the one feature that changes your UI: only out of combat, only when you click Apply (or
for a brand-new character, if you marked a setup for that), and always with an undo snapshot first.
• Plays by Forever's addon rules. Nothing reads combat data Blizzard hides from addons. Every
feature checks for hidden ("secret") values and steps aside instead of erroring. Inside instances,
where creature tooltip data is hidden, Kill Value shows nothing.
• Errors stay out of your way. Tooltip and event code runs protected, so a bad value skips a line
instead of throwing a Lua error.

addons.changelog:
1.0.4 (2026-11-02)
• Large restructuring and refactor: Unit Frames, Nameplates, Aura Reminders, Cooldown Manager, Skins, Profiles and the shared aura code were reorganised and rewritten module by module, with cleaner code and many old leftovers removed.
• Nameplates options: new layout. Visual cards with their own icons replace the tabs, the live preview sits above every section at a larger size, and each card shows only its own options, with the duplicates gone.
• Nameplates: the preview and the plates show each class resource with the game's own art, centred under the plate. Pips default to the colour of each resource.
• Nameplates: in the Friendly card the preview dims the health bar when it is off or set to show names only.
• Aura Reminders options: new layout with section cards, a preview column and a settings column, plus a new zone dialog and error flash.
• Resource Bars: the anchor block was redesigned, and a resource the unit frame already draws is no longer repeated.
• Resource Bars: Tip of the Spear for Survival and Whirlwind for Fury.
• Skins: new surface material across windows, and buttons no longer keep their default red look in the Group Finder, AddOn List, Auction House and other windows.
• Game Menu: new frame styles, crests and button styles, with position, order and visibility options for the KUI buttons and a live preview.
• Enhancements: new Battleground History, recording each battleground with filters and a summary.
• Layout: Focus, Pet, Target of Target and the combat timers follow their unit frames, and frames around Player and Target keep their gaps when the scale changes. Default positions now depend on client and resolution.
• Art: new portrait, nameplate, bar, cursor and category icons, plus lighter packaging with unused fonts and textures removed.
• Fixed: Enhancement Shaman nameplates no longer raise an error, and Maelstrom Weapon shows its stacks.
• Client detection: KUI now recognises the Forever client properly, so its own group finder skin, default layout and bar look apply, and Aura Reminders settings are kept between sessions. Existing profiles move to the Forever name automatically.
• Forever Visual Style: Action Bars default to the Blizzard button style.
• Fixed: a damaged profile string can no longer freeze the game on import. It now shows a clear message.
• Fixed: nameplates follow a specialization change without a reload, and the resource of the previous spec no longer stays.
• Fixed: nameplate settings for Friendly text now show the real values instead of blanks.
• Fixed: Blizzard plates come back correctly when a unit stops being hostile.
• Fixed: pips reappear when a resource returns to its higher maximum, and the Stagger bar handles missing values.
• Fixed: Aura Reminders no longer hides your reminder because of the same buff from another player, repeated talents now give feedback, and dragging icons during a refresh no longer breaks their order.
• Fixed: debug messages in chat are gone, and the Group Finder leader role icon shows again.
• Translations: new option labels and messages translated into every language, and garbled characters in the changelog window repaired.

Configuration changes after updating:
• Aura Reminders: a preferred flask saved by an older version returns to Last Used. Choose it again if you want a fixed one.
• Cooldown Manager: a bar anchored with an older saved value returns to its saved position.

If you update from 1.0.3 or lower, restoring defaults from the installer is recommended.

KullThranUI Forever brings KullThranUI's approach to interface customisation to WoW Forever, with an edition adapted to that client.

Its modules let you decide how much of your interface you want to change. Pick a visual style, adjust your layout and colours, and build something that feels comfortable to play with. You can start small and make it your own over time.

Visit the website for screenshots and a closer look at the project.

• Forever Visual Style: Action Bars default to the Blizzard button style.
• Fixed: a damaged profile string can no longer freeze the game on import. It now shows a clear message.
• Fixed: nameplates follow a specialization change without a reload, and the resource of the previous spec no longer stays.
• Fixed: nameplate settings for Friendly text now show the real values instead of blanks.
• Fixed: Blizzard plates come back correctly when a unit stops being hostile.
• Fixed: pips reappear when a resource returns to its higher maximum, and the Stagger bar handles missing values.
• Fixed: Aura Reminders no longer hides your reminder because of the same buff from another player, repeated talents now give feedback, and dragging icons during a refresh no longer breaks their order.
• Fixed: debug messages in chat are gone, and the Group Finder leader role icon shows again.
• Translations: new option labels and messages translated into every language, and garbled characters in the changelog window repaired.

Configuration changes after updating:
• Aura Reminders: a preferred flask saved by an older version returns to Last Used. Choose it again if you want a fixed one.
• Cooldown Manager: a bar anchored with an older saved value returns to its saved position.

If you update from 1.0.3 or lower, restoring defaults from the installer is recommended.

addons.description:
World of Warcraft professions addon. Your professions companion: browse recipes, plan what to craft, and find out where to get every recipe and ingredient.

For WoW Forever (Fabrikao.toc: interface 16001), Classic Era (Fabrikao_Vanilla.toc: 11508, 11509) and TBC Anniversary
(Fabrikao_TBC.toc: 20506). What it does is in CURSEFORGE_DESCRIPTION.md and CHANGELOG.md: the
character's professions, every recipe of the game (known or not) with filters, a table and a detailed view, a panel with everything
known about a recipe, a search of every recipe, trainers, vendors and creatures on the map (and TomTom waypoints), and optional
the professions and known recipes of your other characters (read only), and optional integrations with Embolsao (items of the other
characters) and Auctionator (prices).

DPSPulse Forever v0.2.0Features
• Added a complete in-game configuration panel under Esc → Options → AddOns → DPSPulse Forever.
• Added live controls for window visibility, position lock, rolling-window duration, UI scale, debug mode, session reset, and position reset.
• Added persistent Original / minimal and Blizzard / native appearance options.
• Added a WoW Forever-inspired native skin with bronze trim, layered title bar, warm panel colors, a subtle chart grid, and a low-contrast DPSPulse watermark.
• Added /dpsf skin and /dpsf resetposition shortcuts.

Existing graph behavior and WoW Forever-compatible UNIT_COMBAT tracking remain unchanged.
addons.description:
WoW Forever (beta, client 1.60.1) port of DPSPulse.

DPSPulse Forever shows a realtime rolling DPS graph and current DPS value during combat, with a Details-style dual-series overlay (rolling window + full-session).

This port began as a straight port of DPSPulse tag v0.3.0. The graph and damage-tracking behavior remain unchanged, while the WoW Forever edition now adds native in-game options and a choice of window skins.
Status
• Interface: 16001 (confirmed via in-game GetBuildInfo() on build 1.60.1.69893).
• CurseForge project ID: 1719813; WoW Forever 1.60.1 release uploads are enabled.
• Version 0.2.0 adds an Esc > Options > AddOns panel and a live, persistent Blizzard/native skin.
WoW Forever combat log limitation
WoW Forever hard-taints (ForceTaint_strong) any addon that registers COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED, so this port uses the taint-free UNIT_COMBAT event instead. That comes with real caveats vs. the TBC original:
• Damage is only counted while the mob is your current target. If you tab off mid-fight (or the mob dies before you retarget) any in-flight events are lost.
• Group content may over-count. UNIT_COMBAT fires for damage the unit takes, not damage you deal — in a party/raid, other players' hits on the same mob will inflate your numbers. Solo and small-group tuning is where this port shines.
• DoTs and environmental damage may not be surfaced. UNIT_COMBAT skips much of what the combat log covers.
• Only WOUND actions are tracked (actual damage). Misses/dodges/parries/blocks are ignored for DPS math.

This is intentional — WoW Forever's design philosophy on combat log privacy is respected. See PLAN.md for the upstream API investigation notes.
Options and commands
All display settings are available under Esc > Options > AddOns > DPSPulse Forever (with a legacy Interface Options registration fallback). The panel controls visibility, position lock, rolling window (2–60 seconds), UI scale (0.5–2), debug mode, Classic/Blizzard skin, session reset, and window-position reset. Changes apply immediately and persist in DPSPulseForeverDB where applicable.

Slash commands remain available:
• /dpspulseforever (alias /dpsf) — toggle frame.
• /dpsf show, hide, lock, unlock, reset, or debug.
• /dpsf window and /dpsf scale .
• /dpsf skin and /dpsf resetposition.

addons.description:
Play live with Musician using a MIDI keyboard.
Table of contents
• How it works
• Choosing the translator
• Setting up the translator
• Solution 1: Bome MIDI Translator Classic
• Solution 2: Bome MIDI Translator Pro
• Solution 3: Musician MIDI Pico Translator
• Configuration for macOS
1. Function keys configuration
2. Permissions
• How to play
• Deal with audio delay
• Using a hardware synthesizer
• Using a software synthesizer
1. Install Sforzando
2. Install FlexASIO (optional, Windows only)
3. Configure Sforzando
4. Configure MIDI thru (optional)
5. Play!
How it works
There is no possible way to use MIDI in World of Warcraft. The trick is to translate the MIDI note events that come from your MIDI controller into PC keyboard keystrokes, that can then be captured by the add-on interface.

The translator can be either:
• a third party application that runs on your computer and emulates a PC keyboard

or
• a custom MIDI interface that connects directly to your MIDI controller using a 5-pin DIN connector on one side, and to your computer as a standard USB PC keyboard on the other side.
Choosing the translator
There are 3 translator solutions available to you, each of them having their pros and cons. It's up to you to choose the most suitable for you:
1. Bome MIDI Translator Classic : recommended solution if you play on Windows and already have a standard MIDI interface or USB MIDI controller. It's simple to configure and easy to use. It's a charged program for commercial use (29 €) but you can use it for free without any limitation (remember WinRAR).
2. Bome MIDI Translator Pro : recommended solution if you play on macOS and already have a standard MIDI interface or USB MIDI controller. As for the classic version, it's simple to configure and easy to use but it's quite expensive (79 €). You can use the free trial version but you have to restart it every 20 minutes.
3. Musician MIDI Pico Translator : Plug and play DIY solution for MIDI controllers with a 5-pin DIN MIDI output. The parts are inexpensive (less than 10 €) and easy to source from online and local retailers. The building process is straightforward and just requires basic tools such as soldering iron. It's recognized by the computer as a standard USB keyboard so no additional software or driver is required. It also includes a MIDI to USB interface that can be used with music production software or a software synthesizer to mitigate the audio delay issue.

| | Solution | Type | OS | Price | Pros | Cons |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | Bome MIDI Translator Classic | Software | Windows | 0 - 29 € | Free | Windows only |
| 2. | Bome MIDI Translator Pro | Software | Windows / macOS | 79 € | Works on macOS | Expensive |
| 3. | Musician MIDI Pico Translator | Hardware | Windows / macOS / Linux | ⚠️ If you're running macOS, a few extra configuration steps are required regardless of the solution you chose. Check out the Configuration for macOS section when you're done.

> ⚠️ If you need a 5-pin DIN MIDI to USB interface to use with Bome MIDI Translator, make sure to use a quality product like the Roland UM-ONE mk2 to avoid problems. Avoid the cheap off-brand models from Amazon and AliExpress.

Feel free to join our Discord server for further assistance.
Solution 1: Bome MIDI Translator Classic
Download and install Bome MIDI Translator Classic.

1. Connect your MIDI controller.
2. Start Bome MIDI Translator Classic.
3. Open the Musician preset.bmtp file that is provided in the Interface/AddOns/MusicianMIDI folder.
4. Open the Midi In menu.
5. Select your MIDI input device.

Solution 2: Bome MIDI Translator Pro
Download and install Bome MIDI Translator Pro.

1. Connect and turn on your MIDI controller.
2. Start Bome MIDI Translator Pro.
3. Open the Musician preset.bmtp file that is provided in the Interface/AddOns/MusicianMIDI folder.
4. Open the MIDI menu option then click Project Default MIDI Ports.…

===================

WoW Dings allows you to add funny symbols into your chat messages such as smilies, arrows, hearts etc. Just type the code corresponding to the symbol you want in your message, it will be automatically replaced. For example, :) will be replaced by ☺, (l) will become ♥ and so on. Of course, other players do not need the addon to see the symbols you insert. However, the symbols may not be visible to players who have changed the default font of the game by another one that does not include the symbols.

Also works in Battle.net discussions.

Doesn't work for /say, /yell and /raidwarning messages.

Also implements the following macro shortcuts:
• (here) Name of your current location
• (pin) World map pin of your current location (WoW Retail only)
• (t) Detailed information about the targeted player

Type /wd to display the list of available symbols.

addons.changelog:
Changelog1.0.0
First release, for World of Warcraft: Forever and Retail.
• Rain and snow on demand, anywhere, for as long as you want. When the server
sends its own rain or snow, Comfy Rain steps aside and lets the real thing fall.
• Four intensities each, plus monsoon and blizzard.
• /comfy auto matches the server's current weather in one shot.
• Layered ambience built from the game's own weather loops, with wind gusts and
distant thunder. Two beds of unequal length run under each other so the loop
never settles into a recognisable cycle.
• A Volume slider for the rain and snow that leaves your game volume alone.
Thunder and wind follow the game's own volume for now.
• Gusts drive the rain, the sound and the light from one shared signal.
• Rain streaks and snow flakes are smaller and far more numerous, so heavy
weather reads as a downpour or a real snowfall rather than as bars and
snowballs drawn over the screen, and the distant layer is visible again
behind the near one. Blizzard streaks no longer read as scratches on glass.
• Time-of-day grading: hold the world at dusk, or run it on your own clock.
• Fades down under a roof rather than raining on the ceiling.
• A settings window at /comfyrain. Every control shows the slash command it ran.
addons.description:
Rain or snow wherever you are, for as long as you want.

World of Warcraft decides when it rains. The server picks the weather, it picks it per
zone, and a lot of zones never get any. Comfy Rain is the switch the game does not give you:
type /comfy and it is raining, in Durotar, in Elwynn, at the top of a mountain, on the
deck of the boat. Type it again and it stops.

Works on WoW Forever and Retail. The Classic versions are not supported yet (issue #20).

It knows when to get out of the way. If the server sends a real storm, Comfy Rain stands
aside and lets it fall: the game's own rain is 3D, so it stops under an arch or a bridge
the way rain should, and where the real thing exists it is simply the better of the two.

What you get
| | |
|---|---|
| Rain and snow | Four intensities each, from a drizzle to a monsoon or a whiteout blizzard |
| Sound | Blizzard's own weather loops, layered and endlessly varied, with distant thunder |
| Wind | Gusts that move the rain, the sound and the light together, not on a timer |
| Time of day | Hold the world at dusk, or run it on your clock instead of the realm's. Works on its own, with the rain switched off |
| Indoors | Fades down under a roof instead of raining on the ceiling |
| The game's own weather | When the game is raining or snowing for real, Comfy Rain hides so you never see both, and comes back when it stops. It cannot stop the game's weather; no addon can. /comfy defer off keeps yours on top |
| Scenes | /comfy preset cozy, storm, snow or overcast sets a whole weather; dusk or night sets just the time of day. Each leaves the other alone, so night with no rain is /comfy off plus /comfy preset night |
| A settings window | /comfyrain, the minimap button, the addon compartment, or a keybind of your own. Every control shows you the command it ran, so you learn them by using it |
Getting started
That is the whole thing. Everything below is optional.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| /comfy | Turn the weather on or off |
| /comfy preset cozy · storm · snow · overcast | A whole look in one go. Also buttons at the top of the settings window |
| /comfy preset dusk · night | Just the light. The weather stays as it is |
| /comfy rain · /comfy snow | Pick which |
| /comfy light · normal · heavy | How hard |
| /comfy monsoon · /comfy blizzard | The two extremes |
| /comfy auto | Match whatever the server is doing right now |
| /comfyrain | Open the settings window |

The rest of the commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| /comfy indoors off \| dim \| on | What happens under a roof. dim is the default |
| /comfy sound on \| off | The ambience bed |
| /comfy volume 0.5 | How loud, over the weather only |
| /comfy thunder on \| off | Lightning and thunder |
| /comfy channel Ambience \| SFX \| Master | Which of the game's volume sliders owns it |
| /comfy time local | Light the world by your clock, not the realm's. Works with the rain off |
| /comfy time 21 · /comfy time +9 | Hold one hour, or shift the realm's by that many |
| /comfy time strength 0.6 | How far towards that hour. The rest is in the settings window |
| /comfy status | What it currently thinks it is doing |
| /comfy reset | Back to defaults |

/rain is an alias for /comfy, and /comfyui also opens the window.
What it is, honestly
Comfy Rain is a screen-space overlay. It draws scrolling layers of rain in front of the
camera and dims the frame behind them. It does not touch the game's 3D weather system,
its particles, its lighting or its sky, because addons are not allowed anywhere near any
of those.

In practice that means:
• It looks right when you are looking at the world. It is weather on your screen.
• It cannot put rain outside a window while you stand indoors. There is one overlay and
no way to ask the client which pixels are sky, so indoors it fades to a faint wash
instead. /comfy indoors off turns it off entirely.…

sends its own rain or snow, Comfy Rain steps aside and lets the real thing fall.
• Four intensities each, plus monsoon and blizzard.
• /comfy auto matches the server's current weather in one shot.
• Layered ambience built from the game's own weather loops, with wind gusts and
distant thunder. Two beds of unequal length run under each other so the loop
never settles into a recognisable cycle.
• A Volume slider for the rain and snow that leaves your game volume alone.
Thunder and wind follow the game's own volume for now.
• Gusts drive the rain, the sound and the light from one shared signal.
• Rain streaks and snow flakes are smaller and far more numerous, so heavy
weather reads as a downpour or a real snowfall rather than as bars and
snowballs drawn over the screen, and the distant layer is visible again
behind the near one. Blizzard streaks no longer read as scratches on glass.
• Time-of-day grading: hold the world at dusk, or run it on your own clock.
• Fades down under a roof rather than raining on the ceiling.
• A settings window at /comfyrain. Every control shows the slash command it ran.

addons.description:
A complete mailbox for World of Warcraft. Collect, sort, send, search and track
your mail, on every version of the game from Classic Era to modern Retail, and
on World of Warcraft: Forever.

Parcel exists because Postal stopped being maintained and Mailbox Plus was
discontinued, leaving a gap where the most used utility addon in the game used
to be. It is a full replacement for the default mail window, not a set of buttons
bolted onto it: one click empties your mailbox, and a real scrolling window with
search, sorting and click shortcuts replaces the seven row pane.

Then it goes further than either addon it replaces.

History. Every mail Parcel sees is archived and stays searchable long after
it has left your mailbox. Find the item somebody posted you months ago, read the
letter again, and see what became of it.

Auction house data. What you earned, what sold, what the house took, and
what a listing actually netted after deposit and cut, all worked out from the
mail the auction house already sends you. No scanning and no second addon.

It works away from the mailbox. Open Parcel anywhere to search your history
and read your auction numbers. The inbox says plainly when it is showing records
rather than live mail.

It watches every character. At login Parcel tells you which of your alts has
mail about to expire, because it remembers what was waiting in their mailboxes.
Nothing else can tell you that.
Features
Inbox
• Parcel's own scrolling window in place of the seven row pane, with no paging
• Search as you type across senders, subjects, item names and mail text
• Sort by sender, subject, value or time remaining
• Hover a mail for every attachment, what is enclosed, and its fate on expiry
• An icon per row shows whether a mail returns or is deleted when it runs out,
and clicking it does that now
• Shift-click to take a mail, ctrl-click to return it, right-click to tick it
• Select a range, or everything from one sender, then Open or Return the lot
• Parcel's own reader opens beside the window with working attachments

Collecting
• One button empties the mailbox, gold and attachments, until nothing is left
• Never automates cash on delivery or Blizzard mail
• Full bags only hold back mail carrying items, so auction gold still comes in
• Keeps as many bag slots free as you ask, and still takes anything that tops up
a stack you already carry
• Handles mailboxes past the hundred mail cap, asking the server for the rest
• Collect only what you want: auction sales, wins, expiries, cancellations,
outbid notices, Postmaster mail and everything else are separate switches
• Shift-click Collect to take everything and ignore those filters for one run
• Reports every mail to chat with item links and a total when it finishes

History
• Every mail Parcel sees is archived and indexed, and outlives your mailbox
• Search with from: to: item: subject: body: type:, or plain words
• Mistype something and it falls back to near matches instead of nothing
• Filter by character, or look across all of them
• Reopen any archived mail in full, attachments and tooltips intact
• Records whether each mail was collected, returned, deleted or is still waiting
• Mark a record taken by hand when Parcel was not watching
• Keep as much or as little as you like, by days and by a hard entry ceiling

Auction house
• Earned, sold, house cut and spent, by day, week, month, year or all time
• Top sellers ranked by what they actually netted, not by how many moved
• Click any of them for its own panel: every sale, the average per unit, the
best one, and the span it sold over
• Every sale listed with the deposit and the cut broken out
• Profit and loss counts the gold you take at a vendor, so buying under the
vendor price and selling the difference reads as the profit it is
• Vendored items are matched back to the auction they were bought at, with one
line in chat when you leave the vendor…

addons.description:
Sagalore is a saga log for a World of Warcraft group. One person plays. The desktop companion installs the addon, signs in with Battle.net, and syncs sagas. The addon has no HTTP of its own: it writes chat lines and SavedVariables, and the companion posts them.

Site: sagalore.app · API: api.sagalore.app · Product: github.com/sagalore/sagalore · Website: github.com/sagalore/website
Free and open source
Three parts, on purpose:

1. The project. Sagalore is free and open source (MIT). The addon, the companion, and the API are in this repository. Anyone can read the code, run it, and host their own server on any host that runs containers (or a Go binary) and Postgres.
2. The official server. The easiest way to start is the official server at sagalore.app / api.sagalore.app, which is free to use. Your data is stored there, and you sign in with Battle.net.
3. The MCP. There is an official MCP that lets your AI create sagas. It is built on the open Sagalore API and runs on Smia, a platform we also make. The MCP is not in this repo: Sagalore stays independent of any one platform, and the listing is also a way to show people Smia. Want your own MCP? The API is documented — build away. See docs/API.md and docs/oauth.md.

The marketing site is a separate repository (sagalore/website). This product repo does not ship or serve the landing page.
Project status
Early public / alpha. One maintainer. Expect rough edges, unsigned binaries, and slow replies on issues.
• Built with heavy Cursor (AI) assistance for a lot of the code. Architecture and merge decisions are human-owned; review PRs as carefully as you would any agent-assisted codebase.
• Assets were AI-generated or AI-assisted too: logo / emblem / wordmark, landing copy, and UI frames / chrome. Treat the brand as provisional, not commissioned art.
• Day-to-day development and playtesting: macOS Apple silicon, WoW Classic Era (and Forever). The Windows companion is built in CI; in-game Windows play is not systematically tested.
• Not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard. Unofficial software; ToS risk is yours.
• Release binaries are not signed. Gatekeeper and SmartScreen warnings are expected.
• Leaderboard finish times are client-reported (honor-based), not anti-cheat.
Try it locally
You need Docker, Go, and a WoW client. Postgres and the API come from Compose. Login in development uses SAGALORE_DEV_TOKEN so you do not need a Battle.net app for the first run.

That starts Postgres and the API, waits for /healthz, and seeds the Elwynn tutorial sagas. In another terminal:

The API container must have the same SAGALORE_DEV_TOKEN. make dev sets dev-token for local use only.

The companion installs Interface/AddOns/Sagalore. In game, /reload, then /sagalore or /sl.

If the database already has sagas and no group, set SAGALORE_BOOTSTRAP_GROUP=slug:Name before the API starts.
Self-host
Anyone can run the API + Postgres and point a companion at it. Short checklist and env table: docs/self-hosting.md. For a real (non-dev-token) login you need your own Battle.net app, PUBLIC_BASE_URL, and secrets as described there. Official release binaries bake SAGALORE_API_URL; self-hosted companions pass --api-url.
What you set before a real login
• Register a Battle.net application for this host. The redirect URI is {PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/v1/auth/bnet/callback. Blizzard will not accept a random loopback port, so the secret stays on the API.
• BNET_CLIENT_ID and BNET_CLIENT_SECRET on the API.
• PUBLIC_BASE_URL for that redirect and for signed cover URLs.
• Official release binaries get the public API URL from the GitHub Actions variable SAGALORE_API_URL (-ldflags). A self-hosted companion passes --api-url.
Groups
A player is a Battle.net account (bnet_account_id and BattleTag). Characters come from the addon. A name and realm sticks to the first account that linked it. If the character line includes a BattleTag, it must match the logged-in account.…

Changelog
All notable changes to CraftBoard are documented here.
The format is based on Keep a Changelog,
and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.
[Unreleased][1.0.0] - 2026-10-06
CraftBoard 1.0: from a crafting-order board to a crafting companion for Forever.
Added
• Find: "Hide what I can craft" in the Filter menu leaves out what you can get without anyone
else: what this character makes, and items your characters on this realm and faction make and
can mail you. An enchant only an alt knows stays listed (without a scroll it has to be put on
your gear in person), with the other players who know it. Professions with nothing left drop
out of the menu while it is on.
• Plan tab: your professions with their learned recipes by skill-up colour (orange, yellow,
green, grey), ready ones first. The card says how many crafts reach the next milestone, when you
can train the next rank, and which reagents the planned crafts need (with what your alts hold).
Queue adds the planned crafts to your queue; Craft makes them while that profession's window is
open, one click per batch.
• Craft and Craft next on the queue: make a queued craft, or the next one your bags allow, from
the Requests tab while the profession window is open.
• Mats across alts: CraftBoard remembers bags and bank per character; reagent slots show "+12 on
alts" and item tooltips say which alt holds how many.
• Reagent tooltips: how many of your recipes use the item and what your queue needs of it.
• Recipe tooltips: which of your characters know the recipe, can learn it, or need more skill.
• Buy missing mats: at a merchant, one button buys the vendor reagents your queue still lacks.
• Cooldown-ready notice and trainer reminders (one quiet chat line each; options).
• The minimap button's tooltip sums it up: requests you can craft, the queue, ready cooldowns,
trainable ranks.
• Welcome window rewritten for the wider focus.
• Requests tab reworked: rows show what is wanted (item icon and name, "3x" for more than one)
and who asked, in a muted "Bob · 8m". New group order: "You can craft" (board requests and chat
asks one of your characters can make, ready ones first), "My queue", "Open requests", "Seen in
chat", "My requests". Rows older than 10 minutes are dimmed. A Filter with "Only what I can
craft", a right-click menu on every row, and a count on the Requests tab.
• The request card says whether you know the recipe (or which alt does), whether they bring the
mats, what you are missing, and how often they asked. The chat line is only quoted when it says
more than the title. Asking again for the same thing updates the one row instead of adding one.
• Crafter queue: "Queue" on a request you can craft; "My queue" lists them with an "All reagents"
row summing everything against your bags and bank. A trade that hands the craft over takes it
off the queue.
• Multi-crafter chains: when a craft needs an intermediate someone else makes (for example an
Elixir of Lesser Defense for Toughened Leather Gloves), reagent tooltips name who makes it,
"Post linked orders" asks the board for it, and Post request in Find posts those linked orders
with the request. Linked orders show on each other's cards and are retracted together.
• Cooldown sharing: transmutes, Mooncloth and other crafting cooldowns show as "ready" or time
left next to crafters in Find; /cb cd lists your characters' cooldowns.

chat), a button under the trade window casts it on their item in "Will not be traded". It
waits while the enchant's reagents aren't in your bags.

tooltips. Never sent anywhere.
• "Back online" notice: one quiet chat line when a player whose request you can craft, or offered
on, logs back in (option, default on).
• Group tooltips: in a party or raid, item tooltips name the group members who can craft the item…
addons.description:
A crafting companion for World of Warcraft: Forever: level your professions, plan and craft,
and find crafters or customers.

Forever brought back the Classic world but not retail's crafting orders, so finding a crafter still
means repeating "LF LW, have mats" in Trade and hoping. CraftBoard adds a crafting board to the
game's own Professions window: see who can craft what, whisper them, or post a request that
crafters on your realm can see.

Download: CurseForge or the
GitHub releases. Works with the
CurseForge app and WowUp under the Forever game version.
Features
• Part of the Professions window. CraftBoard is a tab under your profession tabs, built from
the same frame, fonts and textures as Blizzard's window. Characters without professions get the
same board as a standalone window.
• Recipes shared automatically. Open each profession window once and every recipe you know is
shared with other CraftBoard users on your realm. Bind-on-Pickup crafts are never shared, since
nobody can hand those over.
• Find. Search any item and see everyone who can craft it, grouped by category like
Blizzard's list. Reagents show what you have and what is missing. "Hide what I can craft" in the
Filter menu leaves out what you or your alts can already provide (an alt's enchant stays, since
it can't reach your gear), so only crafts you need someone else for are listed.
• Requests. Post an order with a quantity and a note. Crafters see it on the board and offer
with one click.
• Seen in chat. Players asking for a crafter in Trade or General ("LF enchanter", "WTB [item]")
are listed on the Requests tab, with a green check when you can make it. This works even when
nobody else on your realm runs CraftBoard.
• Plan your leveling. The Plan tab sorts your recipes by skill-up colour, says how many crafts
reach the next rank, and reminds you when to visit your trainer.
• Craft from the board. Queue crafts from requests or your plan, then Craft next works through
them while the profession window is open. At a vendor, one button buys the missing thread,
vials and flux.
• Your alts count. Reagents on your other characters show up in slots and tooltips, and recipe
tooltips say which of your characters can learn a recipe.
• Queue and chains. Queue the requests you take on and see the reagents for all of them at
once. When a craft needs an intermediate someone else makes, post linked orders for it.
• Trade window help. One click casts a requested enchant on your partner's item, and
CraftBoard privately counts how often you've crafted for each other.
• Cooldowns. Transmute and Mooncloth cooldowns show next to crafters; /cb cd lists yours.
• Busy mode. Mark yourself busy and other users see you greyed out and can't whisper you from
the board. It turns on by itself in dungeons and raids.
• Advertise. One button posts a single plain line to Trade for players without the addon, at
most once a minute.
• In your language. English, German, French and Spanish.
• Easy to reach. Minimap button, addon compartment, a key binding, and /cb.
Principles
• Nothing happens on its own. CraftBoard never sends a whisper, invite, trade or chat line
without your click. No keyword auto-replies.
• No gold. Prices and tips are agreed in whispers, like always. Nothing here works like an
auction house or GDKP.
• Fair ordering. Online crafters are listed first, then shuffled each session. There are no
ratings, featured spots or anything you can pay for.
• Private by default. Chat lines are kept in memory for 30 minutes and never saved or shared.
"Crafted for you" counts stay on your computer.
• Non-combat. Unaffected by Forever's combat addon restrictions.
Commands
| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| /cb | Open or close CraftBoard |
| /cb find [text], /cb requests, /cb plan | Open a tab (Find searches for the text) |
| /cb busy | Toggle busy |
| /cb cd | List crafting cooldowns on your characters |…

[Unreleased][0.9.4] - 2026-09-27Added
• Busy / available (requested on Reddit): mark yourself busy with /cb busy, shift-right-click
on the minimap button, or the "Available" / "Busy" switch on the board header. Other
CraftBoard users then see you greyed out with "(busy)" in the crafter list, can't pick you
from it, and their Whisper button stays off; busy crafters are listed after available ones
and still count as online. By default you are also busy automatically in dungeons, raids and
combat (option "Automatically mark me busy in dungeons and combat"). Older versions simply
don't see the flag.
• "Seen in chat" knows your alts: the check is green when any of your characters knows the
recipe and this one carries the mats, and grey when only an alt knows it; the row tooltip
says which alt.
• /cb chatdebug also lists the chat channels the watcher has accepted so far (for example
"Trade, Trade (Services)").
[0.9.3] - 2026-09-27Fixed
• Your own character no longer shows up as a peer ("1 crafter online" with nobody else installed).
• Adverts with bracketed words like [PvP] are no longer read as crafting requests; a plain
[Name] only counts when it is one of your recipes.

chat watcher, so peers and chat requests never appeared.

recognised by the chat watcher.
Added

LookingForGroup, say and yell for players looking for a crafter ("LF LW for...",
"WTB [item]", "need an alch", "anyone can make [item]?") and lists them between Open requests
and My requests, one line per player, newest first, for 30 minutes. Offers ("WTS", "selling",
"LFW", "can craft", "tips welcome", "max ench") are skipped. A green check marks lines for one
of your professions or a recipe you know; the card shows the chat line and, for a known
recipe, your reagents. Whisper opens the chat box to the player with
"[CraftBoard] I can craft that for you." typed in; Hide drops the line. Nothing is sent
without a click and nothing is saved.
• Options "Watch chat for crafting requests" (on) and "Include guild chat" (off).

closes the Professions window as usual. The minimap button, /cb and the key binding open the

buttons on the Professions window are gone while the tab is there. CraftBoard never goes
through Blizzard's own tab switching, so crafting is unaffected.

minimap edge; the position is remembered. Also listed in the addon compartment (the addon
list button by the minimap) on clients that have one.

addons.description:
Dwarf Explorer's Bible (WoW: Forever) v1.0.4
What can I make with this? Pick any material and Dwarf Explorer's Bible shows every recipe that uses it, what each one is worth at the auction house right now, and where the result goes next.
• Pick a material: Alt-click any item (bags, chat links, loot, the AH), type /deb linen cloth, paste a link, or use the search box.
• Every recipe that uses it: profession, skill level (orange when it's above yours), the other reagents, and whether you know the recipe.
• Prices and profit: the latest auction price for the material, every reagent and every crafted result, the reagent cost, and the estimated profit after the 5% AH cut. Each price says which addon it came from.
• Follow the chain: click a result to see what that makes: Linen Cloth > Bolt of Linen Cloth > Linen Bag. Back walks the chain back. "Made from" flips to the recipes that create the item.
• Tooltip line: "Used in N recipes (Dwarf Explorer's Bible)", with its price and source.
• LDB launcher for Titan Panel, ChocolateBar and other broker displays.

Price sources
Dwarf Explorer's Bible reads prices from whichever price addon you already use. The first source in your order that has a price wins:

| Source | API used | Forever (16001) build |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PriceLog (mine) | KennyPriceLog.GetLatest(itemID) | Yes |
| Auctionator | Auctionator.API.v1.GetAuctionPriceByItemID | Yes (341, Oct 13 2026) |
| TradeSkillMaster | TSM_API.GetCustomPriceValue("DBMarket"), then DBMinBuyout | Not yet; works when it ships one |
| Auctioneer (Forever) | AucAdvanced.API.GetMarketValue | Yes (4.0.0) |
| Dwarf Explorer's Bible scan | prices it sees in AH searches you do | Always on |

No price addon? It still works: every AH search you make (browse or commodity) is cached. It never searches on its own.
Change the order with /deb prefer auctionator or /deb order tsm,auctionator,scan; /deb sources shows the order and what's installed.
Where the recipes come from
The recipe list (1,971 recipes across Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Cooking, Enchanting items, Engineering, First Aid, Leatherworking, Mining and Tailoring) comes from WoW: Forever's own client tables (build 1.60.1, via wago.tools), so it has Forever's reagents, not vanilla's: for example Minor Healing Potion in Forever uses an Empty Vial, Mild Spices and Peaceblooms. tools/gen_data.py regenerates it after a patch. Skill levels are where a recipe turns yellow and grey, coloured against your own skill. Each time you open a profession window the addon also records what you know and adds any recipe the bundled list doesn't have.

Reagent cost uses the vendor price for reagents a vendor sells (thread, flux, vials, spices, dyes), as Auctionator's crafting view does: learned from merchant windows you open, else Forever's listed price. Everything else uses the auction price. Profit is shown only when every reagent and the result have a price, so a missing price can't make a recipe look better than it is.
How it's different
Reverse lookups exist (Recipe Master by BrenoLudgero, ATT, Auctionator's crafting info, TSM's crafting tab, CraftSim on retail, Crafting Dictionary on retail), but they either track which recipes you're missing, price recipes you already know, or start from the recipe rather than the material. This one starts from the material, prices every option from your own AH addon, and lets you walk the chain material > intermediate > final, like the Guide in Terraria.
Commands
/deb (or /craftguide) open · /deb · sources · prefer · order a,b,c · tooltip · altclick · report · help. Source ids: pricelog, auctionator, tsm, auctioneer, scan.

addons.description:
GoldPerSpot (WoW: Forever) v0.3.4
Formerly "FarmTracker" in wow-forever-addons. It was renamed because several addons on CurseForge already use "FarmTracker".

Tracks a farming session and shows, in a small movable frame:
• spot name and session time
• total value and gold per hour
• coin looted
• the top 5 items by value ((v) = valued at vendor price)
• a verdict such as this spot: 3.2g/hr vs your best 4.5g/hr (Westfall boars). Under 75% of your best it adds "consider "; beating it shows "NEW BEST".

How it counts:
• Items: it compares your bags before and after, so skinning, herbs and loot all count in any language. Changes while a vendor, mailbox, bank, trade or AH window is open are ignored, so purchases and mail don't count. Bag changes during combat are counted when combat ends.
• Coin: only money gained while a loot window is open (not quest rewards or sales).
• Value: your newest AH scan price (PriceLog or MatTooltip) minus the 5% AH cut, or the vendor price if there's no scan. /goldspot value vendor forces vendor prices.
• History: sessions of 1 minute or more are saved per spot (up to 50 each). Only sessions of 5 minutes or more count as a "best".

Read-only: it never loots, clicks or moves for you.

Extras
• LDB display: with Titan Panel, ChocolateBar, Bazooka or another LibDataBroker display, GoldPerSpot shows your current gold/hour. Hover for the full session, left-click shows or hides the window, right-click starts or pauses a session.

Works with: PriceLog or MatTooltip (AH prices for your loot), NeutralFlip (flip value), MatTooltip (sell-or-craft verdict). Without them it uses vendor prices. Works fully on its own.

addons.description:
Mat Tooltip (WoW: Forever) v0.4.3
Adds lines to item tooltips for every crafting mat (Trade Goods: cloth, herbs, ore and bars, leather, elemental, enchanting and more):
• AH (your scan): the lowest per-unit buyout from your newest full AH scan (this addon's or PriceLog's).
• Vendor: the vendor sell price.
• NEVER VENDOR: a flag for scarce mats. The list is seeded with Pristine Leather 249427 and Frilled Lichen 249399, and you can edit it.
• One verdict, SELL ON AH, VENDOR or HOLD:
• SELL ON AH when the AH price after the 5% faction cut beats vendor by 10% or more; otherwise VENDOR.
• HOLD when there's no scan yet. Never-vendor mats are never VENDOR.
• A scan older than 3 days adds "price is old".

It never buys, sells, posts or clicks anything. The scan only runs when you type the command.

Extras
• Bagnon bag markers: with Bagnon, crafting mats in your bags get a small SELL, VEND or ? tag, so you can see the verdict without hovering. /mattip bagnon turns them off.
• LDB display: with Titan Panel, ChocolateBar, Bazooka or another LibDataBroker display, it shows what your bag mats would fetch on the AH after the cut, with the verdict for each in the tooltip.

Works with: PriceLog (uses its prices and shows its 7-day trend; no second price store), NeutralFlip (one tooltip block, no repeated AH price), GoldPerSpot (shows the sell-or-craft verdict on your loot). Works fully on its own.

addons.description:
NeutralFlip (WoW: Forever) v0.3.2
In WoW: Forever each faction has its own auction house. The goblin auctioneers in Booty Bay, Gadgetzan and Everlook run the only cross-faction market. Prices there often differ a lot from your faction's house (see auctionhouse.fyi Horde vs Alliance).

NeutralFlip keeps separate prices for your faction AH and the neutral AH. It then tells you which items are worth carrying across, after the cut:
• Both directions: faction to neutral, and neutral to faction.
• Net of the cut: each listing is priced 1c under the lowest one you saw, and the profit shown is after the 5% or 15% cut.
• Filters: a flip only shows if its profit is at least 20% of the buy price and at least 50c a unit. Prices older than 24 hours are ignored.
• Quantity: capped at what's listed at the lowest price and at what the other house lists.
• Deposit at risk: you get the deposit back if the item sells. The rate is measured with C_AuctionHouse.CalculateCommodityDeposit the first time you open each kind of AH.
• Thin-market flag: shown when the gap is 20x or more, because that's usually a troll listing.
• Tooltip: adds one or two lines: both prices, plus the flip if there is one.

It never buys, posts or clicks anything. It only records prices the AH already shows you, from your own searches or a full scan you start yourself. It also picks up full scans started by PriceLog or MatTooltip. You make every purchase and post.

Good to know: the 5% faction / 15% neutral cuts come from AHledger, and you can change them with /nflip cut. If a spot is detected as the wrong auction house, /nflip here neutral or /nflip here faction fixes it for that spot.

Extras
• TomTom arrow: /nflip way points a TomTom arrow at the nearest neutral AH (Gadgetzan on Kalimdor, Booty Bay in the Eastern Kingdoms), or /nflip way everlook. Only if TomTom is installed. It sets a waypoint; you do the walking.
• LDB display: with Titan Panel, ChocolateBar, Bazooka or another LibDataBroker display, NeutralFlip shows the number of flips, the top five in its tooltip, opens the list on left-click and sets the TomTom arrow on right-click.

Works with: PriceLog (uses its saved prices; one scan feeds both), MatTooltip (one tooltip block, no repeated AH price), GoldPerSpot (shows the flip value of farmed items). Works fully on its own.

addons.description:
Price Log (WoW: Forever) v0.3.2
Records auction house prices from your own scans and searches into SavedVariables, kept separately for each realm and faction:
• Full scan: /pricelog scan at an open AH. This is Blizzard's full-AH replicate, limited to about once per 15 minutes; the addon tells you how long is left. For every item it stores the lowest unit buyout, the median unit buyout and the total quantity.
• Your searches: when you browse or search the AH yourself, the shown lowest price and quantity are recorded too, at most one point per item per minute.
• A full scan started from MatTooltip is captured as well, so one scan feeds every addon.
• Up to 200 points per item, kept for 90 days.

Trend: /pricelog trend compares the latest price to the median of the previous 7 days. It shows RISING (more than 10% above), FALLING (more than 10% below) or STABLE, and NOT ENOUGH DATA with fewer than 3 points.

Works with: NeutralFlip, MatTooltip and GoldPerSpot all read its prices, so you only scan once; MatTooltip shows its 7-day trend. Falls back to Auctionator's prices if you have Auctionator. Works fully on its own.
Export
WoW addons can't write files, so there are two ways to get the data out:
1. /pricelog export [days] [itemID or link] opens a window with CSV text already selected: press Ctrl+C and paste into a spreadsheet. The columns are itemID,name,date,min_buyout_copper,median_copper,quantity,source, with UTC ISO dates. Large logs are capped at 20,000 rows, so narrow by days or item if it says "truncated".
2. Offline path: after you log out or /reload, everything is in World of Warcraft\forever\WTF\Account\\SavedVariables\PriceLog.lua (the KennyPriceLogDB table), which a Python script can read next to auctionhouse.fyi data.

Extras
• LDB display: with Titan Panel, ChocolateBar, Bazooka or another LibDataBroker display, Price Log shows how many prices are logged and when your last full scan was. Left-click prints stats, right-click opens the CSV export.

addons.description:
A lightweight World of Warcraft addon that hides all Battle.net (Real ID and BattleTag) friends from your in-game friends list. Only your character-level WoW friends remain visible.
Why?
• Streaming & content creation - Prevents accidental display of real names and BattleTags on stream or in screenshots.
• Cleaner friends list - See only your WoW friends from the same server/faction, without the clutter of cross-game Battle.net contacts.
• Privacy - Keep your Battle.net social graph private while still playing normally.
How it works
The addon overrides BNGetNumFriends() to return zero, so the WoW friends UI simply sees no Battle.net friends to display. That's it - 4 lines of Lua.

Nothing is deleted or modified server-side. You can still:
• Receive and reply to Battle.net whispers
• Send and accept Battle.net friend requests
• See your Battle.net friends in the Battle.net app
Compatibility
| Client | Supported |
|---|---|
| Retail (The War Within / Midnight) | Yes |
| Classic (Cataclysm / MoP) | Yes |
| Classic Era | Yes |
| Anniversary Edition | Yes |
| Forever | Yes |

Interface versions are automatically kept up to date via CI.

addons.description:
Outil de guilde WoW Forever : addon, site, bot Discord et app compagnon, autour d'une base Supabase.
• Conventions et fonctionnalités : CLAUDE.md.
• Tests encore à faire en jeu : docs/tests-en-jeu.md.
• Résultats de la sonde sur WoW Forever : docs/phase-0/resultats.md.
• Charte graphique « La Taverne », maquettes et captures : docs/design.
Démarrer
Depuis le terminal de VS Code, lancer Electron avec env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE … : sinon il se comporte comme Node.
Structure
Dépôt unique géré par les espaces de travail npm. Un dossier n'est créé que quand il a du contenu.

| Dossier | Contenu |
| --- | --- |
| apps/web | Site et API, Next.js 16 sur Vercel (vxv-web.vercel.app), et adresse des interactions du bot (/api/discord/interactions) |
| apps/companion | Compagnon de bureau (Electron, Windows et Mac) : relie le jeu au site (@vxv/companion) |
| packages/server | Cœur du serveur partagé par le site et le bot : domaine, cas d'usage, PostgreSQL (@vxv/server) |
| packages/bot | Bot Discord en interactions HTTP : signature, commandes, boutons (@vxv/bot), hébergé par apps/web |
| packages/raid-data | Schéma et validation des données de raid (@vxv/raid-data) |
| packages/lua | Données Lua 5.1 : écriture pour l'addon, lecture des SavedVariables du jeu sans les exécuter (@vxv/lua) |
| packages/design | Jetons de la charte (couleurs, polices), thème du site et de l'addon générés (@vxv/design) |
| addon/VXV | L'addon, en un seul dossier : le socle (Core), une partie par lieu (Raid, Paris…), le lien avec le compagnon (Sync) et les données des raids (Data) |
| data/raids | Source des données de raid en JSON, une par raid (format) |
| data/dungeons | Dernier boss de chaque donjon en JSON, pour la quête des donjons en guilde (format) |
| supabase/ | Schéma, migrations et tests de la base (@vxv/database) |
| tools/data-generator | Données des raids : addon/VXV/Data/Raids.lua et script SQL dans dist/generated (npm run generate) |
| tools/addon-release | Copie l'addon à publier et inscrit la version (npm run release:prepare -- v1.2.0) |
| tools/addon-harness | Banc d'essai de l'addon hors du jeu, sur un client simulé, et export du journal de la sonde (npm run export:probe -- ) |
| tools/VXV_Probe | Sonde : addon de mesure sur WoW Forever, jamais distribué |
| tools/install-addon.sh | Construit l'addon comme une publication (version de développement) et l'installe dans un client, à la place des anciens dossiers VXV_… |
| tools/install-probe.sh | Copie la sonde dans le dossier AddOns d'un client |
| tools/deploy-database.sh | Déploie la base : migrations puis données de raid |
| docs/ | Charte graphique, résultats de la sonde, tests à faire en jeu |
Environnements
| | Test | Production |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base | Supabase vxv-test | Supabase vxv-prod |
| Mise à jour de la base | Automatique à chaque fusion dans main qui touche supabase/migrations ou data/raids | Manuelle : gh workflow run deploy-database.yml --ref main -f target=production |
| Site et bot (Vercel, projet vxv-web) | Prévisualisation de chaque demande de fusion, la dernière sur https://vxv-web-test.vercel.app (protégée par Vercel) | main, sur https://vxv-web.vercel.app |

Tout part de la CI, après les tests : le déploiement automatique de Vercel depuis git est désactivé (apps/web/vercel.json).
La CI rejoue aussi le déploiement de la base deux fois sur un PostgreSQL jetable à chaque demande de fusion. La base de
test ne contient jamais de vraies données de membres : son mot de passe est considéré comme exposé.
Secrets et variables
Aucun secret dans le dépôt (.env et ses variantes sont ignorés par git). Un secret se saisit sans l'afficher :
gh secret set pour GitHub, vercel env add pour Vercel.

| Où | Secrets | Variables |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub, flux « Deploy database » | SUPABASE_TEST_DB_URL, SUPABASE_PRODUCTION_DB_URL (« Session pooler » : GitHub ne joint pas l'IPv6 de la connexion directe) | |…
